en: to accept and follow a rule or decision
simple: We must abide by the rules.
toeic: All employees must abide by the company safety policy.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的安全政策。

en: a person who manages an organization or system
simple_zh: 管理員修復了我的帳號。
toeic: Please contact the system administrator if you cannot log in.
toeic_zh: 如果無法登入，請聯絡系統管理員。

en: additional information at the end of a document
simple: The detailed data is in the appendix.
toeic: Additional supporting documents are provided in the appendix.
toeic_zh: 附錄中提供了其他支持文檔。

en: to store documents for long-term keeping
simple: We archive old files in the basement.
simple_zh: 我們將舊文件存檔在地下室。
toeic: Please archive this year's documents before the fiscal year ends.
toeic_zh: 請在財政年度結束前存檔今年的文檔。

en: to succeed in reaching a goal
simple: She worked hard to attain her goal.
simple_zh: 她努力工作以達成目標。
toeic: The team attained its sales target ahead of schedule.
toeic_zh: 團隊提前達成了銷售目標。

en: clothes, especially formal ones
simple_zh: 這裡要求穿著商務服裝。
toeic: The invitation says the dress code is formal attire.
toeic_zh: 邀請函上寫明服裝規定為正式服裝。

en: a thorough examination of accounts or procedures
toeic: An external audit ensures compliance with financial regulations.
toeic_zh: 外部審計確保符合財務法規。

en: power to decide, or an official group
simple: The police have the authority to stop cars.
toeic: Only the manager has the authority to approve this expense.
toeic_zh: 只有經理有權核准這筆費用。

en: official permission or power to do something
toeic: Authorization codes are required for all system access.
toeic_zh: 所有系統訪問都需要授權代碼。

en: to give official permission or approval
toeic: Only authorized personnel can approve expenses over $5000.
toeic_zh: 只有授權人員可以批准超過5000美元的費用。

en: a small card or pin showing who you are
toeic: All visitors must wear a badge while inside the building.
toeic_zh: 所有訪客在大樓內都必須配戴識別證。

en: A flat case for carrying papers and documents.
simple_zh: 他提著一個黑色公事包。
toeic: Please do not leave your briefcase unattended at the airport.
toeic_zh: 請勿將公事包留在機場無人看管。

en: A man who works in business, especially as an owner.
toeic: The businessman flew to Tokyo to meet a new supplier.
toeic_zh: 這位商人飛往東京去見一家新供應商。

en: A person who works in business, of any gender.
simple_zh: 她是個忙碌的商務人士。
toeic: Every businessperson at the summit received a welcome packet.
toeic_zh: 高峰會上每位商務人士都收到一份歡迎資料袋。

en: A cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things.
simple: The files are in the cabinet.
toeic: All invoices must be locked in the filing cabinet every evening.
toeic_zh: 所有發票每晚都必須鎖在檔案櫃裡。

en: Not paying enough attention to what you do.
simple_zh: 他犯了一個粗心的錯誤。
toeic: A careless error in the report cost the company money.
toeic_zh: 報告中一個粗心的錯誤讓公司損失了金錢。

en: movement or distribution through a group
toeic: The document is in circulation for approval.
toeic_zh: 文檔正在傳閱以待批准。

en: A person who works in an office or shop doing simple tasks.
simple: The clerk helped me find it.
toeic: The desk clerk will check you in at the hotel.
toeic_zh: 櫃檯人員會為您辦理飯店入住。

en: A small device for holding things together, or a short video.
toeic: Please attach the receipt to the form with a clip.
toeic_zh: 請用夾子把收據附在表格上。

en: the action of working together
toeic: Effective collaboration between teams leads to innovation.
toeic_zh: 團隊之間的有效協作導致創新。

en: To collect information and put it together.
toeic: Please compile the sales figures into a single report.
toeic_zh: 請將銷售數字彙整成一份報告。

en: the action of complying with rules or standards
simple: Compliance is mandatory for all employees.
simple_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守合規。
toeic: Regular audits ensure compliance with regulations.
toeic_zh: 定期審計確保合規性。

en: to follow rules or requirements
simple: All employees must comply with safety regulations.
simple_zh: 所有員工必須遵守安全規定。
toeic: The department must comply with the new financial reporting standards.
toeic_zh: 部門必須遵守新的財務報告標準。

en: proof that something has been received or is correct
simple: I need a confirmation of receipt.
toeic: Please send a confirmation once you receive this email.
toeic_zh: 收到此電郵後，請發送確認。

en: always in the same way; regularly
toeic: The company has consistently met its quarterly targets.
toeic_zh: 該公司一直達成季度目標。

en: a difference between two statements that cannot both be true
simple: There is a contradiction in his story.
toeic: I found a contradiction between the invoice and the order form.
toeic_zh: 我發現發票與訂單之間有矛盾。

en: to arrange or organize different activities
toeic: The project manager will coordinate all team activities.
toeic_zh: 項目經理將協調所有團隊活動。

en: a machine that makes copies of documents
simple: The copier is out of paper.
toeic: The copier on the third floor is jammed again.
toeic_zh: 三樓的影印機又卡紙了。

en: the final date to complete something
toeic: We must meet the deadline for this project.
toeic_zh: 我們必須趕上這個項目的截止日期。

en: to assign a task to someone else
simple: I delegate tasks to my team.
simple_zh: 我將任務委派給我的團隊。
toeic: Effective managers know how to delegate responsibility.
toeic_zh: 有效的經理知道如何委派責任。

en: to remove something from a file or list
toeic: Make sure you delete old files before saving new ones.
toeic_zh: 儲存新檔案前，請務必刪除舊檔案。

en: giving details about what something is like
simple_zh: 這本小冊子描述得很詳細。
toeic: Please write a descriptive title that explains the file's content.
toeic_zh: 請撰寫能說明檔案內容的描述性標題。

en: written material providing information or procedures
toeic: Complete documentation is required for all processes.
toeic_zh: 所有流程都需要完整文檔。

en: a box-like part of a desk that slides out
simple: The pen is in the drawer.
toeic: Please keep the signed contracts in the top drawer.
toeic_zh: 請把簽好的合約放在最上層抽屜。

en: to make an exact copy of something
toeic: Do not duplicate the report without written permission.
toeic_zh: 未經書面許可，請勿複製這份報告。

en: in a way that saves time, money, or effort
toeic: The new software helps staff handle orders more efficiently.
toeic_zh: 新軟體幫助員工更有效率地處理訂單。

en: by using computers or electronic devices
simple_zh: 你可以用電子方式付款。
toeic: Please submit your application electronically by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前以電子方式提交申請。

en: to raise something to a higher level
simple: They elevate the bed with blocks.
toeic: The training program will elevate our service standards.
toeic_zh: 這項訓練計畫將提升我們的服務水準。

en: to remove writing or data completely
toeic: Do not erase any files from the shared drive.
toeic_zh: 請勿從共用磁碟機刪除任何檔案。

en: in a way that is equal or smooth
toeic: The workload should be divided evenly among team members.
toeic_zh: 工作量應該平均分配給團隊成員。

en: to make something easier or help it happen
simple: I facilitate the discussion among team members.
simple_zh: 我促進團隊成員之間的討論。
toeic: The coordinator will facilitate the workshop sessions.
toeic_zh: 協調員將主持研討會課程。

en: information about how someone did something
toeic: Please provide feedback on the training program.
toeic_zh: 請提供對培訓計劃的反饋。

en: to make something final or complete
toeic: Please finalize the budget before month-end.
toeic_zh: 請在月末前定稿預算。

en: a container for keeping papers or computer files
simple: Put the paper in the folder.
toeic: I saved the report in the shared folder.
toeic_zh: 我把報告存在共用資料夾裡。

en: to say that something is not allowed
simple: The rules forbid food in class.
simple_zh: 規定禁止在教室內吃東西。
toeic: Company policy forbids employees from sharing passwords.
toeic_zh: 公司政策禁止員工分享密碼。

en: talk about other people's private lives
simple: I do not like office gossip.
toeic: Office gossip can hurt team morale.
toeic_zh: 辦公室八卦可能會損害團隊士氣。

en: a diagram showing how numbers change or relate
simple_zh: 這張圖表顯示我們的銷售額。
toeic: Please refer to the graph on page five for last quarter's results.
toeic_zh: 請參閱第五頁的圖表了解上一季的結果。

en: the main office of a company
toeic: The company's headquarters will move to a larger building next spring.
toeic_zh: 公司總部明年春天將搬到更大的大樓。

en: an official document that proves who you are
toeic: Visitors must show identification at the security desk.
toeic_zh: 訪客必須在警衛台出示身分證件。

en: extremely important and needing action now
simple: It is imperative to be on time.
toeic: It is imperative that all staff complete the safety training today.
toeic_zh: 所有員工今天務必完成安全訓練。

en: wasting time, money, or energy
toeic: The old filing system was slow and inefficient.
toeic_zh: 舊的歸檔系統既慢又沒效率。

en: an organization for education or research
toeic: The research institute released its annual economic report today.
toeic_zh: 研究機構今天發布了年度經濟報告。

en: necessary and forming an important part of a whole
simple: Teamwork is integral to our job.
simple_zh: 團隊合作是我們工作中不可或缺的。
toeic: Customer feedback is integral to our product development process.
toeic_zh: 顧客回饋是我們產品開發過程中不可或缺的一部分。

en: to get in the way of something
toeic: Please do not let personal matters interfere with your work.
toeic_zh: 請勿讓私人事務妨礙您的工作。

en: a document showing goods sold and payment due
simple: I issue an invoice to the client.
toeic: The invoice must include all items and pricing details.
toeic_zh: 發票必須包含所有項目和定價詳情。

en: A set of tools or items for one purpose
simple: We have a first aid kit at home.
simple_zh: 我們家裡有一個急救箱。
toeic: Each new employee receives a welcome kit on the first day.
toeic_zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會收到一份迎新包。

en: In the recent past
toeic: Sales have improved steadily lately.
toeic_zh: 最近銷售額穩定成長。

en: Paper printed with a company name and address
simple: Please print the letter on letterhead.
simple_zh: 請把信印在公司信紙上。
toeic: All official letters must be printed on company letterhead.
toeic_zh: 所有正式信件都必須印在公司信紙上。

en: A person who works in a library
simple: The librarian helped me find a book.
simple_zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本書。
toeic: The librarian will organize a workshop on research skills.
toeic_zh: 圖書館員將舉辦研究技巧工作坊。

en: The time of day when people eat lunch
simple: The shop is busy at lunchtime.
simple_zh: 這家店在午餐時間很忙。
toeic: The office is closed to visitors at lunchtime.
toeic_zh: 辦公室在午餐時間不接待訪客。

en: Required by a rule or law
simple: The class is mandatory for everyone.
simple_zh: 這堂課每個人都必須上。
toeic: Attendance at the safety training is mandatory.
toeic_zh: 出席安全訓練是強制性的。

en: a short message about business matters
simple: I send a memo to the team.
toeic: The manager distributed a memo regarding the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理分發了關於新政策的備忘錄。

en: A short written note used in an office
simple: He sent a memorandum to staff.
simple_zh: 他寄了一份備忘錄給員工。
toeic: The director issued a memorandum about the new dress code.
toeic_zh: 主管發出一份關於新服裝規定的備忘錄。

en: An oven that heats food quickly
simple: Use the microwave to heat the soup.
toeic: There is a microwave in the staff break room.
toeic_zh: 員工休息室裡有一台微波爐。

en: To put something where you cannot find it
simple_zh: 我常常把鑰匙放到找不到。
toeic: Please do not misplace the original invoice.
toeic_zh: 請不要遺失發票正本。

en: A short sleep during the day
simple: The baby is taking a nap.
toeic: A short nap can help employees stay focused in the afternoon.
toeic_zh: 短暫的午睡能幫助員工下午保持專注。

en: Clean and well arranged
toeic: Please keep the reception area neat for visitors.
toeic_zh: 請為訪客保持接待區整潔。

en: to inform someone of something
simple: I notify my team about the changes.
simple_zh: 我通知我的團隊有關更改。
toeic: Please notify your supervisor if you cannot attend the meeting.
toeic_zh: 如果您無法參加會議，請通知主管。

en: To leave something out
simple: Please do not omit any steps.
toeic: Do not omit your phone number from the application form.
toeic_zh: 請勿在申請表中漏填您的電話號碼。

en: Not required, but you may choose it
toeic: Attendance at the evening workshop is optional.
toeic_zh: 晚間工作坊可自由參加。

en: Related to how a group or company is arranged
toeic: The consultant will review our organizational structure.
toeic_zh: 顧問將檢視我們的組織架構。

en: a failure in the supply of something
toeic: System outages must be reported immediately.
toeic_zh: 系統故障必須立即報告。

en: shaped like an egg or a long circle
simple_zh: 我們有一張橢圓形的桌子。
toeic: The conference room has a large oval table.
toeic_zh: 會議室裡有一張大型橢圓形桌子。

en: past the time when something should happen
toeic: Overdue payments will incur a 5% penalty charge.
toeic_zh: 逾期付款將收取5%的罰款。

en: to watch and manage work or people
toeic: The manager will oversee the construction of the new branch.
toeic_zh: 經理將監督新分公司的興建。

en: Extra hours worked beyond the normal working schedule.
simple: My father works overtime on Fridays.
toeic: Employees who work overtime will be paid at one and a half times their rate.
toeic_zh: 加班的員工將以一點五倍的薪資計算。

en: written work such as forms and reports
simple: I have a lot of paperwork.
toeic: Please complete the paperwork before your first day of work.
toeic_zh: 請在上班第一天前完成文件作業。

en: list of employees and their salaries
simple: The payroll is processed every two weeks.
toeic: The finance department manages payroll and benefits administration.
toeic_zh: 財務部門管理薪資和福利管理。

en: a machine that copies documents
toeic: Please call the technician to repair the photocopier.
toeic_zh: 請打電話請技術人員修理影印機。

en: to make a copy of a paper
toeic: Please photocopy the contract and send it to legal.
toeic_zh: 請把合約影印後送給法務部。

en: to delay something to a later time
simple: We postpone the meeting to next week.
simple_zh: 我們將會議延期到下週。
toeic: The company postponed the launch due to technical issues.
toeic_zh: 由於技術問題，公司延期了發布。

en: to check a text for mistakes
toeic: Please proofread the brochure before it goes to print.
toeic_zh: 手冊印刷前請先校對。

en: happening four times a year; every three months
toeic: The quarterly report shows our financial performance.
toeic_zh: 季度報告顯示了我們的財務績效。

en: a document showing that something was received
simple: I keep the receipt for records.
toeic: Please provide a receipt for the office supplies purchased.
toeic_zh: 請提供購買辦公用品的收據。

en: a person who greets visitors and answers phones
toeic: Please leave your name with the receptionist when you arrive.
toeic_zh: 抵達時請將您的姓名留給接待人員。

en: a person who receives something
toeic: Make sure the recipient is correct before sending.
toeic_zh: 發送前確保收件人正確。

en: done automatically without thinking
toeic: The grammar test included a question about reflexive pronouns.
toeic_zh: 文法測驗包含一道關於反身代名詞的題目。

en: to repay money spent by someone else
toeic: I will reimburse you for the office supplies you purchased.
toeic_zh: 我會報銷你購買的辦公用品費用。

en: something that helps you remember something
simple: I send a reminder about the meeting.
toeic: The system sends you a reminder before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 系統在截止日期前向你發送提醒。

en: doing or saying the same thing again
simple_zh: 重複練習幫助我學單字。
toeic: Avoid repetition in your report to keep it short.
toeic_zh: 報告中請避免重複，以保持簡潔。

en: to make a copy of something
simple_zh: 我們不能複製這張照片。
toeic: You may not reproduce any part of this manual without permission.
toeic_zh: 未經許可，不得複製本手冊的任何部分。

en: a person who checks or judges something
toeic: A reviewer will check the contract before it is signed.
toeic_zh: 簽約前會有審查人員檢閱合約。

en: to write something again to make it better
toeic: The editor asked me to rewrite the first paragraph.
toeic_zh: 編輯要求我重寫第一段。

en: a story that may not be true
simple: I heard a rumor about him.
simple_zh: 我聽到一則關於他的謠言。
toeic: There is a rumor that the company will merge with a rival.
toeic_zh: 有傳聞說公司將與競爭對手合併。

en: not often
toeic: The printer is seldom used, so we may sell it.
toeic_zh: 這台印表機很少使用，所以我們可能會把它賣掉。

en: a person's name written in their own handwriting
simple: I need your signature on this document.
simple_zh: 我需要你在這份文檔上簽名。
toeic: The contract requires authorized signature and approval.
toeic_zh: 合同需要授權簽名和批准。

en: to be a sign of something
simple: A red light can signify stop.
toeic: The green icon will signify that the file has been saved.
toeic_zh: 綠色圖示表示檔案已儲存。

en: without making any sound
toeic: Please work silently in the library so others can study.
toeic_zh: 請在圖書館安靜工作，以免打擾他人讀書。

en: to make something easier
toeic: The new form will simplify the application process.
toeic_zh: 新表格將簡化申請流程。

en: without problems or sudden changes
toeic: The new system is running smoothly after the update.
toeic_zh: 新系統在更新後運作順暢。

en: unwanted email messages
simple: These emails are spam and should be deleted.
simple_zh: 這些電郵是垃圾郵件，應該刪除。
toeic: Use the spam filter to automatically delete unwanted emails.
toeic_zh: 使用垃圾郵件過濾器自動刪除不需要的電郵。

zh: 惡意；(in spite of) 儘管
en: in spite of: although something happened
simple: We went out in spite of the rain.
simple_zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是出去了。
toeic: In spite of the budget cuts, the team finished on time.
toeic_zh: 儘管預算被削減，團隊仍準時完成。

en: a computer file with rows and columns of numbers
toeic: Please update the spreadsheet with this month's expenses.
toeic_zh: 請用本月支出更新試算表。

en: to fasten papers with small metal pieces
simple_zh: 請把這些頁面釘在一起。
toeic: Staple the receipt to the expense form before submitting it.
toeic_zh: 送出前請把收據釘在費用表上。

en: a tool that fastens papers together
toeic: Do you know where I can find a stapler?
toeic_zh: 你知道哪裡可以找到釘書機嗎？

en: Writing materials such as pens, paper, and envelopes.
simple: I need new stationery for school.
toeic: Please order more stationery before the supply cabinet runs out.
toeic_zh: 請在文具櫃用完之前多訂購一些文具。

en: the act of sending something for approval
toeic: The deadline for proposal submission is next Monday.
toeic_zh: 提案提交的截止日是下週一。

en: a person who directs and controls workers
simple_zh: 我的主管批准了我的請求。
toeic: You should report this issue to your supervisor.
toeic_zh: 你應該向主管報告這個問題。

en: for a short time only
toeic: The office will be temporarily closed for renovation.
toeic_zh: 辦公室將因整修而暫時關閉。

en: a book used for studying a subject
toeic: The publisher released a new textbook for business English.
toeic_zh: 出版社推出了一本新的商用英語教科書。

en: completely and carefully
toeic: Please read the contract thoroughly before signing it.
toeic_zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀整份合約。

en: neat and well arranged
toeic: Employees are asked to keep their work areas tidy.
toeic_zh: 員工被要求保持工作區域整潔。

en: a schedule showing when things will happen
toeic: All project milestones are shown on the timeline.
toeic_zh: 所有項目里程碑都顯示在時間線上。

en: Done without official permission.
simple_zh: 未經授權的人不得進入。
toeic: Unauthorized use of company software is strictly prohibited.
toeic_zh: 嚴禁未經授權使用公司軟體。

en: Not known or not well known to you.
simple: This city is unfamiliar to me.
toeic: New staff may be unfamiliar with our filing system.
toeic_zh: 新進員工可能不熟悉我們的歸檔系統。

en: Not clearly stated or named.
simple: The meeting is at an unspecified time.
toeic: The email mentioned an unspecified amount of additional costs.
toeic_zh: 電子郵件提到一筆未指明金額的額外費用。

en: requiring immediate action or attention
toeic: The urgent emails are marked with red flags.
toeic_zh: 緊急電郵用紅旗標記。

en: In a way that must be done at once.
toeic: We urgently need to replace the broken printer before Monday.
toeic_zh: 我們必須在週一前緊急更換壞掉的印表機。

en: a place where an event is held
simple: The venue is near the train station.
toeic: We need to confirm the venue for the upcoming conference.
toeic_zh: 我們需要確認即將舉行的會議的地點。

en: responsibility for one's actions
simple: Accountability is important in our workplace.
simple_zh: 問責在我們的工作場所很重要。
toeic: Each manager is accountable for their team's performance.
toeic_zh: 每位經理對其團隊的績效負責。

en: a standard used for comparison or measurement
simple: We set a benchmark for quality.
toeic: Industry benchmarks help us evaluate our competitive position.
toeic_zh: 行業基準幫助我們評估我們的競爭地位。

en: a provision for something that might happen
toeic: Contingency plans ensure business continuity.
toeic_zh: 應急計劃確保業務連續性。

en: decrease in value of an asset over time
toeic: Calculate the depreciation for office equipment.
toeic_zh: 計算辦公設備的折舊。

en: to free someone from an obligation
simple: The team is exempt from the new policy.
toeic: Certain employees are exempt from the dress code policy.
toeic_zh: 某些員工不受著裝規範政策約束。

en: honesty and moral principles
simple_zh: 誠正對領導力至關重要。
toeic: The company is known for its integrity and ethical practices.
toeic_zh: 公司以其誠正和倫理實踐而聞名。

en: a standard measurement or unit
simple_zh: 我們跟踪幾個關鍵指標。
toeic: The marketing team uses specific metrics to measure campaign success.
toeic_zh: 營銷團隊使用特定指標來衡量活動的成功。

en: an important event or achievement in a project
simple: We reached a major milestone today.
simple_zh: 我們今天達到了一個主要里程碑。
toeic: Meeting this milestone will keep us on schedule.
toeic_zh: 達到這個里程碑將使我們按時進行。

en: to make something as good as possible
toeic: Optimizing the distribution network will reduce costs.
toeic_zh: 優化配送網絡將降低成本。

en: rules or procedures to follow
toeic: All communication must follow established protocols.
toeic_zh: 所有通信都必須遵循既定協議。

en: to make sure accounts match
simple: We reconcile the bank account monthly.
simple_zh: 我們每月對帳銀行帳戶。
toeic: The accounting team must reconcile all invoices before month-end.
toeic_zh: 會計團隊必須在月末前對帳所有發票。

en: the state of being redundant or no longer needed
toeic: We maintain redundancy for critical systems.
toeic_zh: 我們為關鍵系統維護冗餘。

en: the action of keeping or holding something
toeic: The company has a retention policy for all employee records.
toeic_zh: 公司對所有員工記錄有保留政策。

en: a person with an interest in a business or project
toeic: Key stakeholders must approve the project proposal.
toeic_zh: 關鍵利益相關者必須批准項目提案。

en: ability to meet present needs without harming the future
simple_zh: 可持續性是我們的優先事項。
toeic: The company is committed to environmental sustainability.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於環境可持續性。

en: a standard pattern to be copied
simple: We use a standard template for reports.
simple_zh: 我們使用標準範本進行報告。
toeic: Use this template as a guide for creating your proposal.
toeic_zh: 使用此範本作為創建提案的指南。

en: openness and clarity in dealings
simple_zh: 我們重視溝通的透明度。
toeic: Organizational transparency builds employee trust.
toeic_zh: 組織透明度建立員工信任。

en: the difference between expected and actual results
toeic: Explain the variance between projected and actual revenue.
toeic_zh: 解釋預計收入和實際收入之間的差異。

en: Final or greatest; the best possible.
toeic: The ultimate decision rests with the board of directors.
toeic_zh: 最終決定權在董事會手上。

en: In the most basic or important way.
simple: He is essentially a kind man.
simple_zh: 他本質上是個善良的人。
toeic: The two proposals are essentially the same in cost.
toeic_zh: 這兩個提案在成本上基本相同。

en: Something handed down from the past.
toeic: The founder's legacy is still seen in our company culture.
toeic_zh: 創辦人的傳承仍可見於我們的企業文化。

en: good judgment from experience and knowledge
simple: My grandfather is full of wisdom.
toeic: The manager's wisdom helped the team avoid a costly mistake.
toeic_zh: 經理的智慧幫助團隊避免了一次代價高昂的錯誤。

en: the act of carrying out a plan
simple: The execution of the plan was easy.
simple_zh: 這個計畫的執行很容易。
toeic: Careful execution of the marketing strategy raised our profits.
toeic_zh: 行銷策略的謹慎執行提高了我們的利潤。

en: good enough to deserve respect or attention
toeic: The proposal is worthy of serious consideration by the board.
toeic_zh: 這項提案值得董事會認真考慮。

en: what a person plans or wants to do
toeic: The letter of intent shows their interest in buying the firm.
toeic_zh: 意向書顯示他們有意購買這家公司。

en: the state of being joined together
simple_zh: 團隊展現出極大的團結。
toeic: Unity among departments is key to completing the project on time.
toeic_zh: 各部門之間的團結是準時完成專案的關鍵。

en: only, and nothing else
simple: She works solely for this company.
toeic: The manager is solely responsible for approving the budget.
toeic_zh: 經理單獨負責核准預算。

en: having no end
toeic: The endless paperwork slowed down the approval process.
toeic_zh: 無止盡的文書作業拖慢了核准流程。

en: empty, with nothing written
toeic: Please leave the signature field blank until you arrive.
toeic_zh: 請在您抵達前讓簽名欄保持空白。

en: agreement with rules or a plan
simple: We act in accordance with the law.
toeic: In accordance with company policy, all expenses need receipts.
toeic_zh: 依照公司政策，所有支出都需要收據。

en: the act of dividing or being apart
simple: The separation was hard for the family.
simple_zh: 這次分離對這家人很難受。
toeic: The separation of duties helps prevent errors in accounting.
toeic_zh: 職責分離有助於避免會計上的錯誤。

en: happening sometimes but not often
simple: I have an occasional cup of tea.
toeic: Occasional delays may occur during the system upgrade.
toeic_zh: 系統升級期間可能偶爾會有延遲。

en: very small in amount or degree
toeic: The upgrade requires minimal effort from the IT staff.
toeic_zh: 此次升級只需要資訊人員付出極少的心力。

en: only; completely
toeic: The change was made purely for safety reasons.
toeic_zh: 這項變更純粹是出於安全考量。

en: in a way that appears true but may not be
simple_zh: 這個測驗看起來很簡單。
toeic: The seemingly small error caused a major delay in shipping.
toeic_zh: 這個看似微小的錯誤造成了出貨的嚴重延誤。

en: used to show something matters a lot
simple: Importantly, you must arrive on time.
simple_zh: 重要的是，你必須準時到。
toeic: Importantly, all invoices must be submitted before Friday.
toeic_zh: 重要的是，所有發票必須在週五前提交。

en: without help or control from others
toeic: Each team works independently but reports to the same manager.
toeic_zh: 每個團隊各自獨立作業，但向同一位經理報告。

en: a small round mark
simple: Put a dot on the map.
toeic: Please type your name, then a dot, then the company name.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您的姓名，接著打一個點，再輸入公司名稱。

en: the most important quality of something
simple: Honesty is the essence of trust.
toeic: Time is of the essence, so please reply today.
toeic_zh: 時間至關重要，所以請今天回覆。

en: temporary, used until something permanent is ready
simple: Tom is the interim manager now.
toeic: An interim report will be released before the final audit.
toeic_zh: 最終審計之前會先發布期中報告。

en: showing good judgment and practical
toeic: Choosing a cheaper supplier was a sensible decision.
toeic_zh: 選擇較便宜的供應商是明智的決定。

en: to understand something; to hold tightly
toeic: New staff quickly grasp the basics of the software.
toeic_zh: 新進員工很快就掌握了這套軟體的基本操作。

en: difficult to deal with or needing care
toeic: Negotiating with several suppliers at once can be tricky.
toeic_zh: 同時與多家供應商談判可能相當棘手。

en: able to work or succeed
toeic: We need a viable alternative to the current supplier.
toeic_zh: 我們需要一個可行的方案來取代目前的供應商。

en: a good quality; an advantage
toeic: The main virtue of this software is its simplicity.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體的主要優點是簡單易用。

en: the state of not being able to do something
simple: His inability to swim worries us.
simple_zh: 他不會游泳讓我們擔心。
toeic: The company's inability to pay suppliers caused delays.
toeic_zh: 公司無力支付供應商款項而造成延誤。

en: a usual or accepted way of doing things
simple: Working late is the norm here.
toeic: Remote work has become the norm at many companies.
toeic_zh: 遠距工作已成為許多公司的常態。

en: the freedom to decide; care in keeping secrets
toeic: Refunds may be issued at the manager's discretion.
toeic_zh: 退款由經理自行裁量。

en: A natural way of knowing or acting without thought
toeic: Her business instinct told her to wait before investing.
toeic_zh: 她的商業直覺告訴她投資前要先等等。

en: Based on random choice, not reason
toeic: The manager made an arbitrary decision without checking the data.
toeic_zh: 經理沒有查看數據就做了武斷的決定。

en: Able to act or govern independently
toeic: Each branch is autonomous and sets its own budget.
toeic_zh: 每個分公司都是自主的，自行編列預算。

en: To make secret information known
simple: Please do not disclose the price.
toeic: Employees must not disclose confidential information to outsiders.
toeic_zh: 員工不得向外人透露機密資訊。

en: A tool for measuring or a person who rules
toeic: Use a ruler to measure the width of the panel.
toeic_zh: 請用尺測量面板的寬度。

en: To accept something unpleasant without complaint
toeic: The company will not tolerate late deliveries from suppliers.
toeic_zh: 公司不會容忍供應商延遲交貨。

en: A good reason for something
simple: He has no justification for it.
toeic: Please provide a justification for the extra budget request.
toeic_zh: 請提供額外預算申請的理由。

en: Simple and easy to understand
toeic: The application process is straightforward and takes only ten minutes.
toeic_zh: 申請流程簡單明瞭，只需十分鐘。

en: A quotation or reference to a source
simple: Add a citation to the page.
toeic: The report includes a citation from a government study.
toeic_zh: 報告中包含引用自政府研究的內容。

en: To suffer or continue through difficulty
toeic: The company endured several years of heavy losses.
toeic_zh: 公司忍受了數年的重大虧損。

en: Not enough or not good enough
toeic: The current staff is inadequate for the growing workload.
toeic_zh: 目前人手不足以應付日益增加的工作量。

en: A system of methods used in a field
simple: The study uses a new methodology.
simple_zh: 這項研究採用新的方法。
toeic: The consultant explained the methodology behind the survey.
toeic_zh: 顧問說明了這項調查背後的研究方法。

en: To mark with a check or make a clock sound
toeic: Please tick the box if you agree to the terms.
toeic_zh: 如果您同意條款，請在方格內打勾。

en: Not staying the same or not matching
toeic: The sales figures in the two reports are inconsistent.
toeic_zh: 兩份報告中的銷售數字不一致。

en: A system of ranks from high to low
simple: The company has a clear hierarchy.
simple_zh: 這家公司有明確的階層。
toeic: The firm has a flat hierarchy, so staff talk to directors easily.
toeic_zh: 這家公司層級扁平，員工能輕易與主管交談。

en: The state of continuing without a break
toeic: The plan ensures business continuity during a power failure.
toeic_zh: 該計畫確保停電期間業務不中斷。

en: inside an organization or a body
simple_zh: 我們在內部解決了問題。
toeic: The candidate was promoted internally rather than hired from outside.
toeic_zh: 這位人選是內部晉升，而非外部聘用。

en: to use something in a practical way
simple: We utilize the old room for storage.
simple_zh: 我們把舊房間用來儲物。
toeic: We should utilize our existing resources before buying new equipment.
toeic_zh: 在購買新設備之前，我們應該先利用現有資源。

en: to start a process or plan
simple: She wants to initiate a new club.
toeic: The manager decided to initiate a review of the training program.
toeic_zh: 經理決定啟動對培訓計畫的檢討。

en: happening at the end of a process
simple: The eventual winner was our team.
toeic: The eventual cost of the project was double the original estimate.
toeic_zh: 該專案的最終成本是原估計的兩倍。

en: a person who gives money, help, or ideas
simple: She is a top contributor to the team.
simple_zh: 她是團隊的主要貢獻者。
toeic: Sales in Asia were the largest contributor to our revenue growth.
toeic_zh: 亞洲的銷售是我們營收成長的最大貢獻來源。

en: the act of understanding or achieving something
toeic: The realization of this project depends on additional funding.
toeic_zh: 這個專案的實現取決於額外的資金。

en: an official order or instruction
simple: The boss gave us a new directive.
simple_zh: 老闆給了我們一項新指示。
toeic: All staff must follow the new safety directive from headquarters.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守總公司的新安全指令。

en: as a normal and regular part of work
simple_zh: 我例行性地查看電子郵件。
toeic: Machines are routinely inspected to ensure worker safety.
toeic_zh: 機器會例行檢查以確保工人安全。

en: in a way that is good enough
toeic: The staff were not adequately trained to use the new software.
toeic_zh: 員工沒有受過足夠的訓練來使用新軟體。

en: to believe something is true without proof
toeic: We presume that all invoices have been paid by now.
toeic_zh: 我們假定所有發票到現在都已付清。

en: friendly; leaving or going out
toeic: Please place all outgoing mail in the tray by noon.
toeic_zh: 請在中午前把所有寄出的郵件放進托盤。

en: to say words for someone to write; to control
simple: He will dictate a short letter.
toeic: Market conditions dictate how we set our prices.
toeic_zh: 市場狀況決定我們如何定價。

en: separate and clearly different
simple: The box has three discrete parts.
simple_zh: 這個盒子有三個獨立的部分。
toeic: The report is divided into discrete sections.
toeic_zh: 這份報告被分成幾個獨立的章節。

en: operating in many countries
simple: He works for a multinational company.
toeic: The multinational firm has offices in thirty countries.
toeic_zh: 這家跨國公司在三十個國家設有辦公室。

en: to change a text or law to improve it
toeic: The board voted to amend the contract terms.
toeic_zh: 董事會投票決定修訂合約條款。

en: a system with many rules and officials
simple: Too much bureaucracy slows us down.
simple_zh: 過多官僚作風讓我們變慢。
toeic: Bureaucracy delayed the approval of the new building.
toeic_zh: 官僚體制延誤了新大樓的核准。

en: a book with facts about many subjects
simple: I looked it up in an encyclopedia.
simple_zh: 我在百科全書裡查了它。
toeic: The library has an online encyclopedia for members.
toeic_zh: 圖書館為會員提供線上百科全書。

en: Not present at a place or event.
toeic: Two directors were absent from the annual general meeting.
toeic_zh: 有兩位董事缺席年度股東會。

en: in a way that suits the situation
toeic: Prices will be adjusted accordingly after the new tax takes effect.
toeic_zh: 新稅制生效後，價格將會相應調整。

en: also; used to add more information
toeic: Additionally, all participants will receive a free gift.
toeic_zh: 此外，所有參加者都會收到一份免費贈品。

en: at a later time
simple: We ate and went home afterward.
simple_zh: 我們吃完飯後就回家了。
toeic: Please submit the form, and we will call you afterward.
toeic_zh: 請提交表格，我們之後會致電給您。

en: an official representing a country or brand
toeic: She was named brand ambassador for our new product line.
toeic_zh: 她被任命為我們新產品系列的品牌代言人。

en: again in a new way
toeic: After the merger, the team had to begin anew.
toeic_zh: 合併後，團隊必須重新開始。

en: in any case; anyway
simple: It rained, but we went anyhow.
simple_zh: 下雨了，但我們還是去了。
toeic: The meeting may run late, but we will finish anyhow.
toeic_zh: 會議可能會延遲，但無論如何我們都會完成。

en: relevant or suitable; can be applied
simple: Applicable rules are enforced during meetings.
simple_zh: 在會議期間執行了適用的規則。
toeic: Applicable standards ensure consistent quality.
toeic_zh: 適用的標準確保了一致的質量。

en: one part or feature of something
simple: This is a good aspect of the job.
simple_zh: 這是這份工作好的一面。
toeic: We reviewed every aspect of the new project plan.
toeic_zh: 我們檢視了新專案計畫的每個層面。

en: a task or piece of work allocated to someone
simple: The assignment requires completing a detailed report.
simple_zh: 這項任務要求完成詳細報告。
toeic: Team members received their assignments at the beginning of the project.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員在項目開始時收到了他們的任務分配。

en: a person who provides a service to others
simple: The attendant will help check everyone in.
simple_zh: 服務員將幫助所有人簽到。
toeic: Flight attendants will assist passengers during the conference trip.
toeic_zh: 空乘人員將在會議旅行期間協助乘客。

en: a person who is present at an event
simple: Every attendee must sign the attendance sheet.
simple_zh: 每位參加者都必須簽到。
toeic: The attendees received a welcome package upon arrival.
toeic_zh: 參加者在到達時收到歡迎禮包。

en: a large room for dances and events
toeic: The annual dinner will be held in the hotel ballroom.
toeic_zh: 年度晚宴將在飯店宴會廳舉行。

en: a large formal meal for many people
simple: We went to a wedding banquet.
toeic: The company will host a banquet for retiring employees.
toeic_zh: 公司將為退休員工舉辦一場宴會。

en: earlier than a particular time
toeic: Please let us know beforehand if you need a special meal.
toeic_zh: 如果您需要特殊餐點，請事先告知我們。

en: favorable or promoting wellbeing
simple_zh: 會議後實施了有益的變更。
toeic: Beneficial partnerships enhance business growth.
toeic_zh: 有益的伙伴關係促進了業務增長。

en: A room where company directors hold meetings.
simple: The boss is in the boardroom.
simple_zh: 老闆在董事會會議室裡。
toeic: The quarterly review will take place in the boardroom at ten.
toeic_zh: 季度檢討將於十點在董事會會議室舉行。

en: A small, thin book with a paper cover.
simple: I got a booklet at the museum.
simple_zh: 我在博物館拿到一本小冊子。
toeic: Each participant will receive a booklet with the workshop schedule.
toeic_zh: 每位參加者都會收到一本附有工作坊日程的小冊子。

en: To share many ideas quickly in a group.
simple_zh: 我們每週五腦力激盪想點子。
toeic: The team will brainstorm solutions during the afternoon workshop.
toeic_zh: 團隊將在下午的工作坊中腦力激盪尋找解決方案。

en: A meal where guests serve themselves from a table.
toeic: A buffet lunch will be provided for all conference attendees.
toeic_zh: 所有會議出席者將享用自助午餐。

en: A chart showing the days, weeks and months of a year.
simple_zh: 看一下日曆上的星期五。
toeic: Please add the meeting to the shared calendar.
toeic_zh: 請把會議加到共用行事曆上。

en: To provide food and drinks, or meet particular needs.
simple_zh: 他們承辦大型派對的餐飲。
toeic: Our company will cater the awards dinner next Friday.
toeic_zh: 我們公司將承辦下週五的頒獎晚宴餐飲。

en: A person or company that provides food for events.
simple_zh: 外燴業者把食物送來了。
toeic: We hired a caterer for the product launch event.
toeic_zh: 我們為產品發表會聘請了一家外燴業者。

en: The person who leads a meeting or committee.
toeic: The chairperson will announce the results of the vote.
toeic_zh: 主席將宣布投票結果。

en: To hit your hands together to show you like something.
toeic: The audience stood up to clap for the speaker.
toeic_zh: 觀眾起立為講者鼓掌。

en: closely packed together; occupying little space
simple: The compact meeting room fits ten people.
simple_zh: 緊湊的會議室可容納10人。
toeic: A compact schedule maximizes productivity.
toeic_zh: 緊湊的日程最大化了生產力。

en: Following one after another without a break.
simple: It rained for three consecutive days.
toeic: Sales rose for the fourth consecutive quarter.
toeic_zh: 銷售額連續第四季成長。

en: to say the opposite of or disagree with
simple: Please do not contradict your boss.
toeic: The new data seems to contradict the earlier findings.
toeic_zh: 新數據似乎與先前的研究結果相矛盾。

en: completely different or opposite
toeic: Contrary to expectations, the new product sold poorly.
toeic_zh: 與預期相反，新產品賣得不好。

en: to work together with others
toeic: All departments must cooperate to finish the project on schedule.
toeic_zh: 所有部門必須合作，才能如期完成專案。

en: a person who organizes the activities of different people
simple: The project coordinator manages all team communications.
simple_zh: 項目協調員管理所有團隊溝通。
toeic: Contact the event coordinator to arrange the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 聯繫活動協調員安排會議室。

en: clear and certain
toeic: We have not set a definite date for the product launch yet.
toeic_zh: 我們尚未確定產品上市的日期。

en: a doctor who treats teeth
toeic: I need to reschedule my appointment with the dentist.
toeic_zh: 我需要重新安排與牙醫的預約。

en: to leave a place, especially on a trip
toeic: Flight 208 will depart from Gate 12 at nine o'clock.
toeic_zh: 208 號班機將於九點從十二號登機門出發。

en: relating to one department of an organization
toeic: The departmental budget must be approved by the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 部門預算必須在月底前核准。

en: to choose someone or something for a purpose
simple: We designate one person to lead.
toeic: The manager will designate a representative to attend the conference.
toeic_zh: 經理將指派一名代表出席研討會。

en: lack of consensus or a difference of opinion
simple: There was disagreement about the sales strategy.
simple_zh: 對於銷售策略有意見不合。
toeic: The disagreement between departments delayed the project decision.
toeic_zh: 部門之間的意見不合延遲了項目決定。

en: to take attention away from something
toeic: Please silence your phone so it does not distract other attendees.
toeic_zh: 請將手機靜音，以免讓其他與會者分心。

en: something that takes your attention away
toeic: Turn off the television to avoid any distraction during the meeting.
toeic_zh: 請關掉電視，以免會議中分心。

en: the length of time that something continues
simple: The duration of the meeting is two hours.
simple_zh: 會議的持續時間是兩小時。
toeic: The project duration has been extended by three months.
toeic_zh: 項目持續時間已延長三個月。

en: a person who studies the economy
simple_zh: 那位經濟學家在電視上發言。
toeic: An economist predicts that interest rates will rise next year.
toeic_zh: 一位經濟學家預測明年利率將上升。

en: in a way that shows strong interest
toeic: The audience responded enthusiastically to the presentation.
toeic_zh: 觀眾對簡報反應熱烈。

en: to go with someone to guide or protect them
simple: A guard will escort you out.
toeic: A staff member will escort visitors to the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 一位員工會陪同訪客前往會議室。

en: clearly visible or understood
simple: It was evident that the meeting was successful.
toeic: The need for change was evident from the data.
toeic_zh: 從數據中可以看出需要變革。

en: in an official or serious way
simple: He was formally introduced to us.
toeic: The merger will be formally announced next Monday.
toeic_zh: 這次合併將於下週一正式宣布。

en: a meeting or medium for discussion of topics of interest
simple: The online forum allows participants to ask questions anytime.
simple_zh: 在線論壇允許參與者隨時提問。
toeic: Join the international forum to share best practices.
toeic_zh: 加入國際論壇以分享最佳實踐。

en: a person who starts a company or group
simple: The founder of the shop is here.
simple_zh: 這家店的創辦人在這裡。
toeic: The founder of the company will give the opening speech.
toeic_zh: 公司創辦人將發表開幕演說。

en: school work students do at home
simple: I finish my homework at night.
toeic: Do your homework on the client before attending the meeting.
toeic_zh: 在參加會議前，請先針對客戶做好功課。

en: wanting to eat food
toeic: If you are hungry, there are snacks in the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 如果您餓了，會議室裡有點心。

en: not reasonable or sensible
toeic: The manager felt the proposed schedule was illogical and too tight.
toeic_zh: 經理認為所提議的時程不合理，而且太緊。

en: including all types or categories
simple: An inclusive meeting welcomes all opinions.
simple_zh: 包容的會議歡迎所有意見。
toeic: Inclusive practices ensure diverse participation.
toeic_zh: 包容的做法確保了多樣化的參與。

en: separately, one at a time
simple_zh: 每個玩具都是個別包裝的。
toeic: The manager will meet with each team member individually.
toeic_zh: 經理將與每位團隊成員單獨會面。

en: to decide something is true from the facts
simple: I infer that he is tired.
toeic: From the report, we can infer that sales will fall next quarter.
toeic_zh: 從報告中，我們可以推斷下一季銷售額將下滑。

en: a conclusion based on facts
toeic: The inference drawn from the survey was that customers want lower prices.
toeic_zh: 從調查得出的推論是顧客想要更低的價格。

en: relaxed and not official
simple_zh: 我們進行了一次非正式談話。
toeic: The company will hold an informal gathering after the seminar.
toeic_zh: 公司將在研討會後舉辦一場非正式聚會。

en: with full attention
toeic: The audience listened intently to the CEO's speech.
toeic_zh: 聽眾專注地聆聽執行長的演說。

en: a person who translates speech into another language
toeic: The company hired an interpreter for the meeting with the Japanese clients.
toeic_zh: 公司為與日本客戶的會議聘請了一位口譯員。

en: to stop someone while they are speaking or working
toeic: Sorry to interrupt, but your client is waiting on line two.
toeic_zh: 抱歉打斷一下，您的客戶正在二線等候。

en: not connected to the subject
toeic: Please remove any irrelevant details from your report.
toeic_zh: 請刪除報告中任何無關的細節。

en: A person who gives talks or teaches at a university
toeic: The guest lecturer will talk about marketing trends.
toeic_zh: 客座講師將談論行銷趨勢。

en: Very long, often too long
simple: The meeting was lengthy and boring.
toeic: Please avoid lengthy explanations in your report.
toeic_zh: 請避免在報告中使用冗長的說明。

en: capable of reasoning correctly
simple: The logical flow of the presentation was easy to follow.
simple_zh: 演示的邏輯流程很容易跟進。
toeic: A logical conclusion was reached after careful analysis.
toeic_zh: 經過仔細分析後得出了合理的結論。

en: A formal lunch event
simple: We will attend a luncheon on Friday.
simple_zh: 我們星期五要參加一場午宴。
toeic: The annual awards luncheon will be held at the Grand Hotel.
toeic_zh: 年度頒獎午宴將在大飯店舉行。

en: The time between two events
simple: In the meantime, please take a seat.
toeic: The new system arrives next week; in the meantime, use the old one.
toeic_zh: 新系統下週到貨；在此期間請使用舊系統。

en: Twelve o'clock in the daytime
toeic: The meeting will begin promptly at noon.
toeic_zh: 會議將在正午準時開始。

en: Used to say the exact hour
simple: The class starts at nine o'clock.
toeic: The shuttle bus leaves the hotel at eight o'clock.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士八點從旅館出發。

en: In a formal and approved way
toeic: The new policy will officially take effect on July 1.
toeic_zh: 新政策將於7月1日正式生效。

en: continuing to develop or happen
simple: Ongoing discussions will continue after the meeting.
toeic: Ongoing projects require regular status update meetings.
toeic_zh: 進行中的項目需要定期狀態更新會議。

en: A large group of musicians
toeic: The city orchestra will perform at the grand opening.
toeic_zh: 市立管弦樂團將在開幕典禮上演出。

en: a person who arranges and plans an event or activity
simple: The organizer prepared everything for the conference.
simple_zh: 組織者為會議準備了一切。
toeic: Contact the event organizer for any questions about registration.
toeic_zh: 有任何關於註冊的問題，請聯繫活動組織者。

en: what is expected to happen in the future
toeic: The economic outlook for next year is positive.
toeic_zh: 明年的經濟前景樂觀。

en: a short general description of something
simple: Here is an overview of the plan.
toeic: The presentation begins with an overview of our sales results.
toeic_zh: 簡報一開始先概述我們的銷售成果。

en: a block of paper for writing notes
simple: I need a pad and a pen.
simple_zh: 我需要一本便條本和一支筆。
toeic: Please leave a notepad and pad of paper on each desk.
toeic_zh: 請在每張桌上放一本便條本。

en: a person who entertains an audience
toeic: Each performer will have thirty minutes on the main stage.
toeic_zh: 每位表演者在主舞台有三十分鐘。

en: a person or book that organizes plans
simple: I write it in my planner.
simple_zh: 我把它寫在我的行事曆上。
toeic: The event planner booked the hall for the conference.
toeic_zh: 活動企劃人員為研討會預訂了會場。

en: to come before something
toeic: A short speech will precede the awards ceremony.
toeic_zh: 頒獎典禮之前會有一段簡短致詞。

en: coming before the main part
toeic: The preliminary results will be announced on Friday.
toeic_zh: 初步結果將於週五公布。

en: a person who presents or introduces a show or program
simple: The presenter explained the new product features clearly.
simple_zh: 主講人清楚地解釋了新產品的功能。
toeic: Our top presenter will lead tomorrow's training session.
toeic_zh: 我們的頂級主講人將主持明天的培訓課程。

en: likely to happen or be true
toeic: It is probable that the shipment will arrive late.
toeic_zh: 貨物很可能會延遲抵達。

en: producing much fruit or vegetation; creative
simple: The meeting was very productive and informative.
simple_zh: 會議非常有成效且內容豐富。
toeic: Productive discussions led to actionable solutions.
toeic_zh: 富有成效的討論導致了可行的解決方案。

en: quickly or exactly on time
toeic: The meeting will start promptly at nine o'clock.
toeic_zh: 會議將於九點整準時開始。

en: arriving or doing something at the expected time
simple: Punctual arrival is expected at all meetings.
simple_zh: 所有會議都期望守時到達。
toeic: Punctual presentation of reports is required.
toeic_zh: 需要準時提交報告。

en: sensible and based on what is possible
toeic: We need to set a realistic deadline for the project.
toeic_zh: 我們需要為這個專案訂定切合實際的期限。

en: to change the order or position of things
toeic: We had to rearrange the meeting because the manager was ill.
toeic_zh: 由於經理生病，我們必須重新安排會議。

en: to think again about a decision
toeic: We urge the board to reconsider the proposed budget cuts.
toeic_zh: 我們敦促董事會重新考慮擬議的預算削減。

en: food and drink served at an event
simple: We had refreshment after the show.
simple_zh: 表演後我們享用了茶點。
toeic: Light refreshment will be served after the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報結束後將提供簡單的茶點。

en: a practice before a performance or event
toeic: The final rehearsal for the awards ceremony is on Thursday.
toeic_zh: 頒獎典禮的最後彩排在週四。

en: to practice before a performance
toeic: You should rehearse your speech before the big meeting.
toeic_zh: 你應該在大型會議前預演你的演講。

en: to arrange something for a different time
simple: Can we reschedule the meeting to next Monday?
simple_zh: 我們能把會議改期到下週一嗎？
toeic: The client requested to reschedule the presentation due to prior commitments.
toeic_zh: 由於先前的承諾，客戶要求重新安排演示。

en: a quiet place or trip away from work
simple_zh: 我們去參加了靜修活動。
toeic: The company holds an annual retreat for its senior managers.
toeic_zh: 公司每年為資深經理舉辦一次研修營。

en: a meeting of people after a long time
toeic: The class reunion will be held at a hotel downtown.
toeic_zh: 同學會將在市中心的一家飯店舉行。

en: a change made to improve a text or plan
simple: I made one revision to the letter.
simple_zh: 我對這封信做了一處修改。
toeic: Please send the final revision of the contract by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前寄出合約的最終修訂版。

en: two slices of bread with food between
simple: I eat a sandwich for lunch.
toeic: The caterer will deliver sandwiches to the meeting room at noon.
toeic_zh: 外燴業者中午會把三明治送到會議室。

en: a meeting for discussion or training on a particular topic
simple: The HR department organized a seminar on workplace safety.
simple_zh: 人力資源部組織了一場關於工作場所安全的研討班。
toeic: Employees attended a professional development seminar last week.
toeic_zh: 員工上週參加了專業發展研討班。

en: To make something shorter in time or length.
toeic: We need to shorten the meeting to thirty minutes.
toeic_zh: 我們需要把會議縮短為三十分鐘。

en: in a very short time
toeic: Our manager will join the meeting shortly.
toeic_zh: 我們經理很快就會加入會議。

en: to read quickly without careful attention
simple: I skim the news every morning.
toeic: Please skim the report before the meeting begins.
toeic_zh: 請在會議開始前先瀏覽這份報告。

en: a narrow opening or a time period
simple: Put the card in the slot.
toeic: We have an open time slot on Tuesday afternoon.
toeic_zh: 我們週二下午有一個空檔時段。

en: at an unknown time in the future
simple: I want to visit Japan someday.
toeic: We hope to open a branch in Paris someday.
toeic_zh: 我們希望有一天能在巴黎開一家分公司。

en: at a time that is not known or fixed
toeic: The manager will visit our office sometime next month.
toeic_zh: 經理下個月某個時候會來我們辦公室。

en: an action or strategy carefully planned to achieve an end
simple: The sales team used different tactics to close deals.
simple_zh: 銷售團隊使用不同的戰術來成交。
toeic: Negotiation tactics were discussed in the training session.
toeic_zh: 談判戰術在培訓課程中進行了討論。

en: done in a careful and complete manner
simple: Thorough review of proposals is required.
simple_zh: 需要對提案進行徹底審查。
toeic: Thorough preparation ensures meeting success.
toeic_zh: 周密的準備確保會議成功。

en: occurring at or done at an opportune or useful moment
simple: Timely information delivery is essential for good decisions.
simple_zh: 及時的信息傳遞對做出好決定至關重要。
toeic: Timely notification of changes prevents confusion.
toeic_zh: 及時通知變更可防止混亂。

en: a list of times when things happen
toeic: The timetable shows that the next train leaves at noon.
toeic_zh: 時刻表顯示下一班火車中午發車。

en: Not able to be used, bought, or met.
toeic: The item you requested is currently unavailable in our warehouse.
toeic_zh: 您訂購的商品目前倉庫缺貨。

en: To draw a line under words.
toeic: Underline the key figures in the report before the meeting.
toeic_zh: 開會前請在報告中的關鍵數字下劃線。

en: Not real; hard to believe.
toeic: The sales forecast seems unreal given current market conditions.
toeic_zh: 以目前的市場狀況來看，這個銷售預測似乎不切實際。

en: Going to happen soon.
toeic: Please review the agenda for the upcoming board meeting.
toeic_zh: 請檢視即將舉行的董事會議議程。

en: A meeting held by video over the internet.
simple: We have a videoconference at ten.
toeic: The team will join the videoconference from three different cities.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員將從三個不同城市加入視訊會議。

en: Any day from Monday to Friday.
toeic: The library is open from nine to six on every weekday.
toeic_zh: 圖書館平日每天九點到六點開放。

en: Any person who.
simple: Whoever comes first gets a seat.
toeic: Whoever finishes the report first should send it to the manager.
toeic_zh: 無論誰先完成報告，都應寄給經理。

en: a meeting at which a group of people engages in intensive discussion or training
simple: The software workshop teaches advanced coding techniques.
simple_zh: 軟件工作坊教授高級編碼技術。
toeic: Our company hosts quarterly workshops for skills development.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司每季度舉辦技能發展工作坊。

en: Good enough to deserve the time or money spent.
toeic: Attending the trade show proved worthwhile for our sales team.
toeic_zh: 參加貿易展對我們的業務團隊來說很值得。

en: Happening once every year.
toeic: Our yearly sales meeting will be held in Tokyo this time.
toeic_zh: 我們的年度業務會議這次將在東京舉行。

en: relating to all the members of a group together
simple: Collective decisions were made through voting.
simple_zh: 通過投票做出了集體決定。
toeic: The collective input shaped the final strategy.
toeic_zh: 集體意見塑造了最終戰略。

en: general agreement among group members
simple: We reached a consensus on the project timeline.
simple_zh: 我們就項目時間表達成了共識。
toeic: The team worked to build consensus before implementing changes.
toeic_zh: 團隊在實施變更前努力建立共識。

en: prolonged public disagreement or heated debate
simple: The controversy over the new policy divided the team.
simple_zh: 關於新政策的爭議分裂了團隊。
toeic: The project faced controversy regarding its environmental impact.
toeic_zh: 該項目因其環境影響而面臨爭議。

en: relating to cooperation between parties
simple: Cooperative participants made the meeting run smoothly.
simple_zh: 樂於配合的參與者使會議順利進行。
toeic: A cooperative spirit is essential for project success.
toeic_zh: 合作精神對項目成功至關重要。

en: To delay something until a later time.
simple: Let's defer the decision until Monday.
simple_zh: 我們把決定延到週一吧。
toeic: The committee decided to defer the vote until the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 委員會決定把表決延到下次會議。

en: not supporting either side in a conflict
simple: A neutral position is maintained during disputes.
simple_zh: 在爭議中保持中立立場。
toeic: Neutral ground provides a safe space for negotiations.
toeic_zh: 中立的地點為談判提供了安全的空間。

en: an expression of disagreement or disapproval
simple: No objections were raised during the meeting.
toeic: The manager addressed the team's objections to the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理解決了團隊對新政策的異議。

en: To cover part of the same time or area.
toeic: The sales meeting may overlap with the training session.
toeic_zh: 業務會議可能與培訓課程時間重疊。

en: based on reason or logic
simple: A rational decision was made after considering all options.
simple_zh: 在考慮所有選項後做出了合理的決定。
toeic: The rational basis for the decision was explained clearly.
toeic_zh: 決定的理性基礎得到了明確解釋。

en: lower in rank or position
simple: Subordinate staff attended the department meeting.
simple_zh: 下屬人員參加了部門會議。
toeic: Subordinate details were handled by the committee.
toeic_zh: 委員會處理了從屬細節。

en: a meeting of heads of state or senior officials
simple: The international summit brought together world leaders.
simple_zh: 國際峰會聚集了世界領導人。
toeic: The annual business summit showcases innovation and industry trends.
toeic_zh: 年度商業峰會展示創新和行業趨勢。

en: done in a methodical and organized way
simple: A systematic approach prevents overlooking important topics.
simple_zh: 系統的方法可以防止遺漏重要主題。
toeic: Systematic review of all proposals was completed.
toeic_zh: 對所有提案的系統審查已完成。

en: open and clear, easy to perceive or understand
simple: Transparent communication builds trust in meetings.
simple_zh: 透明的溝通在會議中建立信任。
toeic: The company maintains transparent reporting to stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 公司對利益相關者保持透明報告。

en: not physically existing but made to appear by software
simple: Virtual meetings save travel time and costs.
simple_zh: 虛擬會議節省旅行時間和成本。
toeic: The company held a virtual conference with 5,000 participants.
toeic_zh: 公司舉行了一次有5000名參與者的虛擬會議。

en: A large public meeting to support a cause.
toeic: The sales rally boosted team morale before the product launch.
toeic_zh: 在產品上市前，業務大會提振了團隊士氣。

en: Ready to face danger or difficulty.
toeic: It was brave of her to speak up during the meeting.
toeic_zh: 她在會議中勇敢發言，真有膽量。

en: the chance that something will happen
toeic: The odds of winning this contract are quite high.
toeic_zh: 贏得這份合約的機率相當高。

en: spoken, not written
toeic: An oral agreement is not enough; please sign the contract.
toeic_zh: 口頭協議是不夠的，請簽署合約。

en: a group joining together for a goal
toeic: A coalition of retailers asked for new trade rules.
toeic_zh: 一個零售商聯盟要求制定新的貿易規則。

en: having a sharp, unpleasant taste or feeling
toeic: The negotiations ended in bitter disagreement.
toeic_zh: 談判在激烈的爭執中結束。

en: belonging to each person separately
simple: They went to their respective rooms.
simple_zh: 他們各自回到自己的房間。
toeic: Team members will present their respective reports on Friday.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員將在週五報告各自的報告。

en: a possible situation or series of events
toeic: In the worst-case scenario, we would delay the launch.
toeic_zh: 在最糟的情況下，我們會延後上市。

en: relating to a colony or its ruling country
simple: The hotel is a colonial building.
simple_zh: 這家飯店是殖民時期建築。
toeic: Our colonial style inn attracts many tourists.
toeic_zh: 我們的殖民風格旅店吸引許多觀光客。

en: at the same time
toeic: Both lines can run simultaneously without slowing down.
toeic_zh: 兩條生產線可以同時運作而不會變慢。

en: a book where you write daily events
simple: I write in my diary every night.
toeic: She wrote the meeting time in her diary.
toeic_zh: 她把會議時間記在她的記事簿裡。

en: very impressive and exciting to see
toeic: The resort offers spectacular views of the ocean.
toeic_zh: 這座度假村可欣賞壯觀的海景。

en: a position or opinion on an issue
simple: What is your stance on this?
simple_zh: 你對這件事的立場是什麼？
toeic: The firm took a firm stance against late payments.
toeic_zh: 公司對延遲付款採取強硬立場。

en: a sound heard again after it hits a surface
simple: I heard an echo in the hall.
toeic: The large meeting room has an echo that makes it hard to hear.
toeic_zh: 這間大會議室有回音，讓人很難聽清楚。

en: in spite of that; however
simple: It rained; nonetheless, we went out.
simple_zh: 下雨了，儘管如此我們還是出門了。
toeic: The price is high; nonetheless, the product sells well.
toeic_zh: 價格雖高，但這項產品仍然賣得很好。

en: used to introduce more exact details
simple: I like two fruits, namely apples and pears.
simple_zh: 我喜歡兩種水果，即蘋果和梨子。
toeic: We need two things, namely a budget and a schedule.
toeic_zh: 我們需要兩樣東西，也就是預算和時程表。

en: to run or go somewhere very quickly
simple: I must dash to the station.
toeic: We had to dash to the airport to catch our flight.
toeic_zh: 我們得趕緊衝去機場搭乘班機。

en: great size or importance
simple: The magnitude of the problem is big.
simple_zh: 這個問題的嚴重程度很大。
toeic: Managers underestimated the magnitude of the budget shortfall.
toeic_zh: 經理們低估了預算短缺的嚴重程度。

en: not sure or not decided
simple: I am uncertain about the date.
toeic: The economic outlook remains uncertain for exporters.
toeic_zh: 對出口商而言，經濟前景依然不明朗。

en: a fight or strong disagreement; a conflict
simple: There was a clash of ideas.
toeic: A schedule clash forced us to move the meeting.
toeic_zh: 行程衝突讓我們必須更改會議時間。

en: related to the plans used to reach a goal
toeic: The team made a tactical decision to delay the product launch.
toeic_zh: 團隊做出了延後產品上市的策略性決定。

en: in a way related to people and society
toeic: The firm wants to be socially responsible in all its operations.
toeic_zh: 該公司希望在所有營運中善盡社會責任。

en: the act of joining together; a joining word
toeic: The event was held in conjunction with the trade fair.
toeic_zh: 這項活動與商展同時舉辦。

en: the chance that something will happen
simple: There is a high likelihood of rain.
toeic: There is a strong likelihood that prices will rise next quarter.
toeic_zh: 下一季物價很可能會上漲。

en: a person who watches or notices things
toeic: Industry observers expect the merger to be approved soon.
toeic_zh: 業界觀察人士預期這項合併很快會獲批准。

en: power or influence to get a result
simple_zh: 我們的規模給了我們影響力。
toeic: The firm used its market leverage to negotiate better prices.
toeic_zh: 該公司運用其市場影響力談到更好的價格。

en: Coming one after another
toeic: The company reported profits for five successive quarters.
toeic_zh: 公司連續五季獲利。

en: Completely or openly
toeic: The board rejected the proposal outright.
toeic_zh: 董事會當場完全否決了該提案。

en: In a general way; widely
toeic: Broadly speaking, sales have improved since the launch.
toeic_zh: 大致來說，產品上市後銷售已有改善。

en: The state of being completely sure
toeic: There is no certainty that the deal will be approved.
toeic_zh: 無法確定這筆交易會獲得批准。

en: Together as a group
toeic: The directors collectively approved the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事們共同批准了這項合併。

en: Done on purpose or carefully planned
toeic: The delay was a deliberate move to avoid extra costs.
toeic_zh: 延後是為了避免額外成本而刻意採取的舉動。

en: To move slowly without control
toeic: Sales began to drift downward during the summer.
toeic_zh: 夏季期間銷售開始逐漸下滑。

en: To face a problem or person directly
simple_zh: 我們必須面對這個問題。
toeic: The manager decided to confront the issue at the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 經理決定在下次會議中正面處理這個問題。

en: Not connected to something
toeic: Please keep your comments unrelated to personal matters out of the meeting.
toeic_zh: 請不要在會議中提出與個人事務無關的意見。

en: A small group within a larger group
toeic: One faction of the board opposed the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事會中的一個派系反對合併。

en: To delay or stop making progress
toeic: Negotiations stalled over the price of the contract.
toeic_zh: 談判因合約價格而陷入停滯。

en: Helpful and meant to improve things
simple_zh: 她給了有建設性的建議。
toeic: The manager offered constructive feedback after the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報後經理提出了有建設性的意見回饋。

en: A period of time between two events
toeic: Please check the machine at regular intervals.
toeic_zh: 請定期檢查機器。

en: a legal document about owning property; an action
simple: He signed the deed for the house.
toeic: The deed must be notarized before the property can be transferred.
toeic_zh: 契據必須經過公證，財產才能過戶。

en: coming soon; about to happen or appear
simple: Our forthcoming trip is in May.
simple_zh: 我們即將到來的旅行在五月。
toeic: Details of the forthcoming product launch will be announced next week.
toeic_zh: 即將推出的產品發表會細節將於下週公布。

en: how closely something is connected to a topic
simple: This idea has no relevance to us.
toeic: Please explain the relevance of this data to our sales strategy.
toeic_zh: 請說明這些數據與我們銷售策略的關聯性。

en: a formal agreement between people or groups
simple: The two friends made a pact.
simple_zh: 兩位朋友訂了一個約定。
toeic: The two companies signed a pact to share research costs.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司簽署協議以分攤研究成本。

en: a person or thing that acts for another
simple: She voted by proxy for her father.
toeic: Shareholders who cannot attend may vote by proxy at the meeting.
toeic_zh: 無法出席的股東可在會議中委託代理投票。

en: settling a dispute using an independent judge
simple: The two sides went to arbitration.
toeic: The dispute will be resolved through arbitration rather than in court.
toeic_zh: 這項爭議將透過仲裁而非法庭來解決。

en: possible and likely to work
toeic: The team studied whether building a second factory was feasible.
toeic_zh: 團隊研究了興建第二間工廠是否可行。

en: managing relations between countries, or tactful skill
simple: Good diplomacy can stop a fight.
simple_zh: 良好的外交可以避免爭吵。
toeic: The negotiator used diplomacy to settle the trade dispute.
toeic_zh: 談判代表運用外交手腕化解貿易爭端。

en: a starting level used for comparison
toeic: We measured current performance to set a baseline for future goals.
toeic_zh: 我們衡量目前績效，作為未來目標的基準。

en: a person or thing with a similar role elsewhere
simple: I called my counterpart in Japan.
simple_zh: 我打給日本的對口窗口。
toeic: Our sales director met her counterpart from the partner company.
toeic_zh: 我們的業務總監與合作公司的對等主管會面。

en: a group of voters or supporters in an area
toeic: The senator met with her constituency to hear their concerns.
toeic_zh: 參議員與選區民眾會面，聆聽他們的關切。

en: an official who represents a country abroad
toeic: The diplomat attended the trade summit on behalf of the government.
toeic_zh: 該外交官代表政府出席貿易高峰會。

en: to think something is smaller or less than it is
toeic: We tend to underestimate the time needed to finish the renovation.
toeic_zh: 我們低估了完成整修所需的時間。

en: causing great damage or failure
simple_zh: 那場暴風雨造成了災難。
toeic: The product launch was disastrous because of serious software errors.
toeic_zh: 由於嚴重的軟體錯誤，這次產品發表以慘敗收場。

en: in a way that both sides share
simple: We agreed on a mutually good time.
simple_zh: 我們同意了對雙方都好的時間。
toeic: The two parties reached a mutually acceptable solution.
toeic_zh: 雙方達成了彼此都能接受的解決方案。

en: about to happen very soon
toeic: The merger announcement is imminent, according to company sources.
toeic_zh: 據公司消息人士透露，併購公告即將發布。

en: a lack of something needed
toeic: The audit revealed a deficiency in the safety procedures.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現安全程序有缺失。

en: to arrange things in a line or agree
toeic: We must align our goals with the company strategy.
toeic_zh: 我們必須讓目標與公司策略一致。

en: a strong statement that something is true
toeic: The report supports the manager's assertion that sales are rising.
toeic_zh: 報告支持經理關於銷售正在成長的主張。

en: to state something firmly as true
simple: I assert that I am right.
toeic: The director asserted that the project would finish on time.
toeic_zh: 主任斷言專案會準時完成。

en: a person hurt or killed in an accident
simple: There was one casualty in the crash.
toeic: The factory fire caused no casualty, but the damage was heavy.
toeic_zh: 工廠火災沒有造成人員傷亡，但損失慘重。

en: based on an imagined situation, not fact
toeic: Let's consider a hypothetical case of rising material costs.
toeic_zh: 我們來設想一個原料成本上漲的假設情況。

en: to begin
simple: The class will commence at nine.
toeic: Construction will commence next month.
toeic_zh: 工程將於下個月開始。

en: a sudden event causing great damage
simple_zh: 那場洪水是一場大災難。
toeic: The insurance covers losses caused by a natural catastrophe.
toeic_zh: 這份保險涵蓋天然災難造成的損失。

en: to compete; to argue that something is true
simple: Two teams contend for the prize.
toeic: Small firms must contend with large global competitors.
toeic_zh: 小公司必須與大型跨國對手競爭。

en: a change to the opposite direction or decision
simple: The team had a sudden reversal.
toeic: The court ordered a reversal of the earlier decision.
toeic_zh: 法院下令撤銷先前的決定。

en: to win or be most common
toeic: Low prices still prevail in the local market.
toeic_zh: 本地市場仍普遍維持低價。

en: to protect something from harm
simple: Lock the door to safeguard your bike.
simple_zh: 鎖上門來保護你的腳踏車。
toeic: We use passwords to safeguard customer data.
toeic_zh: 我們用密碼來保護客戶資料。

en: the negative part of something
simple: The downside is the high price.
toeic: The main downside of the plan is its cost.
toeic_zh: 這項計畫的主要缺點是成本。

en: the reasons behind a decision
simple: What is the rationale for this rule?
simple_zh: 這項規定的理由是什麼？
toeic: The manager explained the rationale behind the price increase.
toeic_zh: 經理說明了調漲價格背後的理由。

en: to get a result or reward from effort
simple: Farmers reap the corn in fall.
toeic: The company will reap the benefits of its new strategy.
toeic_zh: 公司將從新策略中獲益。

en: a state of great confusion or trouble
toeic: The market was in turmoil after the announcement.
toeic_zh: 公告發布後市場陷入動盪。

en: a group of companies working together
simple_zh: 一個財團買下了這棟大樓。
toeic: A syndicate of banks provided the loan.
toeic_zh: 一個銀行團提供了這筆貸款。

en: the act of agreeing to take something
simple: He wrote a letter of acceptance.
toeic: Please send your acceptance of the job offer by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前回覆您接受這份工作的意願。

en: something successfully achieved
simple: Finishing school was a big accomplishment.
simple_zh: 完成學業是很大的成就。
toeic: Her greatest accomplishment was doubling the annual sales.
toeic_zh: 她最大的成就是讓年度銷售額翻倍。

en: to make someone get used to something
simple: He must accustom himself to early mornings.
simple_zh: 他必須讓自己習慣早起。
toeic: New staff will accustom themselves to the system within a week.
toeic_zh: 新進員工會在一週內習慣這套系統。

en: in a way that involves energy and effort
toeic: We are actively looking for a new marketing manager.
toeic_zh: 我們正積極尋找新的行銷經理。

en: to manage or carry out something officially
toeic: The HR department will administer the employee survey.
toeic_zh: 人資部門將辦理員工問卷調查。

en: relating to running an organization
toeic: We are hiring an administrative assistant for the front desk.
toeic_zh: 我們正在為櫃檯招聘一名行政助理。

en: the process of moving forward in position or rank
toeic: Career advancement is achieved through consistent performance, skill development, and leadership demonstration.
toeic_zh: 職業進步通過持續績效、技能發展和領導力表現而實現。

en: a person who gives expert advice
simple: My advisor helped me choose a class.
simple_zh: 我的指導老師幫我選課。
toeic: The financial advisor recommended a new investment plan.
toeic_zh: 財務顧問建議了一項新的投資計畫。

en: having a strong wish to succeed
toeic: The company has set an ambitious goal for next year.
toeic_zh: 公司為明年設定了一個雄心勃勃的目標。

en: a person who asks for a job
simple: The applicant waits outside the office.
simple_zh: 應徵者在辦公室外等候。
toeic: Every applicant will be contacted within two weeks of the closing date.
toeic_zh: 每位應徵者都會在截止日後兩週內接獲通知。
family: apply (v); application (n); applicant (n); apply for a job 應徵工作

en: formal assessment of an employee's performance
toeic: The annual appraisal includes feedback on strengths and areas for improvement.
toeic_zh: 年度評估包括對優勢和改進領域的反饋。

en: worried that something bad may happen
simple: He felt apprehensive before the test.
toeic: Investors are apprehensive about the upcoming market changes.
toeic_zh: 投資人對即將到來的市場變動感到憂心。

en: a short test performance for a role
toeic: The audition for the commercial will be held on Monday.
toeic_zh: 廣告的試鏡將在週一舉行。

en: a person who is just starting to learn
simple: I am a beginner at golf.
toeic: The workshop is designed for beginners with no experience.
toeic_zh: 這個工作坊是為沒有經驗的初學者而設計的。

en: The scientific study of living things.
toeic: The university is hiring a new professor of biology.
toeic_zh: 這所大學正在招聘一位新的生物學教授。

en: additional payment given for good performance or special occasions
toeic: Performance bonuses are awarded quarterly to employees who exceed their targets.
toeic_zh: 績效獎金按季度授予超出目標的員工。

en: The grounds and buildings of a school or company.
toeic: Our company campus includes a gym and two cafeterias.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司園區內有一間健身房和兩間餐廳。

en: Relaxed and informal, not formal.
simple: I wear casual clothes on Fridays.
toeic: The company allows casual dress every Friday.
toeic_zh: 公司允許每週五穿著休閒服裝。

en: an official document proving someone has skills in a particular area
toeic: Industry certifications strengthen your resume and improve job prospects.
toeic_zh: 行業認證加強你的履歷並改善就業前景。

en: A medical examination to check your health.
toeic: All employees receive a free annual checkup.
toeic_zh: 所有員工每年都可享有免費健康檢查。

en: A professional cook, especially the head cook.
toeic: The hotel hired a new chef from Paris.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店從巴黎聘請了一位新主廚。

en: Lasting for a long time or happening again and again.
toeic: The company faces a chronic shortage of skilled workers.
toeic_zh: 公司長期面臨技術人員短缺。

en: A person who is in the same class as you.
simple: My classmate lent me a pen.
toeic: I met an old classmate at the trade show.
toeic_zh: 我在貿易展上遇到一位老同學。

en: A place where people see a doctor for treatment.
toeic: The company runs a small clinic for its employees.
toeic_zh: 公司為員工設有一間小診所。

en: The ability to understand something.
simple: Reading comprehension is hard for me.
simple_zh: 閱讀理解對我來說很難。
toeic: The test measures listening and reading comprehension.
toeic_zh: 這項測驗評量聽力與閱讀理解能力。

en: a person who gives advice or guidance
toeic: A career counselor will meet with each new graduate this week.
toeic_zh: 職涯顧問本週將與每位新鮮人面談。

en: a person you work with
toeic: I will ask a coworker to cover my shift on Friday.
toeic_zh: 我會請一位同事在週五代我的班。

en: ability to generate new and original ideas
toeic: Supporting employee creativity and experimentation leads to breakthrough solutions and improved processes.
toeic_zh: 支持員工創意和實驗導致突破性解決方案和改進的流程。

en: related to cooking or kitchens
simple: He studies at a culinary school.
toeic: The hotel is hiring a chef with strong culinary skills.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店正在招聘具有優秀廚藝的主廚。

en: hard work and loyalty to a goal
toeic: We thank Ms. Lin for her dedication to the company over twenty years.
toeic_zh: 我們感謝林女士二十年來對公司的奉獻。

en: an amount taken away from a total
simple: There is a deduction from my pay.
simple_zh: 我的薪水有一筆扣除額。
toeic: The tax deduction applies to all business travel expenses.
toeic_zh: 此稅額扣除適用於所有商務差旅費用。

en: related to teeth
toeic: The company provides dental insurance for all full-time employees.
toeic_zh: 公司為所有全職員工提供牙科保險。

en: the act of leaving a job or organization
toeic: Employee departure procedures include exit interviews and knowledge transfer to ensure continuity.
toeic_zh: 員工離職程序包括離職面試和知識轉移以確保連續性。

en: worth wanting or having
simple_zh: 這是一份令人嚮往的工作。
toeic: Experience in marketing is desirable but not required for this position.
toeic_zh: 具備行銷經驗為佳，但並非必要。

en: needing something very badly
toeic: The firm is desperate for skilled engineers this season.
toeic_zh: 公司本季迫切需要有技術的工程師。

en: an official paper showing you finished school
toeic: Applicants must have a high school diploma or equivalent.
toeic_zh: 應徵者須具備高中文憑或同等學歷。

zh: 干擾選項；使分心的事物
en: a wrong answer choice meant to mislead you
simple: Pick the best answer, not a distractor.
simple_zh: 選最佳答案，不要選干擾選項。
toeic: Each test question includes one correct answer and three distractors.
toeic_zh: 每道測驗題包含一個正確答案和三個干擾選項。

en: to reduce the number of employees in a company
simple: The shop will downsize this year.
toeic: The firm decided to downsize its sales department to cut costs.
toeic_zh: 公司決定縮編業務部門以降低成本。

en: wanting very much to do or have something
simple: She is eager to learn English.
toeic: We are eager to start working with your team.
toeic_zh: 我們很期待與貴團隊合作。

en: the degree to which something succeeds in producing results
toeic: The effectiveness of training programs is measured through employee performance improvements.
toeic_zh: 培訓計畫的有效性通過員工績效改進來衡量。

en: allowed to do or get something because you meet the rules
simple: You are eligible for this prize.
toeic: Staff who have worked here for a year are eligible for paid leave.
toeic_zh: 在此工作滿一年的員工可享有帶薪假。
family: eligibility (n); be eligible for 有……的資格; ineligible (adj)

en: full of energy and ready to be active
toeic: We are looking for an energetic person to join our sales team.
toeic_zh: 我們正在找一位精力充沛的人加入業務團隊。

en: the degree of enthusiasm and commitment to a job
toeic: High employee engagement correlates with better performance, retention, and customer satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 高員工參與與更好的績效、保留和客戶滿意度相關聯。

en: to officially join a course or school
simple: I will enroll in a class.
toeic: Employees may enroll in the training course online.
toeic_zh: 員工可以在線上報名參加訓練課程。

en: the act of joining a course, or the number joined
toeic: Enrollment for the workshop closes at the end of this week.
toeic_zh: 工作坊的報名將於本週末截止。

en: strong interest and excitement about something
simple: He shows great enthusiasm for work.
toeic: Her enthusiasm for the project inspired the whole team.
toeic_zh: 她對這項專案的熱忱激勵了整個團隊。

en: principles of right and wrong behavior
toeic: Company ethics standards require employees to maintain professional integrity and confidentiality.
toeic_zh: 公司倫理標準要求員工保持專業誠信和保密性。

en: state of being extremely good or outstanding
toeic: Pursuing excellence requires continuous improvement, high standards, and commitment to quality in all work.
toeic_zh: 追求卓越需要持續改進、高標準和對所有工作質量的承諾。

en: expert skill or knowledge in a particular area
simple_zh: 她具有寶貴的專業知識。
toeic: Industry expertise is highly valued in senior positions and specialized technical roles.
toeic_zh: 行業專業知識在高級職位和專業技術職位中受到高度重視。

en: teachers at a school, or a school department
toeic: The faculty will host a seminar for local business owners.
toeic_zh: 教職員將為當地企業主舉辦研討會。

en: good knowledge of something
simple: He has familiarity with the system.
toeic: Familiarity with spreadsheet software is required for this position.
toeic_zh: 這個職位要求熟悉試算表軟體。

en: to learn about something until you know it well
simple: Please familiarize yourself with the rules.
toeic: New employees should familiarize themselves with the safety procedures.
toeic_zh: 新進員工應熟悉安全程序。

en: the act of saying goodbye
toeic: The staff held a farewell luncheon for the retiring manager.
toeic_zh: 員工為即將退休的經理舉辦了歡送午餐會。

en: a system where workers choose their own hours
toeic: The company introduced flextime to help employees balance work and family.
toeic_zh: 公司引進彈性工時，協助員工兼顧工作與家庭。

en: able to speak a language easily and well
toeic: The position requires someone fluent in both English and Japanese.
toeic_zh: 此職位需要英語與日語都流利的人。

en: to help something develop over time
simple: Teachers foster a love of reading.
toeic: The manager works to foster teamwork in the department.
toeic_zh: 經理致力於在部門內培養團隊合作。

en: working for different companies, not one employer
simple_zh: 他做自由接案的設計工作。
toeic: We hired a freelance writer to update the company handbook.
toeic_zh: 我們聘請了一位自由撰稿人來更新公司手冊。

en: finishing school, or the ceremony for it
toeic: Many companies hire new staff soon after graduation.
toeic_zh: 許多公司在畢業後不久就會僱用新員工。

en: advice or information about what should be done
toeic: Career guidance from senior leaders helps employees navigate organizational structures and plan advancement.
toeic_zh: 來自資深領導者的職業指導幫助員工導航組織結構並規劃進步。

en: done regularly as a habit
simple: He is a habitual late comer.
toeic: Habitual lateness may result in disciplinary action by the company.
toeic_zh: 習慣性遲到可能導致公司給予處分。

en: a small book of rules or instructions
simple: Read the handbook on your first day.
toeic: New employees will receive an employee handbook at orientation.
toeic_zh: 新進員工將在新人訓練時收到員工手冊。

en: working with energy and effort
toeic: We are seeking a hardworking and reliable assistant manager.
toeic_zh: 我們正在尋找勤奮可靠的副理。

en: services for treating and preventing illness
simple_zh: 醫療保健福利包括在內。
toeic: Comprehensive healthcare benefits include dental, vision, and prescription medication coverage.
toeic_zh: 全面的醫療保健福利包括牙科、眼科和處方藥物保險。

en: happening or paid every hour
toeic: The hourly wage for this part-time position is fifteen dollars.
toeic_zh: 這份兼職的時薪是十五美元。

en: in the best possible situation
toeic: Ideally, the candidate should have three years of sales experience.
toeic_zh: 理想上，應徵者應具備三年銷售經驗。

en: not suitable for a situation
simple: That shirt is inappropriate for work.
simple_zh: 那件襯衫不適合穿去上班。
toeic: Inappropriate use of company e-mail may lead to dismissal.
toeic_zh: 不當使用公司電子郵件可能導致解僱。

en: not finished or missing parts
toeic: Incomplete application forms will not be processed.
toeic_zh: 填寫不完整的申請表將不予處理。

en: process of introducing new employees to the company
simple: The induction process helps employees adjust.
simple_zh: 入職過程幫助員工適應。
toeic: A comprehensive induction program includes company history, culture, and workplace safety.
toeic_zh: 全面的入職計畫包括公司歷史、文化和工作場所安全。

en: lack of knowledge or practice
toeic: Her inexperience did not stop her from leading the project well.
toeic_zh: 缺乏經驗並未妨礙她把專案領導得很好。

en: to teach or tell someone what to do
toeic: The manager will instruct new staff on how to use the system.
toeic_zh: 經理將指導新進員工如何使用系統。

en: a person who teaches a skill
toeic: The instructor will lead the training session on Tuesday morning.
toeic_zh: 講師將於星期二早上主持訓練課程。

en: a student or new worker who learns a job for a short time
simple: The intern makes coffee for us.
toeic: Our intern will help the team with data entry this summer.
toeic_zh: 我們的實習生今年夏天會協助團隊進行資料輸入。
family: internship (n) 實習; summer intern 暑期實習生; intern (v) 實習

en: a short job to gain work experience
toeic: The firm offers a three-month internship to university students.
toeic_zh: 公司提供大學生為期三個月的實習機會。

en: given at the start to introduce something
toeic: We are offering an introductory price for new members this month.
toeic_zh: 本月我們為新會員提供優惠的入門價。

en: Lower in rank or less experienced
simple: He is a junior member of the team.
simple_zh: 他是團隊裡的資淺成員。
toeic: A junior accountant will assist the finance director.
toeic_zh: 一名初級會計師將協助財務主管。

en: The act of ending jobs because of lack of work
simple: The layoff made many workers sad.
simple_zh: 裁員讓許多工人很難過。
toeic: The company announced a layoff of two hundred employees.
toeic_zh: 公司宣布裁員兩百名員工。

en: Related to the work of a manager
toeic: The position requires strong managerial skills.
toeic_zh: 這個職位需要很強的管理能力。

en: To learn something so you can remember it exactly
simple: I memorize ten words a day.
toeic: New staff must memorize the emergency exit procedures.
toeic_zh: 新進員工必須記住緊急逃生程序。

en: an experienced person who guides and advises someone
toeic: A mentor provides guidance and support to help junior employees navigate career advancement.
toeic_zh: 導師提供指導和支持，幫助初級員工尋求職業進步。

en: A good quality that deserves praise
toeic: Promotions are based on merit, not seniority.
toeic_zh: 升遷依據功績，而非年資。

en: the confidence and spirit of a group
toeic: Staff morale dropped after the company announced salary cuts.
toeic_zh: 公司宣布減薪後，員工士氣下降了。

en: To suggest someone for a job or prize
simple: They will nominate her for the prize.
simple_zh: 他們會提名她角逐獎項。
toeic: Employees may nominate a colleague for the annual award.
toeic_zh: 員工可以提名同事角逐年度獎項。

en: The act of suggesting someone for a job or prize
toeic: The deadline for nomination is the end of this month.
toeic_zh: 提名截止日期是本月底。

en: A person who lives in or uses a place
simple: The occupant of the room left.
toeic: The occupant of the apartment must pay the utility bills.
toeic_zh: 公寓的住戶必須支付水電費。

en: A person's job
toeic: Please write your name and occupation on the form.
toeic_zh: 請在表格上填寫您的姓名和職業。

en: introduction and training for new employees
toeic: New employees attend an orientation program to learn company policies and procedures.
toeic_zh: 新員工參加介紹計畫以了解公司政策和程序。

en: exceptionally good or impressive
toeic: Outstanding performance in this quarter exceeded all expectations and contributed to company growth.
toeic_zh: 本季度的傑出績效超越了所有期望並促進了公司增長。

en: a small flat package or set of papers
simple: I got a packet of seeds.
toeic: Each new employee will receive an information packet on the first day.
toeic_zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會收到一份資料袋。

en: a person who helps a lawyer
toeic: The law firm is looking for an experienced paralegal.
toeic_zh: 這家律師事務所正在徵求有經驗的律師助理。

en: money paid to a worker for work
toeic: Your paycheck will be deposited every second Friday.
toeic_zh: 您的薪資會在每隔一週的週五存入帳戶。

en: in a way that lasts forever
toeic: The branch office will be closed permanently next month.
toeic_zh: 這間分公司下個月將永久關閉。

en: a doctor of medicine
toeic: Please consult your physician before starting the program.
toeic_zh: 開始這項計畫前請先諮詢您的醫師。

en: the act of putting something in a place
simple: The placement of the sign is good.
toeic: The agency helps with job placement for recent graduates.
toeic_zh: 這家仲介公司協助應屆畢業生就業安置。

en: collection of work samples showing skills and experience
