simple: Bring your portfolio to the interview.
simple_zh: 帶上你的作品集去面試。
toeic: Portfolios of past projects demonstrate technical skills and experience relevant to the applied position.
toeic_zh: 過去項目的作品集展示了與申請職位相關的技術技能和經驗。

en: to order a medicine for a patient
toeic: The physician may prescribe a stronger treatment.
toeic_zh: 醫師可能會開立藥效更強的治療。

en: respected and admired by many
toeic: She won a prestigious award for her design.
toeic_zh: 她因設計獲得一座享有盛名的獎項。

en: the quality of being productive and accomplishing tasks
toeic: Employee productivity is tracked through performance metrics and output measurements.
toeic_zh: 員工生產力通過績效指標和產出測量進行追蹤。

en: a high level of skill
toeic: The job requires proficiency in Spanish and Excel.
toeic_zh: 這份工作要求精通西班牙文和 Excel。

en: well known or easy to see
toeic: The logo is placed in a prominent position on the box.
toeic_zh: 標誌放在盒子上顯眼的位置。

en: likely to become something in future
simple_zh: 我們見了一位潛在客戶。
toeic: The firm interviewed several prospective employees this week.
toeic_zh: 公司本週面試了幾位未來可能錄用的員工。

en: to leave a job or stop doing
toeic: Several staff members plan to quit after the merger.
toeic_zh: 合併後有幾名員工打算辭職。

en: a person whose job is to find and hire new employees
simple_zh: 招聘人員今天給我打電話。
toeic: Our company recruiter visited universities to find top talent for internship programs.
toeic_zh: 我們公司的招聘人員訪問了大學，為實習計畫尋找頂級人才。

en: the process of finding new workers
toeic: The recruitment of new engineers will begin in January.
toeic_zh: 新工程師的招募將於一月開始。

en: a recommendation of a person for a job
simple: I got this job by referral.
simple_zh: 我是經人推薦得到這份工作的。
toeic: Employees receive a bonus for every successful referral.
toeic_zh: 員工每成功推薦一人即可獲得獎金。

en: to make something stronger
toeic: The training session will reinforce the new safety rules.
toeic_zh: 這次培訓將強化新的安全規定。

en: quality of being trustworthy and dependable
toeic: Employee reliability in meeting deadlines and commitments strengthens team trust and project outcomes.
toeic_zh: 員工在滿足截止日期和承諾方面的可靠性加強了團隊信任和項目成果。

en: the act of moving to a new place
toeic: The company will cover all relocation costs for the new manager.
toeic_zh: 公司將負擔新經理的所有搬遷費用。

en: the act of formally leaving a job
toeic: The manager submitted her resignation after ten years with the firm.
toeic_zh: 這位經理在公司任職十年後遞出了辭呈。

en: a paper listing your education and work
simple_zh: 我昨天寄出了我的履歷。
toeic: Please attach your résumé to the online application form.
toeic_zh: 請將您的履歷附在線上申請表上。

en: a document listing someone's work experience and education
toeic: Your resume should highlight relevant experience and achievements.
toeic_zh: 你的履歷應該突出相關經驗和成就。

en: people whose job is to sell things
simple_zh: 這些業務人員非常友善。
toeic: Our salespeople will attend a training workshop on Monday.
toeic_zh: 我們的業務人員將於週一參加培訓工作坊。

en: meeting requirements or expectations adequately
toeic: Employees with satisfactory performance reviews maintain their current salary and benefits.
toeic_zh: 績效評估令人滿意的員工保持其目前的薪水和福利。

en: money given to a student to pay for study
toeic: The firm offers a scholarship to students who study engineering.
toeic_zh: 這家公司為就讀工程的學生提供獎學金。

en: a person who is looking for something
toeic: Every job seeker should prepare a clear and short résumé.
toeic_zh: 每位求職者都應準備一份清楚簡短的履歷。

en: half of a school year
toeic: Students must pay tuition at the start of each semester.
toeic_zh: 學生必須在每學期開始時繳交學費。

en: a husband or wife
simple: His spouse works at a bank.
toeic: Employees may add a spouse to their health insurance plan.
toeic_zh: 員工可以將配偶加入健康保險計畫。

en: planned and designed to achieve specific goals
toeic: Strategic workforce planning aligns employee capabilities with organizational objectives and future growth.
toeic_zh: 戰略人力資源規劃將員工能力與組織目標和未來增長相一致。

en: better than others
toeic: Our product is superior to those of our competitors.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品優於競爭對手的產品。

en: to watch and direct people or work
toeic: Managers supervise the work of new employees.
toeic_zh: 主管負責監督新進員工的工作。

en: to end an employment relationship
toeic: Employees may be terminated for violation of company policies or unsatisfactory performance.
toeic_zh: 員工可因違反公司政策或績效不滿意而被終止。

en: the act of ending something
toeic: Early termination of the contract requires written notice.
toeic_zh: 提前終止合約需要書面通知。

en: a person who is learning a job
toeic: Each trainee will receive a mentor for the first month.
toeic_zh: 每位受訓者在第一個月都會有一位導師。

en: a person who teaches skills to others
toeic: A professional trainer will lead the safety workshop.
toeic_zh: 一位專業講師將帶領安全工作坊。

en: Money paid for classes at a school.
simple: The tuition is very high here.
toeic: The company will cover your tuition for evening courses.
toeic_zh: 公司會負擔你夜間課程的學費。

en: the rate at which employees leave a job or organization
toeic: High employee turnover increases recruitment and training costs for the organization.
toeic_zh: 高員工離職率增加了組織的招聘和培訓成本。

en: Without a job.
simple: He has been unemployed for a month.
toeic: The number of unemployed workers fell slightly last quarter.
toeic_zh: 上一季失業人數略微下降。

en: Not yet paid, or without pay.
toeic: Please settle all unpaid invoices before the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 請在月底前結清所有未付發票。

en: an unfilled job position
simple: There is a vacancy in our team.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊有一個空缺。
toeic: The company announced three job vacancies in the marketing department.
toeic_zh: 公司在市場行銷部門宣布了三個空缺。

en: A period of time away from work or school.
simple: We are on vacation this week.
toeic: Employees must submit vacation requests at least two weeks ahead.
toeic_zh: 員工須至少提前兩週提出休假申請。

en: the state of being in good physical and mental health
toeic: Comprehensive wellness programs include fitness classes, mental health support, and nutrition counseling.
toeic_zh: 全面的健康計畫包括健身課程、心理健康支持和營養諮詢。

en: The feeling of being ready to do something.
simple: I like his willingness to help.
toeic: We value your willingness to work flexible hours.
toeic_zh: 我們重視您願意彈性工作的態度。

en: A book with exercises for students.
simple: Open your workbook to page ten.
simple_zh: 請把練習本翻到第十頁。
toeic: Each trainee receives a workbook at the start of the course.
toeic_zh: 每位受訓者在課程開始時會領到一本練習手冊。

en: all the people employed in a company or industry
toeic: The company is developing strategies to attract younger talent to its aging workforce.
toeic_zh: 公司正在制定戰略以吸引年輕人才到其老化的勞動力隊伍。

en: the place where someone works
toeic: A positive workplace culture encourages collaboration, innovation, and employee satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 積極的工作場所文化鼓勵協作、創新和員工滿意度。

en: a sum of money provided for a specific purpose
toeic: Monthly allowances for transportation and meals are provided to field representatives.
toeic_zh: 為外場代表提供月度運輸和膳食津貼。

en: independence and freedom to make decisions in one's work
toeic: Giving employees autonomy in decision-making improves engagement and develops leadership capabilities.
toeic_zh: 給員工決策自主權改善參與度並發展領導能力。

en: a demonstrated ability to perform tasks
toeic: Core competencies for this role include communication and problem-solving.
toeic_zh: 公司通過定期績效評估來評估員工能力。

en: having the knowledge and ability to do something successfully
simple_zh: 他是一位有能力的工程師。
toeic: A competent workforce with strong technical skills is essential for company success.
toeic_zh: 具有強大技術技能的有能力的勞動力對公司成功至關重要。

en: a qualification or achievement showing someone's ability
simple_zh: 她的證書令人印象深刻。
toeic: Candidates should present relevant credentials such as certifications and awards.
toeic_zh: 候選人應提供相關證書，如認證和獎項。

en: unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people
toeic: Zero-tolerance discrimination policies ensure equal treatment regardless of race, gender, or age.
toeic_zh: 零容忍歧視政策確保不分種族、性別或年齡的平等待遇。

en: improvement or increase in value or quality
toeic: Career enhancement programs provide training and development opportunities to strengthen employee capabilities.
toeic_zh: 職業增強計畫提供培訓和發展機會以加強員工能力。

en: the practice of including and welcoming all people
simple_zh: 包容是公司的優先事項。
toeic: Inclusion of diverse perspectives strengthens team outcomes.
toeic_zh: 包容性的工作場所文化歡迎多元化員工並提供平等的晉升機會。

en: process of making something as good or effective as possible
toeic: Continuous optimization of workflows and systems increases employee productivity and organizational effectiveness.
toeic_zh: 工作流程和系統的持續優化提高了員工生產力和組織有效性。

en: to pay another company to do work for you
toeic: The firm chose to outsource its payroll processing to a specialist.
toeic_zh: 公司選擇將薪資處理外包給專業業者。

en: to cause someone to suffer a penalty for wrongdoing
toeic: The company punishes violations of workplace conduct policies through warnings or suspension.
toeic_zh: 公司通過警告或暫停來懲罰違反工作場所行為政策的行為。

en: the period of time someone holds a job
simple: His tenure here is ten years.
toeic: During her tenure as HR director, staff turnover fell sharply.
toeic_zh: 在她擔任人資主管期間，員工流動率大幅下降。

en: Good enough; of acceptable quality.
toeic: The hotel offers decent rooms at a reasonable price.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以合理價格提供不錯的客房。

en: Dishonest or illegal behavior by powerful people.
toeic: The audit uncovered corruption within the purchasing department.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現採購部門內部有貪腐情事。

en: Developing step by step; favoring change.
toeic: The firm adopted a progressive pay system to reward performance.
toeic_zh: 公司採用漸進式薪資制度來獎勵績效。

en: Something done to a person who broke a rule.
toeic: The policy lists the punishment for late reports and missed deadlines.
toeic_zh: 政策列出了延遲報告與錯過期限的處罰。

en: The study of the mind and behavior.
toeic: Consumer psychology helps marketers understand buying habits.
toeic_zh: 消費者心理學幫助行銷人員了解購買習慣。

en: able to learn and understand things well
toeic: We hired an intelligent analyst to review the market data.
toeic_zh: 我們聘請了一位聰明的分析師來檢視市場數據。

en: having two parts or purposes
toeic: The new role has a dual responsibility for sales and service.
toeic_zh: 這個新職位同時負責銷售與服務兩部分。

en: the state of being equal in rights
simple: We believe in equality for all.
toeic: The firm promotes gender equality in hiring and pay.
toeic_zh: 公司在聘雇與薪資上推動性別平等。

en: including many different types
simple_zh: 我們有一支多元的團隊。
toeic: The company serves a diverse range of clients worldwide.
toeic_zh: 公司服務全球各種不同的客戶。

en: at an earlier time
toeic: Mr. Lee, formerly of Sales, is now our operations director.
toeic_zh: 李先生先前任職業務部，現為我們的營運總監。

en: to get rid of something
toeic: The company plans to shed 200 jobs this year.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃今年裁減兩百個職位。

en: a condition that limits what a person can do
toeic: The building provides full access for people with a disability.
toeic_zh: 這棟大樓為身心障礙者提供完整的無障礙設施。

en: in a way allowed by law
simple: You must legally sign the form.
simple_zh: 你必須依法簽署這份表格。
toeic: The firm is legally required to protect customer data.
toeic_zh: 公司依法必須保護客戶資料。

en: not treating people equally or fairly
toeic: Employees filed a complaint about unfair treatment.
toeic_zh: 員工針對不公平待遇提出申訴。

en: the position or term of a president
toeic: She took over the presidency of the company last month.
toeic_zh: 她上個月接任公司總裁職位。

en: a room where students learn
toeic: The training will be held in the classroom on the third floor.
toeic_zh: 訓練將在三樓的教室舉行。

en: related to thinking and understanding
simple: Reading helps cognitive growth in children.
simple_zh: 閱讀有助於兒童的認知發展。
toeic: The training program improves cognitive skills such as problem solving.
toeic_zh: 這個訓練課程可提升解決問題等認知能力。

en: a small number or amount
simple: Only a handful of people came.
toeic: Only a handful of applicants met all the requirements.
toeic_zh: 只有少數應徵者符合所有條件。

en: the legal status of belonging to a country
toeic: Applicants must show proof of citizenship or a valid work visa.
toeic_zh: 應徵者必須提供公民身分證明或有效的工作簽證。

en: right and fair according to moral rules
simple: It is not ethical to lie.
toeic: All staff must follow the company's ethical standards.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的道德標準。

en: involving a lot of work in a short time
simple: I took an intensive English course.
simple_zh: 我上了一個英語密集課程。
toeic: New staff must complete an intensive training program.
toeic_zh: 新進員工必須完成密集的訓練課程。

en: the part of a shirt around the neck
simple_zh: 他的襯衫領子是白色的。
toeic: Many white-collar workers now work from home.
toeic_zh: 許多白領工作者現在在家上班。

en: between beginner and advanced level
simple: I am an intermediate English learner.
simple_zh: 我是中級的英語學習者。
toeic: The course is designed for intermediate users of the software.
toeic_zh: 這門課是為軟體中級使用者設計的。

en: a person who takes over a job from someone
simple: Who is his successor at work?
simple_zh: 誰是他工作上的接班人？
toeic: The board will name a successor to the retiring CEO next week.
toeic_zh: 董事會將於下週宣布即將退休的執行長之繼任人選。

en: a series of things in order; taking over a position
simple: He won three games in succession.
toeic: A clear succession plan helps the firm avoid leadership gaps.
toeic_zh: 明確的接班計畫有助於公司避免領導空窗。

en: to make people obey a rule or law
simple: The school will enforce the rule.
toeic: Inspectors will enforce the new safety regulations strictly.
toeic_zh: 檢查人員將嚴格執行新的安全法規。

en: the reason why someone does something
toeic: The investigator looked for a motive behind the data leak.
toeic_zh: 調查人員尋找資料外洩背後的動機。

en: to let someone go or release something
simple: The hospital will discharge him today.
toeic: The factory was fined for the illegal discharge of waste.
toeic_zh: 該工廠因將廢棄物排入河中而被罰款。

en: an unfair difference between groups of people
simple_zh: 這裡有收入不平等的問題。
toeic: The report highlights pay inequality between men and women.
toeic_zh: 該報告凸顯了男女薪資不平等。

en: a strong wish to succeed or achieve something
toeic: His ambition is to become the regional sales director.
toeic_zh: 他的抱負是成為區域銷售總監。

en: in a way that many people could say is true
simple: This is arguably the best cafe.
simple_zh: 這可以說是最棒的咖啡館。
toeic: She is arguably the most qualified candidate for the position.
toeic_zh: 可以說她是這個職位最合格的人選。

en: a person who will receive money or property from someone
simple: He is the heir to the farm.
simple_zh: 他是這座農場的繼承人。
toeic: The founder named his daughter as heir to the family business.
toeic_zh: 創辦人指定女兒為家族事業的繼承人。

en: choosing carefully only some things or people
toeic: The company is highly selective when hiring new engineers.
toeic_zh: 該公司在招聘新工程師時非常挑剔。

en: The outer edge of something; extra benefits
simple: He lives on the city fringe.
toeic: The job offers good fringe benefits, including health insurance.
toeic_zh: 這份工作提供良好的額外福利，包括健康保險。

en: A person who held a job before someone else
simple_zh: 我的前任留了一張字條。
toeic: My predecessor set up the filing system we still use.
toeic_zh: 我的前任建立了我們至今仍在使用的歸檔系統。

en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge
toeic: The company has a strict policy against prejudice in hiring.
toeic_zh: 公司有嚴格的政策禁止招聘中的偏見。

en: Based on personal feelings, not facts
toeic: Performance reviews should not be too subjective.
toeic_zh: 績效評核不應太過主觀。

en: An earlier case used as an example
toeic: The ruling set a precedent for future contract disputes.
toeic_zh: 該裁決為日後的合約糾紛樹立了先例。

en: The quality of treating people equally
toeic: The union demanded fairness in the way bonuses are given.
toeic_zh: 工會要求獎金發放要公平。

en: A person who currently holds a position
simple: The incumbent will keep the job.
simple_zh: 現任者將保有這份工作。
toeic: The incumbent manager plans to retire next year.
toeic_zh: 現任經理計劃明年退休。

en: required or set by law
simple: Statutory leave is a right by law.
simple_zh: 法定假是依法享有的權利。
toeic: Employees are entitled to statutory holidays in addition to their annual leave.
toeic_zh: 員工除了年假之外，還享有法定假日。

en: a person who moves to another place for work
simple: The migrant came here to find work.
simple_zh: 這位移工來這裡找工作。
toeic: Many migrant workers send part of their salary back home each month.
toeic_zh: 許多移工每月把部分薪水寄回家鄉。

en: using careful study to understand something
toeic: The position requires strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
toeic_zh: 這個職位需要很強的分析能力與細心。

en: the act of removing someone from a job
simple_zh: 他被解僱讓大家很驚訝。
toeic: The employee filed a complaint about his unfair dismissal.
toeic_zh: 該名員工針對不當解僱提出申訴。

en: required by a rule or law
toeic: Attendance at the safety training is compulsory for all new staff.
toeic_zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。

en: depending on something else happening
simple: The trip is contingent on the weather.
toeic: The offer is contingent upon a successful background check.
toeic_zh: 這份聘書以通過背景調查為條件。

en: a particular quality of a person or thing
toeic: Leadership is an important trait for a team manager.
toeic_zh: 領導力是團隊經理的重要特質。

en: a person who works in a profession
simple: My aunt is a medical practitioner.
toeic: Legal practitioners attended the seminar on new regulations.
toeic_zh: 法律從業人員參加了關於新法規的研討會。

en: depending on something else happening
toeic: The job offer is conditional on a successful background check.
toeic_zh: 這份工作錄取以通過背景調查為條件。

en: a person who is not part of a group
simple_zh: 他覺得自己像個局外人。
toeic: The company hired an outsider as its new CEO.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請了外部人士擔任新任執行長。

en: giving people more power or control
toeic: Employee empowerment improved morale and productivity.
toeic_zh: 員工賦權提升了士氣與生產力。

en: careful and steady hard work
toeic: Due diligence is required before signing the deal.
toeic_zh: 簽約前需要進行盡職調查。

en: to treat people unfairly because of who they are
toeic: The law forbids employers to discriminate on the basis of age.
toeic_zh: 法律禁止雇主以年齡為由歧視員工。

en: to give someone the power to do something
simple_zh: 好老師能賦予學生力量。
toeic: We empower our staff to solve customer problems quickly.
toeic_zh: 我們授權員工快速解決客戶問題。

en: strong public praise for something
simple_zh: 這部電影獲得極高的讚譽。
toeic: The restaurant has received critical acclaim for its menu.
toeic_zh: 這家餐廳的菜單獲得評論界的讚譽。

en: to provide space or meet someone's needs
simple: The room can accommodate ten people.
simple_zh: 這個房間可容納十個人。
toeic: The hotel can accommodate large groups during the conference.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店在會議期間可以容納大型團體。

en: a woman who acts in films or plays
simple: The actress smiled at the crowd.
toeic: The famous actress will appear in our new advertisement.
toeic_zh: 這位著名女演員將出現在我們的新廣告中。

en: permission or payment to enter a place
simple: Admission to the museum is free.
toeic: Admission to the trade show costs twenty dollars.
toeic_zh: 貿易展的入場費是二十美元。

en: wise and sensible to do
simple: It is advisable to arrive early.
toeic: It is advisable to book your flight well in advance.
toeic_zh: 最好提早預訂機票。

en: the price of a plane ticket
simple: Airfare is very high in summer.
toeic: The company will reimburse your airfare after the trip.
toeic_zh: 公司會在旅程結束後報銷你的機票費用。

en: a passage between rows of seats
simple: Aisle seats offer easy restroom access.
simple_zh: 走道座位可方便上廁所。
toeic: Aisle positions are preferred by frequent travelers.
toeic_zh: 走道位置是頻繁旅行者的偏好。

en: an abnormal reaction to a substance
simple_zh: 向航空公司披露過敏情況。
toeic: Allergy information assists meal planning.
toeic_zh: 過敏信息有助於膳食規劃。

en: a person who does something without being paid
toeic: The photo contest is open to amateurs and professionals.
toeic_zh: 這場攝影比賽開放業餘與專業人士參加。

en: a desirable feature or facility
simple_zh: 飯店提供優秀的便利設施。
toeic: Amenities include gym and pool access.
toeic_zh: 便利設施包括健身房和游泳池。

en: to make someone laugh or enjoy
simple: The clown will amuse the kids.
toeic: The game was designed to amuse guests while they wait.
toeic_zh: 這個遊戲是為了讓客人等候時有娛樂而設計的。

en: a date marking a yearly event
simple_zh: 今天是我們的結婚週年紀念日。
toeic: The firm will celebrate its twentieth anniversary next month.
toeic_zh: 公司下個月將慶祝成立二十週年。

en: a small dish eaten before the main meal
simple_zh: 我點了一份沙拉開胃菜。
toeic: The restaurant offers a free appetizer with every dinner.
toeic_zh: 這家餐廳每份晚餐都附贈一道開胃菜。

en: a round red or green fruit
toeic: The cafeteria serves a fresh apple with every lunch set.
toeic_zh: 自助餐廳每份午餐套餐都附一顆新鮮蘋果。

en: relating to art or skilled in art
toeic: The lobby has an artistic design that impresses visitors.
toeic_zh: 大廳的藝術設計令訪客印象深刻。

en: in the state of sleeping
toeic: Please keep quiet because several guests are already asleep.
toeic_zh: 請保持安靜，因為有幾位客人已經入睡。

en: relating to sports or good at sports
toeic: The hotel has an athletic center open to all guests.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店有一座對所有房客開放的運動中心。

en: the state of being available or ready
toeic: Room availability is limited during peak season.
toeic_zh: 在旅遊高峰期房間可用性有限。

en: a bag carried on your back
toeic: Please place your backpack under the seat in front of you.
toeic_zh: 請將您的背包放在前方座位下方。

en: the bags and cases that a traveler carries
toeic: Checked baggage must not weigh more than twenty-three kilograms.
toeic_zh: 託運行李的重量不得超過二十三公斤。
family: 不可數名詞；baggage claim; baggage allowance; checked baggage

en: a person who makes bread and cakes
simple_zh: 麵包師傅做的麵包很好吃。
toeic: The baker delivers fresh pastries to local cafes each day.
toeic_zh: 麵包師傅每天將新鮮糕點送到當地咖啡館。

en: a shop that sells bread and cakes
toeic: The bakery next to our office sells excellent sandwiches.
toeic_zh: 我們辦公室旁邊的麵包店賣很棒的三明治。

en: a rubber bag filled with air or gas
simple: The child has a red balloon.
toeic: Colorful balloons decorated the hall for the opening ceremony.
toeic_zh: 彩色氣球裝飾了開幕典禮的會場。

en: a meal cooked outdoors over a fire
simple: We had a barbecue on Sunday.
toeic: The staff barbecue will take place in the park on Friday.
toeic_zh: 員工烤肉聚會將於週五在公園舉行。

en: a sport played with a bat and ball
toeic: Tickets to the baseball game sell out quickly every season.
toeic_zh: 棒球比賽的門票每季都很快售完。

en: a team sport played with a ball and hoops
toeic: The company sponsors a local basketball team every year.
toeic_zh: 公司每年贊助一支當地籃球隊。

en: a small seed eaten as food
toeic: The cafe imports coffee beans directly from farms in Colombia.
toeic_zh: 這家咖啡館直接從哥倫比亞的農場進口咖啡豆。

en: A drink, such as juice, coffee or tea.
toeic: Complimentary beverages will be served during the afternoon session.
toeic_zh: 下午場次將提供免費飲料。

en: A two-wheeled vehicle you ride by pedaling.
simple: I ride my bicycle to school.
toeic: Employees who ride a bicycle to work can use the secure parking area.
toeic_zh: 騎腳踏車上班的員工可使用安全停車區。

en: A written account of a person's life.
simple: I read a biography of Lincoln.
toeic: The author's latest biography will be published next month.
toeic_zh: 這位作者的最新傳記將於下個月出版。

en: The day each year when a person was born.
toeic: The team organized a small party for her birthday.
toeic_zh: 團隊為她的生日辦了一場小派對。

en: A thick cover used on a bed to keep warm.
toeic: Guests may request an extra blanket from the front desk.
toeic_zh: 房客可向櫃檯索取額外的毯子。

en: A thin printed booklet with information about a product or place.
simple_zh: 她拿了一本旅遊小冊子。
toeic: Please send me a brochure describing your corporate travel packages.
toeic_zh: 請寄給我一份介紹貴公司商務旅遊套裝行程的宣傳小冊。

en: A soft yellow food made from cream.
simple: I put butter on my bread.
toeic: The bakery buys fresh butter from a local farm.
toeic_zh: 這家烘焙坊向當地農場採購新鮮奶油。

en: A small wooden house, or a room in a plane or ship.
simple: The cabin is small but warm.
simple_zh: 這間小木屋小但很溫暖。
toeic: Please store your bags in the overhead compartment of the cabin.
toeic_zh: 請將行李放在機艙上方的行李櫃。

en: A small place that serves coffee and light food.
toeic: The café on the first floor serves lunch to employees.
toeic_zh: 一樓的咖啡館為員工提供午餐。

en: the action of canceling a reservation
toeic: Cancellation policy is stated in terms.
toeic_zh: 取消政策在條款中說明。

en: A famous person, especially in entertainment.
simple_zh: 她今天見到了一位名人。
toeic: A famous celebrity will appear in our new advertisement.
toeic_zh: 一位知名名人將出現在我們的新廣告中。

en: the process of leaving a hotel
toeic: Late checkout may require additional fees.
toeic_zh: 晚退房可能收取額外費用。

en: To shout happily or make someone feel happier.
simple: The fans cheer for the team.
toeic: Staff gathered to cheer the winners of the sales contest.
toeic_zh: 員工聚集起來為業績競賽的得主歡呼。

en: A hamburger with melted cheese on top.
toeic: The restaurant sells a cheeseburger and fries for six dollars.
toeic_zh: 這家餐廳的起司漢堡加薯條只賣六美元。

en: A place where people go to watch films.
toeic: The new cinema offers discounts to local residents.
toeic_zh: 新開的電影院提供當地居民折扣。

en: A show with acrobats, clowns and trained animals.
toeic: The circus will perform in the city stadium this weekend.
toeic_zh: 馬戲團本週末將在市立體育場演出。

en: a person who receives services or goods
toeic: Client satisfaction is our top priority.
toeic_zh: 客戶滿意度是我們的首要任務。

en: A flat tool with teeth used to tidy hair.
toeic: The hotel provides a comb and a toothbrush in each room.
toeic_zh: 飯店每間客房都提供梳子和牙刷。

en: In a way that feels pleasant and relaxed.
toeic: The meeting room can comfortably seat twenty people.
toeic_zh: 這間會議室可舒適地容納二十人。

en: to travel regularly between home and work
simple: I commute to work by train.
toeic: Many employees commute to the downtown office by subway.
toeic_zh: 許多員工搭地鐵通勤到市中心的辦公室。

en: free or provided at no cost
toeic: Complimentary airport transfers are available.
toeic_zh: 提供免費機場轉運。

en: a hotel employee who helps guests
toeic: The concierge arranged our restaurant reservation.
toeic_zh: 禮賓部為我們安排了餐廳預訂。

en: a person who takes part in a competition
simple_zh: 這位參賽者贏得了獎品。
toeic: Each contestant must register before the competition begins.
toeic_zh: 每位參賽者必須在比賽開始前登記。

en: a book with recipes for cooking
toeic: The chef is launching a cookbook featuring local dishes next month.
toeic_zh: 這位主廚下個月將推出一本以在地料理為主的食譜書。

en: a small flat sweet baked snack
simple_zh: 她吃了一塊巧克力餅乾。
toeic: Complimentary coffee and cookies will be served after the seminar.
toeic_zh: 研討會結束後將供應免費咖啡和餅乾。

en: a container that keeps food and drinks cold
simple: We put drinks in the cooler.
toeic: Please bring a cooler to keep the beverages cold at the picnic.
toeic_zh: 請帶一個冰桶，讓野餐的飲料保持冰涼。

en: clothes worn for a play or party
simple: She wore a costume to the party.
toeic: The theater rents costumes for its annual stage production.
toeic_zh: 劇院為年度舞台劇出租戲服。

en: land outside towns and cities
toeic: The resort offers quiet views of the countryside.
toeic_zh: 這間度假村可欣賞寧靜的鄉間景色。

en: a trip on a large ship for fun
simple: They took a cruise in May.
toeic: The company rewarded its top sales team with a Caribbean cruise.
toeic_zh: 公司以加勒比海郵輪之旅獎勵業績最佳的業務團隊。

en: a flat outside area of a ship or house
toeic: Guests can enjoy dinner on the upper deck of the ship.
toeic_zh: 旅客可在船的上層甲板享用晚餐。

en: having a very good taste
toeic: The restaurant is famous for its delicious seafood dishes.
toeic_zh: 這家餐廳以美味的海鮮料理聞名。

en: a sweet food eaten after a meal
toeic: Dessert and coffee are included in the price of the banquet.
toeic_zh: 宴會價格包含甜點與咖啡。

en: the place where someone is going
toeic: The destination offers excellent business opportunities.
toeic_zh: 目的地提供了絕佳的商業機會。

en: to eat a meal, usually dinner
toeic: Guests may dine on the terrace if the weather permits.
toeic_zh: 如果天氣允許，賓客可以在露台用餐。

en: a machine or person that cleans dishes
toeic: The restaurant needs to hire a dishwasher for the evening shift.
toeic_zh: 這家餐廳需要為晚班聘請一名洗碗工。

en: to go under water head first
toeic: Tourists can dive near the coral reef with a certified guide.
toeic_zh: 遊客可以在合格導遊的帶領下於珊瑚礁附近潛水。

en: a film about real people or events
toeic: The documentary about local farming will air on Channel 5 tonight.
toeic_zh: 這部關於在地農業的紀錄片將於今晚在五台播出。

en: a sweet ring-shaped fried cake
simple: I ate a donut for breakfast.
simple_zh: 我早餐吃了一個甜甜圈。
toeic: The bakery offers a free donut with every coffee purchase.
toeic_zh: 這家麵包店買咖啡就送一個免費甜甜圈。

en: a man who guards or opens the door of a building
toeic: The doorman will help guests with their luggage on arrival.
toeic_zh: 門僮會在客人抵達時協助搬運行李。

en: a musical instrument, or a large round container
simple: He plays the drum in a band.
toeic: The chemicals are stored in a steel drum in the warehouse.

en: a round red fruit used in cooking
toeic: The farm supplies fresh tomato to local supermarkets.
toeic_zh: 這座農場供應新鮮番茄給當地超市。

en: A legally registered name or symbol of a company.
toeic: The firm filed a trademark to protect its product name overseas.
toeic_zh: 該公司申請註冊商標，以在海外保護其產品名稱。

en: in a way that follows old customs
toeic: The company has traditionally relied on print advertising.
toeic_zh: 這家公司傳統上依賴平面廣告。

en: business deal or exchange of money and goods
toeic: Payment processing transactions increased by 300% this year.
toeic_zh: 今年支付處理交易增加了300%。

en: Without any limit in amount or number.
toeic: The plan includes unlimited data and free international calls.
toeic_zh: 此方案包含無限流量與免費國際通話。

en: A small case for money and cards.
toeic: A guest found a wallet in the lobby and gave it to reception.
toeic_zh: 一位房客在大廳撿到皮夾並交給櫃檯。

en: guarantee that a product meets certain standards
toeic: Our products come with a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品附帶針對製造缺陷的兩年保修。

en: Soft hair from sheep used to make clothes.
simple: This sweater is made of wool.
toeic: The jackets in our winter line are made of pure wool.
toeic_zh: 我們冬季系列的外套由純羊毛製成。

en: A small fold or line in cloth or skin.
toeic: This fabric resists wrinkle, so it is ideal for travel.
toeic_zh: 這種布料不易皺，很適合旅行。

en: A watch worn on the wrist.
toeic: The store offers a free engraving on every wristwatch.
toeic_zh: 這家店為每支手錶提供免費刻字。

en: combination of products sold together
toeic: Our product bundles offer better value than individual purchases.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品捆綁提供了比單獨購買更好的價值。

en: changing a potential customer into a paying customer
toeic: Our conversion rate from inquiry to sale is approximately 15%.
toeic_zh: 我們的詢問轉化為銷售的轉化率約為15%。

en: quality of being trusted or believed
toeic: Our company's credibility increased after receiving industry awards.
toeic_zh: 獲得行業獎項後，我們公司的信任度提高了。

en: A group of people defined by age, income, or similar traits.
simple: Young people are our main demographic.
simple_zh: 年輕人是我們的主要客群。
toeic: The survey shows that our product appeals mostly to a younger demographic.
toeic_zh: 調查顯示我們的產品主要吸引較年輕的族群。

en: making something distinct or different
toeic: Our differentiation strategy focuses on superior customer service.
toeic_zh: 我們的差異化戰略專注於優質客戶服務。

en: to say publicly that you like and support a product
simple: A famous singer will endorse the shoes.
simple_zh: 一位知名歌手將為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: The company paid a famous athlete to endorse its new sports drink.
toeic_zh: 公司付錢請一位知名運動員為其新運動飲料代言。
family: endorsement (n) 代言；背書; endorser (n) 代言人; celebrity endorsement 名人代言

en: public support from a famous person for a product
simple: The singer gave the shoes an endorsement.
simple_zh: 那位歌手為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: A celebrity endorsement helped the new beverage reach younger customers.
toeic_zh: 名人代言幫助這款新飲料接觸到更年輕的顧客。

en: to carry out or perform an action
toeic: Our team executes daily marketing tasks efficiently.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊有效地執行日常市場營銷任務。

en: combining two different types or methods
toeic: Our hybrid retail model combines online and offline channels.
toeic_zh: 我們的混合零售模式結合了在線和線下渠道。

en: To sell goods quickly, often at low prices.
simple: The shop must liquidate old stock.
simple_zh: 這家店必須變賣舊庫存。
toeic: The company had to liquidate its remaining inventory before closing.
toeic_zh: 公司在結束營業前必須變賣剩餘的庫存。

en: A small, specialized part of a market.
simple: They sell to a small niche.
simple_zh: 他們向一個小眾市場銷售。
toeic: The startup found a niche in eco-friendly office supplies.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司在環保辦公用品領域找到了利基市場。

en: time needed to recover investment
toeic: The marketing campaign has a payback period of 6 months.
toeic_zh: 市場營銷活動的回本期限是6個月。

en: series of processes or customers in various stages
toeic: Our sales pipeline contains $5 million in qualified opportunities.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售漏斗包含500萬美元的符合資格的機會。

en: plan or suggestion presented to someone
toeic: Our unique value proposition emphasizes quality and innovation.
toeic_zh: 我們獨特的價值主張強調質量和創新。

en: A fixed amount of sales a person must reach.
toeic: Our team exceeded its quarterly quota by fifteen percent.
toeic_zh: 我們團隊的季度業績超出配額百分之十五。

en: a short phrase that a company uses in its advertising
simple: The shop has a funny slogan.
simple_zh: 這家店有一句很有趣的口號。
toeic: The new slogan is short, catchy, and easy to remember.
toeic_zh: 這句新標語簡短、朗朗上口又容易記住。
family: advertising slogan 廣告標語; catchy slogan 朗朗上口的標語; campaign slogan 活動標語

en: level or point at which something begins
toeic: Orders exceeding the threshold receive automatic discounts.
toeic_zh: 超過門檻的訂單自動獲得折扣。

en: level or rank in a system
toeic: Our tiered pricing structure offers options for all budgets.
toeic_zh: 我們的分級定價結構為所有預算提供選項。

en: person or company that buys and sells goods or securities
simple_zh: 交易商做出了明智的決定。
toeic: The grain trader negotiated contracts for the harvest season.
toeic_zh: 穀物交易商為收穫季節談判合同。

en: To show a new product to the public for the first time.
simple: They will unveil a new car.
toeic: The company will unveil its latest smartphone at a press conference tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 該公司明天將在記者會上發表最新款智慧型手機。

en: selling goods in bulk at lower prices
toeic: Our wholesale division supplies 500 retail partners.
toeic_zh: 我們的批發部門為500家零售合作夥伴供應。

en: A group or agreement of partners who work together.
simple: The two firms formed an alliance.
toeic: The strategic alliance will help both companies enter new markets.
toeic_zh: 這項策略聯盟將協助兩家公司進入新市場。

en: Very valuable and important.
toeic: Please handle the precious artwork with great care.
toeic_zh: 請小心處理這件珍貴的藝術品。

en: to become three times as large
simple: Our sales will triple this year.
simple_zh: 我們今年的銷售額會成長三倍。
toeic: The company plans to triple its output by next year.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃明年將產量增為三倍。

en: to give up something for a greater purpose
simple: Parents sacrifice a lot for children.
toeic: We refuse to sacrifice quality to reduce costs.
toeic_zh: 我們拒絕為降低成本而犧牲品質。

en: brave and confident, or strong and clear
simple_zh: 她做了一個大膽的選擇。
toeic: The bold headline on the flyer attracted many customers.
toeic_zh: 傳單上醒目的標題吸引了許多顧客。

en: accepted by most people
toeic: Electric cars are now becoming mainstream in many markets.
toeic_zh: 電動車如今在許多市場已成為主流。

en: a wide range of different things
simple: The store sells a wide spectrum of goods.
simple_zh: 這家店賣各式各樣的商品。
toeic: The survey covered a broad spectrum of customer opinions.
toeic_zh: 這項調查涵蓋了廣泛的顧客意見。

en: stronger or more important than others
simple: It is the dominant company in the market.
simple_zh: 它是市場上佔優勢的公司。
toeic: The firm holds a dominant position in the online retail market.
toeic_zh: 該公司在線上零售市場佔有主導地位。

en: quick to learn or smart in ideas
toeic: The clever design reduced our packaging costs by half.
toeic_zh: 這個巧妙的設計使我們的包裝成本減半。

en: an official count of the people in a country
simple_zh: 人口普查會計算每一個人。
toeic: The census data helps us choose where to open new stores.
toeic_zh: 人口普查資料幫助我們選擇新店開設地點。

en: happening in many places or among many people
toeic: There is widespread support for the new return policy.
toeic_zh: 新的退貨政策獲得廣泛支持。

en: aware of something
simple: I was conscious of the noise.
toeic: Customers are more conscious of product safety these days.
toeic_zh: 現今顧客對產品安全更有意識。

en: completely new and very different
simple_zh: 這是一支革命性的手機。
toeic: The company introduced a revolutionary battery design this year.
toeic_zh: 公司今年推出了革命性的電池設計。

en: the strength or force of something
toeic: The intensity of competition in this market is rising.
toeic_zh: 這個市場的競爭強度正在上升。

en: the act of chasing or trying to achieve something
simple: He is in pursuit of a new job.
simple_zh: 他正在追求一份新工作。
toeic: The firm is in pursuit of new markets in Southeast Asia.
toeic_zh: 該公司正在東南亞尋求新市場。

en: a large and varied group of things
simple: The shop has an array of toys.
simple_zh: 這家店有各式各樣的玩具。
toeic: The store offers a wide array of products at low prices.
toeic_zh: 這家店以低價提供種類繁多的商品。

en: a widely held but false belief; an old story
toeic: It is a myth that online shopping is always cheaper.
toeic_zh: 認為網購一定比較便宜是個迷思。

en: small and not easy to notice
simple: There is a subtle difference in color.
toeic: The ad uses a subtle message to attract younger buyers.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告用含蓄的訊息吸引年輕買家。

en: without limits or control
simple_zh: 你可以在這裡自由發言。
toeic: Customers can freely choose from several payment options.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以自由選擇多種付款方式。

en: force or speed gained as something develops
simple: The team gained momentum this month.
simple_zh: 這個團隊本月氣勢越來越強。
toeic: The campaign is gaining momentum among young consumers.
toeic_zh: 這項活動在年輕消費者之間越來越有聲勢。

en: worth noticing because it is important
toeic: The report shows a notable rise in online orders.
toeic_zh: 報告顯示網路訂單有顯著增加。

en: thin; very small in amount
toeic: The chances of closing the deal are slim.
toeic_zh: 談成這筆交易的機會很渺茫。

en: the title of a news story
simple: I read the headline this morning.
simple_zh: 我今天早上看了頭條新聞。
toeic: The merger was the top headline in the business news.
toeic_zh: 這樁併購案是財經新聞的頭條。

en: accepting without taking action
simple: He is too passive at work.
toeic: A passive approach to sales will not bring new customers.
toeic_zh: 被動的銷售方式無法帶來新客戶。

en: a feeling or opinion about something
toeic: Consumer sentiment improved after the new law passed.
toeic_zh: 新法通過後，消費者信心有所改善。

en: a person or thing that does not win
simple: Nobody wants to be the loser.
toeic: Small shops may be the biggest losers if prices rise.
toeic_zh: 如果價格上漲，小店可能是最大的輸家。

en: especially; in a way that is easy to notice
simple: Many cities, notably Taipei, are crowded.
simple_zh: 許多城市，尤其是台北，都很擁擠。
toeic: Sales rose in several regions, notably in Asia.
toeic_zh: 多個地區的銷售額上升，尤其是亞洲。

en: clearly different from others and easy to recognize
simple: This cake has a distinctive taste.
simple_zh: 這個蛋糕有獨特的味道。
toeic: The company's distinctive logo makes its products easy to spot.
toeic_zh: 這間公司獨特的標誌讓產品很容易辨認。

en: rising or falling very quickly; too high in price
simple: The road is very steep here.
toeic: Customers complained about the steep rise in ticket prices.
toeic_zh: 顧客抱怨票價大幅上漲。

en: in a way that has no plan or pattern
toeic: Winners will be randomly selected from all entries.
toeic_zh: 得獎者將從所有參加者中隨機抽出。

en: a great success or victory
toeic: The product launch was a triumph for the marketing team.
toeic_zh: 產品上市對行銷團隊來說是一大成功。

en: very strong or aggressive
simple_zh: 那隻獅子看起來很兇猛。
toeic: The company faces fierce competition from overseas rivals.
toeic_zh: 該公司面臨來自海外對手的激烈競爭。

en: without any doubt
simple: He is undoubtedly the best player.
toeic: Our new model will undoubtedly attract younger customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的新款無疑會吸引更年輕的客群。

en: Related to the way someone acts
toeic: The company hired a behavioral expert to study customer habits.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請行為專家研究顧客習慣。

en: A group within a range, such as income level
simple: He is in a high tax bracket.
toeic: Customers in this age bracket spend the most on gadgets.
toeic_zh: 這個年齡層的顧客在小工具上花費最多。

en: Complete control of a market by one company
simple: One firm has a monopoly here.
simple_zh: 一家公司在這裡獨占市場。
toeic: The government broke up the telephone monopoly.
toeic_zh: 政府拆分了電話業的壟斷局面。

en: A position of power or control over others
simple_zh: 這家公司擁有市場優勢。
toeic: The brand maintained its dominance in the smartphone market.
toeic_zh: 該品牌在智慧型手機市場維持其主導地位。

en: To use something fully, often for gain
simple_zh: 我們必須利用這個機會。
toeic: The startup plans to exploit new opportunities in Asian markets.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司打算開發亞洲市場的新機會。

en: A place or area where goods are bought and sold
toeic: Competition in the marketplace has become tougher.
toeic_zh: 市場上的競爭變得更激烈了。

en: To refuse to buy or use something as a protest
toeic: Many customers decided to boycott the brand after the scandal.
toeic_zh: 醜聞後許多顧客決定抵制該品牌。

en: To make a copy illegally, or to build with effort
simple: He tried to forge a signature.
toeic: The two firms worked to forge a strong partnership.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司努力建立穩固的合作夥伴關係。

en: To add something that makes another thing complete
simple: This wine will complement the meal.
toeic: The new software will complement our existing system.
toeic_zh: 新軟體將與我們現有的系統相輔相成。

en: In a surprising or very noticeable way
toeic: Sales grew remarkably well after the new campaign.
toeic_zh: 新活動後，銷售成長得非常好。

en: The quality of being easy to understand or use
simple: I like the simplicity of it.
toeic: The simplicity of the design makes the product easy to use.
toeic_zh: 設計的簡潔使產品容易使用。

en: Able to be known before it happens
toeic: Customer demand in this market is fairly predictable.
toeic_zh: 這個市場的顧客需求相當可預測。

en: the act of coming into view or existence
simple: The emergence of the sun was beautiful.
toeic: The emergence of online shopping has changed the retail industry.
toeic_zh: 網路購物的興起改變了零售業。

en: related to amounts and numbers
simple: We need quantitative data for the report.
toeic: The survey provides quantitative data on customer spending habits.
toeic_zh: 這份調查提供了顧客消費習慣的量化數據。

en: to get something back after losing it
simple: He wants to regain his strength.
toeic: The company hopes to regain its market share next year.
toeic_zh: 公司希望明年能重新奪回市占率。

en: to grow and do very well
simple: Plants thrive in this sunny room.
simple_zh: 植物在這間陽光充足的房間長得很好。
toeic: Small businesses can thrive if they offer excellent customer service.
toeic_zh: 小型企業若提供優質客服就能蓬勃發展。

en: financial support given to an event or person
toeic: Our company secured sponsorship for the annual charity concert.
toeic_zh: 我們公司為年度慈善音樂會取得了贊助。

en: not liked by many people
toeic: The new pricing policy was unpopular with long-term customers.
toeic_zh: 新的定價政策不受長期客戶歡迎。

en: toward the back or in reverse direction
toeic: Sales moved backward for the third quarter in a row.
toeic_zh: 銷售額連續第三季倒退。

en: something that makes a situation worse
simple: The small room is a disadvantage.
toeic: One disadvantage of this model is its high maintenance cost.
toeic_zh: 這款機型的一項缺點是維修成本高。

en: not busy or not tight
toeic: Business is slack during the winter months in the tourism industry.
toeic_zh: 旅遊業在冬季月份生意清淡。

en: to bring back to life or use
simple: Water will revive the dry flowers.
toeic: The company launched a campaign to revive interest in its brand.
toeic_zh: 公司推出活動來重振品牌的關注度。

en: to move or develop more slowly than others
simple: My little brother always lags behind.
toeic: Our sales continue to lag behind those of our main competitor.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售持續落後主要競爭對手。

en: to attract someone with something pleasing
simple: Free food will lure many people.
simple_zh: 免費食物會吸引很多人。
toeic: Discounts are used to lure new customers to the store.
toeic_zh: 折扣被用來吸引新顧客到店。

en: in a way that relates to statistics
toeic: The difference between the two groups was statistically significant.
toeic_zh: 兩組之間的差異在統計上具有顯著性。

en: not producing the result you want
toeic: The advertising campaign proved ineffective at reaching young buyers.
toeic_zh: 這次廣告活動未能有效觸及年輕買家。

en: to encourage something to happen or grow
simple: Good grades spur me to study.
toeic: Lower interest rates may spur consumer spending.
toeic_zh: 較低的利率可能刺激消費支出。

en: to a very large degree
toeic: The new app has been hugely successful among young users.
toeic_zh: 這款新應用程式在年輕用戶中大獲成功。

en: to become larger or greater
toeic: The number of online orders will swell during the holidays.
toeic_zh: 假期期間線上訂單數量將會暴增。

en: to show or describe someone or something
simple: The painting will portray a farm.
simple_zh: 這幅畫會描繪一座農場。
toeic: The advertisement portrays the brand as modern and reliable.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告將品牌描繪成現代且可靠。

en: a rapid increase in number
simple: There is a proliferation of new shops.
toeic: The proliferation of smartphones changed how we shop.
toeic_zh: 智慧型手機的激增改變了我們購物的方式。

en: a group of firms that fix prices together
simple_zh: 石油卡特爾提高了價格。
toeic: The regulator fined the cartel for fixing prices.
toeic_zh: 監管機構因操縱價格而對該卡特爾處以罰款。

en: to make someone less willing to do something
toeic: High fees may discourage customers from using the service.
toeic_zh: 高額費用可能使顧客不願使用這項服務。

en: made to be thrown away after use
toeic: Disposable income rose by two percent last year.
toeic_zh: 去年可支配所得增加了百分之二。

en: a person who follows or supports someone
simple_zh: 她在網路上有很多追蹤者。
toeic: The brand gained ten thousand followers after the campaign.
toeic_zh: 這個品牌在宣傳活動後增加了一萬名追蹤者。

en: to persuade or cause something to happen
toeic: Discounts are used to induce customers to buy more.
toeic_zh: 折扣是用來誘使顧客買更多。

en: to grow well and be successful
toeic: Small businesses flourish in this part of the city.
toeic_zh: 小型企業在這個城區蓬勃發展。

en: a way of pronouncing words in a region
toeic: The new manager speaks English with a strong accent.
toeic_zh: 新經理說英語帶有濃厚的口音。

en: able to be easily reached or entered; easy to obtain
simple: Our customer support is easily accessible online.
simple_zh: 我們的客支持在線上很容易訪問。
toeic: Accessible customer service channels include phone, email, and live chat.
toeic_zh: 可訪問的客服渠道包括電話、電郵和即時聊天。

en: to support or follow closely; to stick firmly
simple: Adhere to company service standards at all times.
simple_zh: 始終堅持公司服務標準。
toeic: Adhere strictly to ethical practices in customer interactions.
toeic_zh: 在顧客互動中嚴格堅持倫理實踐。

en: saying yes or showing agreement
toeic: We received an affirmative reply from the client this morning.
toeic_zh: 我們今天早上收到客戶肯定的回覆。

en: as another choice or possibility
simple: Take a bus, or alternatively, a taxi.
toeic: You can pay by card or, alternatively, in cash.
toeic_zh: 您可以刷卡付款，或者付現金。

en: a person who gives news or information on air
toeic: The announcer asked passengers to go to gate twelve.
toeic_zh: 廣播員請乘客前往十二號登機門。

en: to make someone a little angry
toeic: Long waiting times may annoy customers and hurt our reputation.
toeic_zh: 漫長的等待時間可能惹惱顧客並損害我們的聲譽。

en: at any time you want
toeic: Customers can cancel their subscription anytime online.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以隨時在線上取消訂閱。

en: words that say you are sorry
toeic: The company issued a public apology for the billing error.
toeic_zh: 公司針對帳單錯誤發表了公開道歉。
family: apology (n); apologize (v) for; make/offer an apology to；apologetic (adj)

en: thanks, or a feeling of gratitude
simple: She showed her appreciation with a card.
simple_zh: 她用一張卡片表達感謝。
toeic: The manager gave a gift in appreciation of our hard work.
toeic_zh: 經理送了禮物，感謝我們的辛勤工作。

en: a promise that something will be true
toeic: The supplier gave us assurance that the goods will arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 供應商向我們保證貨物會準時送達。

en: to wait for something
toeic: We eagerly await your confirmation of the order.
toeic_zh: 我們熱切等候您確認訂單。

en: used in 'on behalf of' to mean for someone
simple: I spoke on behalf of my team.
toeic: I am writing on behalf of the entire sales department.
toeic_zh: 我謹代表整個業務部門來信。

en: To look through things casually without a fixed aim.
simple: I like to browse the shop.
toeic: Customers can browse our full catalog on the website.
toeic_zh: 顧客可在網站上瀏覽我們的完整型錄。

en: A short official announcement or news report.
simple: Read the bulletin on the wall.
toeic: The company bulletin lists all upcoming training sessions.
toeic_zh: 公司公告列出了所有即將舉行的訓練課程。

en: A casual word you say when leaving.
toeic: She said bye to the clients and left the office.
toeic_zh: 她向客戶道別後離開了辦公室。

en: a person who makes a phone call
simple: The caller wants to speak to you.
toeic: Please ask each caller for an account number before checking the order.
toeic_zh: 查詢訂單前，請先向每位來電者詢問帳號。

en: A small phone you can carry anywhere.
simple: My cellphone is on the table.
toeic: Please turn off your cellphone during the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報期間請關閉您的手機。

en: To move around, or pass from person to person.
toeic: Please circulate the agenda to all team members before Monday.
toeic_zh: 請在週一前將議程傳給所有團隊成員。

en: to make something clear or easier to understand
simple: Can you clarify what you mean by that?
toeic: Service representatives clarify product specifications to prevent misunderstandings.
toeic_zh: 服務代表澄清產品規格以防止誤解。

en: A piece of information that helps solve a problem.
toeic: The survey gave us a clue about customer needs.
toeic_zh: 這項調查讓我們對顧客需求有了線索。

en: to pay someone money or give them something to make up for loss or damage
simple: We will compensate you for the damaged goods.
simple_zh: 我們將為損壞的商品補償您。
toeic: Customers who suffered damages are entitled to compensate through insurance claims.
toeic_zh: 遭受損害的顧客有權通過保險索賠獲得補償。

en: a kind thing you say about someone
toeic: Customers often leave a compliment about our friendly staff in the survey.
toeic_zh: 顧客常在問卷中稱讚我們友善的員工。

en: intended to be kept secret or private; not for public disclosure
simple: Treat all customer information as confidential.
simple_zh: 將所有顧客信息視為機密。
toeic: Confidential customer data requires secure storage and limited access.
toeic_zh: 機密顧客數據需要安全存儲和有限訪問。

en: To tell someone you are happy about their success.
toeic: I would like to congratulate the team on a successful launch.
toeic_zh: 我要恭喜團隊成功完成產品上市。

en: A message of praise for someone's success.
toeic: A congratulation card was sent to the new manager.
toeic_zh: 一張賀卡被寄給了新任經理。

en: thinking about the feelings of other people
toeic: It was considerate of you to reschedule the meeting for me.
toeic_zh: 你體貼地為我重新安排會議，真是貼心。

en: the quality of being easy or useful
simple: The store is open late for your convenience.
simple_zh: 商店很晚才關門，方便你。
toeic: Please return the form at your earliest convenience.
toeic_zh: 請在您方便時盡早寄回表格。

en: fitting in well with a person's needs; not troublesome
simple: Our store hours are very convenient for customers.
simple_zh: 我們的營業時間對顧客來說很方便。
toeic: Online shopping provides convenient access to products 24/7.
toeic_zh: 在線購物提供24/7方便的產品訪問。

en: to communicate or express an idea, feeling, or information
simple: Convey important information clearly to customers.
simple_zh: 向顧客清楚地傳達重要信息。
toeic: Convey service limitations clearly to manage customer expectations.
toeic_zh: 清楚地傳達服務限制以管理顧客期望。

en: a change that fixes a mistake
toeic: Please make the necessary corrections and resubmit the report by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請做必要的修正，並於週五前重新提交報告。

en: in a way that is right
toeic: Please make sure the form is filled out correctly before submitting it.
toeic_zh: 送出前請確認表格填寫正確。

en: letters or emails sent and received
simple: I answer my correspondence each morning.
toeic: All correspondence should be addressed to the customer service department.
toeic_zh: 所有信件應寄給客服部門。

en: polite behavior or a free favor
simple_zh: 他很有禮貌地向她道謝。
toeic: The shuttle bus is provided as a courtesy to hotel guests.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士是提供給飯店房客的免費服務。

en: the hours when it is light
toeic: Call our daytime hotline between nine and five for assistance.
toeic_zh: 請於九點至五點致電我們的日間專線尋求協助。

en: a fault or imperfection in something
simple: The product has a manufacturing defect.
toeic: Defects discovered within the warranty period are covered under our guarantee.
toeic_zh: 在保修期內發現的缺陷由我們的保證覆蓋。

en: imperfect or faulty; not working as it should
simple: The defective product was recalled by the manufacturer.
simple_zh: 製造商召回了有缺陷的產品。
toeic: Defective merchandise returned within the policy timeframe receives replacements.
toeic_zh: 在政策時間內退回的有缺陷的商品可獲得更換。

en: to identify the cause or nature of a problem by examination
simple: We need to diagnose the problem first.
simple_zh: 我們首先需要診斷問題。
toeic: Diagnose customer issues promptly through systematic questioning and testing.
toeic_zh: 通過系統提問和測試及時診斷顧客問題。

en: to press numbers on a phone
toeic: To reach the operator, please dial zero from any hotel phone.
toeic_zh: 若要聯絡總機，請用任何飯店電話撥零。

en: a person eating at a restaurant; a small cheap restaurant
toeic: Each diner will receive a free drink with the set menu.
toeic_zh: 每位用餐者點套餐都將獲得一杯免費飲料。

en: a list of names, addresses or files
toeic: You can find her extension in the company directory.
toeic_zh: 你可以在公司通訊錄中找到她的分機號碼。

en: a sad feeling when hopes are not met
toeic: The delay in shipping was a disappointment to many customers.
toeic_zh: 出貨延遲令許多顧客感到失望。

en: a strong feeling of dislike
simple: He showed disgust at the smell.
simple_zh: 他對那個味道感到噁心。
toeic: The customer expressed disgust at the dirty restaurant kitchen.
toeic_zh: 顧客對餐廳骯髒的廚房表示厭惡。

en: to not enjoy something
toeic: Many customers dislike waiting in long lines at the counter.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客不喜歡在櫃台排長隊等候。

en: to make someone unhappy with something
simple_zh: 服務慢可能讓客人不滿。
toeic: Long delays dissatisfy customers and harm the company's reputation.
toeic_zh: 長時間延誤會讓顧客不滿並損害公司聲譽。

en: a newspaper article giving the paper's opinion
simple: I read the editorial this morning.
toeic: The editorial praised the city's new recycling program.
toeic_zh: 這篇社論稱讚了市政府的新資源回收計畫。

en: to put something inside an envelope or area
simple: I enclose a photo with this letter.
simple_zh: 我在這封信裡附上一張照片。
toeic: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with the application.
toeic_zh: 請在申請書中附上履歷影本。

en: giving you pleasure or fun
toeic: We hope your stay at our resort is enjoyable.
toeic_zh: 我們希望您在本度假村住得愉快。

en: feeling or showing strong interest and excitement
toeic: Customers were enthusiastic about the new product line.
toeic_zh: 顧客對新產品系列反應熱烈。

en: unusually good or special
toeic: The hotel is known for its exceptional customer service.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以卓越的客戶服務聞名。

en: only, without including others
simple: This room is exclusively for staff.
simple_zh: 這個房間只限員工使用。
toeic: The sale is available exclusively to registered members.
toeic_zh: 這次特賣僅限註冊會員。

en: to come to an end; to become no longer valid or usable
simple: The warranty will expire next month.
toeic: Expired warranties no longer provide coverage for product defects.
toeic_zh: 過期保修不再為產品缺陷提供保障。

en: giving information to make something clear
toeic: An explanatory brochure is included with every package.
toeic_zh: 每個包裹都附有一份說明手冊。

en: based on facts and real information
simple: The report is factual and clear.
toeic: Please make sure the article is factual before you publish it.
toeic_zh: 發表前請確認這篇文章屬實。

en: a small fault or imperfection in something
simple: There is a small flaw in the glass.
toeic: Flaws discovered during quality inspection prevent defects reaching customers.
toeic_zh: 質量檢查中發現的缺陷可防止缺陷到達顧客。

en: to cause someone to feel annoyed or upset by preventing success
simple: Technical problems frustrate many online shoppers.
simple_zh: 技術問題讓許多在線購物者沮喪。
toeic: Frustrate customer anger by offering immediate compensation.
toeic_zh: 通過提供即時補償來消除顧客的憤怒沮喪。

en: a broad statement based on a few examples
toeic: It is a generalization to say all customers prefer lower prices.
toeic_zh: 說所有顧客都偏好低價是一種以偏概全。

en: freely giving more than is necessary or expected; ample
simple: Our generous return policy satisfies most customers.
simple_zh: 我們慷慨的退貨政策滿足大多數顧客。
toeic: Generous discounts and loyalty rewards encourage repeat purchases.
toeic_zh: 慷慨的折扣和忠誠度獎勵鼓勵重複購買。

en: a source of danger; a potential source of risk or harm
toeic: Hazard assessment ensures customer safety standards.
toeic_zh: 危險評估確保顧客安全標準。

en: a pain in your head; a problem
toeic: The delayed shipment became a major headache for the sales team.
toeic_zh: 延遲的貨運成了業務團隊的一大麻煩。

en: by this statement or document, formally
toeic: We hereby confirm receipt of your order dated March 3.
toeic_zh: 我們特此確認收到您三月三日的訂單。

en: slow to act because you are not sure
toeic: Many investors are hesitant to buy shares in the new company.
toeic_zh: 許多投資人對購買這家新公司的股票持猶豫態度。

en: a short pause before doing something because of doubt
toeic: Please contact us without hesitation if you have any questions.
toeic_zh: 若有任何問題，請不要猶豫，直接與我們聯絡。

en: having no place to live
simple_zh: 那位無家可歸的男子需要食物。
toeic: The company donated blankets to help homeless families this winter.
toeic_zh: 公司捐贈毛毯，協助今年冬天無家可歸的家庭。

en: in a truthful way
toeic: Honestly, we cannot complete the project before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 老實說，我們無法在期限前完成這個專案。

en: friendly and generous treatment of guests
toeic: The hotel is known for its warm hospitality and fast service.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以熱情款待與快速服務聞名。

en: a phone number for quick help or information
simple_zh: 請撥打服務專線尋求協助。
toeic: Customers with billing questions can call the hotline any time of day.
toeic_zh: 有帳單問題的顧客可隨時撥打服務專線。

en: the strong effect or influence of something; to have a strong effect on
simple: Positive service impacts customer lifetime value.
simple_zh: 正面服務影響顧客終身價值。
toeic: Impact analysis reveals service improvements' business benefits.
toeic_zh: 影響分析揭示服務改進的業務利益。

en: unable to wait calmly for something
simple_zh: 那位男士看起來很不耐煩。
toeic: Callers who are impatient often hang up after five minutes on hold.
toeic_zh: 不耐煩的來電者常在等候五分鐘後掛斷。

en: arriving or coming in
toeic: The receptionist handles all incoming calls and visitors.
toeic_zh: 接待員負責處理所有來電和訪客。

en: a small problem or trouble that makes things difficult
toeic: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the system outage.
toeic_zh: 對於系統中斷所造成的任何不便，我們深表歉意。
family: inconvenience (n/v); inconvenient (adj) 不方便的；cause inconvenience；apologize for the inconvenience

en: to experience or have to pay something unpleasant
simple_zh: 您可能要承擔額外費用。
toeic: Customers will incur a fee if they cancel after the deadline.
toeic_zh: 客戶若在期限後取消，將須負擔費用。

en: giving useful information
toeic: The informative brochure explains all of our services clearly.
toeic_zh: 這份資訊豐富的小冊子清楚說明了我們所有的服務。

en: to ask a question or seek information about something
simple: Customers can inquire about product availability online.
simple_zh: 顧客可以在線詢問產品可用性。
toeic: Please inquire about our premium membership benefits at the service desk.
toeic_zh: 請在服務台詢問我們的高級會員福利。

en: the rise and fall of your voice when speaking
toeic: Good intonation helps customers understand your tone on the phone.
toeic_zh: 良好的語調有助於顧客在電話中理解您的語氣。

en: extremely useful or important
toeic: Your advice has been invaluable to our team.
toeic_zh: 您的建議對我們團隊極其寶貴。

en: to make someone annoyed
toeic: Long waiting times can irritate customers and hurt our reputation.
toeic_zh: 過長的等候時間可能惹惱顧客並損害我們的聲譽。

en: The work of collecting and writing news
toeic: She started a career in journalism after graduation.
toeic_zh: 她畢業後開始從事新聞業。

en: having a lot of knowledge or information about something
simple: Our knowledgeable staff can help you choose the right product.
simple_zh: 我們知識淵博的工作人員可以幫助您選擇合適的產品。
toeic: Knowledgeable representatives provide accurate information about product features.
toeic_zh: 知識淵博的代表提供關於產品功能的準確信息。

en: In the same way
simple: He smiled, and I did likewise.
toeic: Please sign the form and ask your manager to do likewise.
toeic_zh: 請在表格上簽名，並請你的經理也這樣做。

en: With a lot of sound
simple: He spoke loudly in the room.
toeic: Please do not talk loudly in the quiet reading area.
toeic_zh: 請勿在安靜閱讀區大聲交談。

en: A polite way to address a woman
toeic: Thank you for calling, ma'am, how may I help you?
toeic_zh: 女士，感謝您來電，請問有什麼能為您服務？

en: a failure to work normally or properly
simple: Report any product malfunction to customer service.
simple_zh: 向客服報告任何產品故障。
toeic: Malfunctioning products are covered under our extended warranty.
toeic_zh: 故障產品由我們的延長保修承保。

en: to make something as large or as great as possible
simple: Maximize customer satisfaction through excellent service.
simple_zh: 通過優秀服務最大化顧客滿意度。
toeic: Maximize operational efficiency without compromising service quality.
toeic_zh: 最大化運營效率而不損害服務質量。

en: Having a clear and important purpose
simple_zh: 她想要一份有意義的工作。
toeic: The survey gave us meaningful feedback from customers.
toeic_zh: 這項調查讓我們獲得客戶有意義的回饋。

en: TV, newspapers and the internet that give news
toeic: The company will advertise through social media.
toeic_zh: 公司將透過社群媒體進行宣傳。

en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree
simple: Minimize customer waiting times through efficient systems.
simple_zh: 通過高效系統最小化顧客等待時間。
toeic: Minimize service disruptions through proactive maintenance.
toeic_zh: 通過主動維護最小化服務中斷。

en: To wrongly say who or what someone is
toeic: Staff may misidentify the item if the label is unclear.
toeic_zh: 如果標籤不清楚，員工可能會誤認該物品。

en: to make someone believe something that is not true
simple_zh: 這個標誌可能誤導人們。
toeic: Advertisements must not mislead customers about the price.
toeic_zh: 廣告不得就價格誤導顧客。

en: A polite title for a man
toeic: Please give this report to mister Chen at reception.
toeic_zh: 請把這份報告交給接待處的陳先生。

en: to ask for too much money
toeic: Please contact us if you think we overcharge you.
toeic_zh: 如果您認為我們多收了費用，請與我們聯絡。

en: to fail to notice or consider something
toeic: Please do not overlook the warranty terms listed on page two.
toeic_zh: 請別忽略第二頁所列的保固條款。

en: a thin booklet with information
toeic: The clinic gives every visitor a pamphlet about healthy eating.
toeic_zh: 診所給每位訪客一本健康飲食的小冊子。

en: to say something again in other words
toeic: Try to paraphrase the customer's request to confirm you understand.
toeic_zh: 試著改述客戶的需求以確認你理解了。

en: a secret word you use to enter an account
toeic: Click the link below to reset your password if you cannot log in.
toeic_zh: 若無法登入，請點擊下方連結重設您的密碼。

en: ability to wait calmly
toeic: Customer service staff need patience when handling complaints.
toeic_zh: 客服人員處理客訴時需要有耐心。

en: a regular customer of a shop or restaurant
simple: He is a patron of this cafe.
simple_zh: 他是這家咖啡店的常客。
toeic: The restaurant offers a free dessert to every patron on their birthday.
toeic_zh: 餐廳在每位老主顧生日時贈送免費甜點。

en: a written request signed by many people
toeic: Residents submitted a petition to stop the new road.
toeic_zh: 居民提出請願書，要求停止興建新道路。

en: a person trained to prepare medicine
toeic: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
toeic_zh: 藥師說明了這種藥的服用方式。

en: seeming likely to be true
toeic: The manager gave a plausible reason for the delay.
toeic_zh: 經理對延誤提出了合理的原因。

en: showing good manners toward other people
toeic: Always be polite and clear when you answer customer emails.
toeic_zh: 回覆客戶電子郵件時，務必保持禮貌且清楚。

en: in a bad way
simple: He did poorly on the test.
toeic: The poorly designed website frustrated many customers.
toeic_zh: 設計不良的網站讓許多顧客感到沮喪。

en: the state of being liked by many
toeic: The popularity of online shopping keeps growing each year.
toeic_zh: 網路購物的普及度逐年成長。

en: a large printed notice or picture
simple: The poster is on the wall.
toeic: We will put up a poster to promote the new product.
toeic_zh: 我們會張貼海報來宣傳新產品。

en: in a skilled, businesslike way
toeic: The staff handled the complaint professionally and politely.
toeic_zh: 員工以專業又禮貌的方式處理了客訴。

en: used to advertise a product
simple_zh: 我們寄出了促銷電子郵件。
toeic: The promotional campaign increased sales by twenty percent.
toeic_zh: 這項促銷活動使銷售增加了百分之二十。

en: to make something known to the public
toeic: The firm will publicize its new product at the trade show.
toeic_zh: 公司將在商展上宣傳其新產品。

en: an officer who looks after passengers and money
toeic: The purser announced that the flight would be delayed.
toeic_zh: 事務長宣布班機將延誤。

en: a question, often asking for information
simple: I have a query about my bill.
toeic: The customer sent a query about the delivery date.
toeic_zh: 顧客寄來詢問交貨日期的信件。

en: to make someone feel less worried
simple: I try to reassure my mom.
toeic: The agent tried to reassure the customer that the order would arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 客服人員努力向客戶保證訂單會準時送達。

en: the place where visitors are met and checked in
toeic: Please leave any complaints in writing at reception before you check out.
toeic_zh: 退房前如有投訴，請以書面留在接待處。

en: able to be paid back to you
toeic: The deposit is refundable if you cancel within seven days.
toeic_zh: 若您在七天內取消，訂金可以退還。

en: not willing to do something
toeic: Many customers are reluctant to share personal data online.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客不願在網路上分享個人資料。

en: the act of making something valid again
toeic: Your membership renewal must be completed before December 1.
toeic_zh: 您的會員續約必須在十二月一日前完成。

en: again and again
toeic: Customers have repeatedly asked for a faster delivery option.
toeic_zh: 顧客一再要求更快速的配送選項。

en: a person who answers a survey
simple_zh: 每位受訪者回答了十個問題。
toeic: Most respondents said they were satisfied with the service.
toeic_zh: 大多數受訪者表示對服務感到滿意。

en: saying something again in a clear way
simple: I need a restatement of the rule.
simple_zh: 我需要這條規則的重述。
toeic: The report included a restatement of last year's earnings.
toeic_zh: 報告中包含對去年盈餘的重新表述。

en: a man whose job is to sell things
simple: The salesman showed me a car.
simple_zh: 業務員帶我看了一輛車。
toeic: The salesman called to confirm our order for office chairs.
toeic_zh: 業務員來電確認我們訂購辦公椅的訂單。

en: in a way that is honest and truly meant
toeic: We sincerely apologize for the late delivery of your order.
toeic_zh: 對於您的訂單延遲送達，我們由衷致歉。
family: sincerely (adv); sincere (adj) 真誠的；sincerity (n)；Yours sincerely 謹啟

en: to pay to receive a service regularly
toeic: Customers can subscribe to our newsletter on the website.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以在網站上訂閱我們的電子報。

en: a person who pays for a regular service
toeic: The magazine has over ten thousand subscribers.
toeic_zh: 這本雜誌有超過一萬名訂閱者。

en: to take someone to court
toeic: The customer threatened to sue the company for damages.
toeic_zh: 這位顧客威脅要控告公司求償。

en: of very high quality
toeic: The hotel offers superb service and a beautiful view.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店提供一流的服務和美麗的景色。

en: a person who makes or fixes clothes
toeic: The tailor can adjust the jacket by tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 裁縫師明天前可以修改好這件外套。

en: a bank worker who handles customers' money
toeic: Please give your deposit slip to the teller.
toeic_zh: 請把存款單交給櫃員。

en: very good or excellent
toeic: The team did a terrific job on the presentation.
toeic_zh: 團隊的簡報做得非常出色。

en: a text changed into another language
toeic: The translation of the manual will be ready by Friday.
toeic_zh: 手冊的翻譯將在週五前完成。

en: a person who changes words into another language
toeic: We hired a translator for the international conference.
toeic_zh: 我們為國際會議聘請了一位翻譯人員。

en: very large or great
toeic: The new product has been a tremendous success.
toeic_zh: 這項新產品取得了極大的成功。

en: Not happy; sad or not satisfied.
simple_zh: 那個孩子看起來不開心。
toeic: Unhappy customers should be directed to the service desk.
toeic_zh: 不滿意的顧客應被引導至服務台。

en: Not nice or enjoyable.
simple: The room has an unpleasant smell.
simple_zh: 房間有令人不舒服的味道。
toeic: The hotel refunded us after our unpleasant experience.
toeic_zh: 在我們經歷不愉快的住宿後，飯店退款給我們。

en: Not certain about something.
simple: I am unsure about the answer.
toeic: Customers who are unsure about sizes can call our hotline.
toeic_zh: 對尺寸不確定的顧客可以撥打我們的專線。

en: Spoken, not written.
toeic: A verbal agreement is not enough; please sign the contract.
toeic_zh: 口頭協議不夠，請簽署合約。

en: A man who serves food in a restaurant.
simple_zh: 服務生送來了我們的湯。
toeic: The waiter recommended the fish special to our clients.
toeic_zh: 服務生向我們的客戶推薦了特餐魚料理。

en: To choose not to require something.
toeic: The bank agreed to waive the late payment fee this month.
toeic_zh: 銀行同意本月免收逾期付款費用。

en: required to explain and justify one's actions; responsible
simple: We hold staff accountable for service quality.
simple_zh: 我們對工作人員的服務質量負責。
toeic: Accountable employees take ownership of customer satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 負責任的員工擁有顧客滿意度的所有權。

en: a failure when a machine or system stops working
toeic: A system breakdown delayed all online orders on Monday.
toeic_zh: 系統故障使週一所有線上訂單延遲。

en: the ability to do something successfully or efficiently
simple: Demonstrate competence in your customer interactions.
simple_zh: 在顧客互動中展示能力。
toeic: Competence assessment identifies training needs for staff.
toeic_zh: 能力評估識別員工的培訓需求。

en: something given up to settle an argument
toeic: The company made a concession and agreed to cover the repair costs.
toeic_zh: 公司讓步，同意負擔維修費用。

en: to recognize or make a distinction between things; to make different
simple_zh: 區別您的服務與競爭對手。
toeic: Differentiate through personalized customer service excellence.
toeic_zh: 通過個性化客服卓越進行區別。

en: a difficult situation where a choice must be made between undesirable options
simple: The dilemma is between cost and customer satisfaction.
simple_zh: 困境在於成本和顧客滿意度之間。
toeic: Dilemma resolution requires careful weighing of consequences.
toeic_zh: 困境解決需要仔細權衡後果。

en: the process of combining parts or elements into a whole
simple: Integration of systems improves service efficiency.
simple_zh: 系統集成提高服務效率。
toeic: Integration of customer data across departments enables holistic service.
toeic_zh: 跨部門顧客數據集成實現整體服務。

en: to come between and help resolve a situation; to take action to influence events
simple: Management will intervene in complex cases.
simple_zh: 管理層將在複雜案件中進行干預。
toeic: Intervene when frontline staff cannot resolve customer issues.
toeic_zh: 當前線員工無法解決顧客問題時進行干預。

en: legally responsible for something; subject to a penalty
simple: The company is liable for product defects.
toeic: Liable parties must compensate customers for verified damages.
toeic_zh: 有責任方必須為經證實的損害賠償顧客。

en: a thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress
simple: Remove obstacles to better customer service.
toeic: Obstacles in service delivery should be identified and addressed.
toeic_zh: 應識別和解決服務交付中的障礙。

en: waiting to be decided or completed
toeic: Your refund is pending and should be completed within five business days.
toeic_zh: 您的退款正在處理中，應會在五個工作天內完成。

en: the state of being free from public attention or intrusion; confidentiality
simple: We respect your privacy and protect your personal information.
simple_zh: 我們尊重您的隱私並保護您的個人信息。
toeic: Privacy policies must clearly explain customer data usage practices.
toeic_zh: 隱私政策必須清楚解釋顧客數據使用慣例。

en: a line of people or things waiting; a list of items waiting to be processed
simple: Please wait in the queue for the next available representative.
simple_zh: 請在隊列中等待下一位可用的代表。
toeic: Queue management systems help reduce customer waiting times.
toeic_zh: 隊列管理系統有助於減少顧客等待時間。

en: to improve something by small changes or additions
simple: Refine your approach based on feedback.
simple_zh: 根據反饋改進您的方法。
toeic: Refine processes to eliminate bottlenecks in service delivery.
toeic_zh: 改進流程以消除服務交付中的瓶頸。

en: a way to correct something that went wrong
simple: Tea is a remedy for a cold.
toeic: As a remedy, the store offered a free repair and an apology.
toeic_zh: 作為補救，商店提供免費維修並致歉。

en: to give one thing and receive another in exchange
toeic: You may swap the item for a different size at any branch.
toeic_zh: 您可在任何分店將商品換成不同尺寸。

en: very quickly
toeic: Our support team acts swiftly to fix any reported issue.
toeic_zh: 我們的支援團隊會迅速處理任何通報的問題。

en: The written words for a speech or video.
toeic: Please review the script before we record the training video.
toeic_zh: 錄製訓練影片前，請先審閱腳本。

en: uncomfortable or difficult to deal with
toeic: The awkward shape of the box made shipping expensive.
toeic_zh: 這個箱子形狀不便，使運費變貴。

en: a shape made by a curved line crossing itself
simple: Make a loop with the rope.
toeic: Please keep me in the loop about the shipment status.
toeic_zh: 請讓我隨時掌握出貨狀況。

en: in a way that everyone can see or know
simple: He spoke publicly about the problem.
toeic: The company publicly announced its quarterly results on Monday.
toeic_zh: 公司週一公開宣布了季度業績。

en: a secret plan to do something harmful
simple: The movie is about a conspiracy.
simple_zh: 這部電影是關於一個陰謀。
toeic: Executives denied any conspiracy to fix prices.
toeic_zh: 高階主管否認有任何操縱價格的陰謀。

en: a person who secretly gets information
simple: The movie is about a spy.
simple_zh: 這部電影是關於一名間諜。
toeic: A spy was caught stealing data from the rival firm.
toeic_zh: 一名間諜被抓到從競爭公司竊取資料。

en: allowed by law or reasonable
toeic: The customer made a legitimate complaint about the delay.
toeic_zh: 顧客對延誤提出了合理的申訴。

en: in a sad way, or unfortunately
toeic: Sadly, we cannot offer a refund after thirty days.
toeic_zh: 很遺憾，三十天後我們無法提供退款。

en: a thin mark made by something sharp
simple: There is a scratch on the car.
toeic: The customer returned the laptop because of a scratch on the screen.
toeic_zh: 顧客因螢幕上有刮痕而退回筆電。

en: according to what people say or report
toeic: The merger will reportedly be announced next week.
toeic_zh: 據報導，合併案將於下週宣布。

en: related to diplomacy; careful not to upset people
simple_zh: 她給了一個圓滑得體的回答。
toeic: The manager was diplomatic when she rejected the proposal.
toeic_zh: 經理在拒絕提案時措辭十分得體。

en: in a way that is honest and not hidden
simple: She spoke openly about her plan.
simple_zh: 她坦率地談到她的計畫。
toeic: Employees are encouraged to speak openly about workplace concerns.
toeic_zh: 公司鼓勵員工坦率說出對工作場所的疑慮。

en: very strong anger
toeic: The customer's rage calmed down after the manager apologized.
toeic_zh: 經理道歉後，客人的怒氣才平息下來。

en: in a real and honest way
toeic: We are genuinely sorry for the delay in your shipment.
toeic_zh: 對於您的貨物延誤，我們由衷感到抱歉。

en: to communicate or work with others
simple: Kids interact with each other at school.
simple_zh: 孩子們在學校彼此互動。
toeic: Sales staff interact with customers every day.
toeic_zh: 業務人員每天都與顧客互動。

en: on purpose; in a careful way
simple: He deliberately left the door open.
toeic: The error was not made deliberately, and we apologize.
toeic_zh: 這個錯誤並非故意，我們深表歉意。

en: in a way that others cannot see or hear
toeic: The manager asked to speak with him privately after the meeting.
toeic_zh: 經理要求會後和他私下談談。

en: care and understanding for someone's trouble
toeic: Please accept our sympathy for the inconvenience you experienced.
toeic_zh: 對於您所遭遇的不便，請接受我們的歉意與慰問。

en: a serious promise to do something
simple: She made a pledge to help us.
toeic: The firm made a pledge to reduce its carbon emissions by 2030.
toeic_zh: 該公司承諾在2030年前減少碳排放。

en: to cause something to start
simple: The news may spark a big debate.
simple_zh: 這則消息可能引發大辯論。
toeic: The new policy sparked complaints from many employees.
toeic_zh: 這項新政策引起許多員工的抱怨。

en: a feeling of being upset when you cannot do something
toeic: Customers expressed frustration over the long wait for support.
toeic_zh: 顧客對客服等待時間過長表達不滿。

en: clearly and fully stated
toeic: The contract contains explicit terms about late payments.
toeic_zh: 合約中有關於逾期付款的明確條款。

en: in a clear and direct way
simple: She explicitly told me to wait.
toeic: The policy explicitly forbids the use of personal email for work.
toeic_zh: 該政策明確禁止使用個人電子郵件處理工作。

en: great worry, pain or trouble
toeic: The airline offered refunds to passengers in financial distress.
toeic_zh: 航空公司為財務困難的乘客提供退款。

en: the quality of reacting quickly or strongly
toeic: Staff need cultural sensitivity when dealing with overseas clients.
toeic_zh: 員工與海外客戶往來時需要具備文化敏感度。

en: not right or true
toeic: The invoice contained an incorrect billing address.
toeic_zh: 發票上的帳單地址有誤。

en: again and again over time
toeic: Our team continually improves the product based on feedback.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊根據意見回饋不斷改進產品。

en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand
toeic: The manager asked for clarity on the project deadlines.
toeic_zh: 經理要求釐清專案的截止日期。

en: continuing for a long time; not giving up
toeic: Persistent delays are hurting our relationship with clients.
toeic_zh: 持續的延誤正在損害我們與客戶的關係。

en: in a good way; definitely
toeic: Customers responded positively to the new service plan.
toeic_zh: 顧客對新的服務方案反應良好。

en: Not clear or exact
toeic: The contract language is too vague, so please revise it.
toeic_zh: 合約用語太含糊，請修改。

en: A person who writes letters or reports news
toeic: Our foreign correspondent filed a story from Tokyo.
toeic_zh: 我們的駐外記者從東京發回一篇報導。

en: Hard to see or understand
toeic: The instructions were so obscure that no one could follow them.
toeic_zh: 說明太晦澀，沒有人能照著做。

en: Strong anger about something unfair
simple: The price rise caused public outrage.
toeic: The new fee caused outrage among loyal customers.
toeic_zh: 新收費引起忠實顧客的憤怒。

en: The act of saying no
toeic: The supplier's refusal to lower prices delayed the contract.
toeic_zh: 供應商拒絕降價，使合約延宕。

en: A man who speaks for a group or company
toeic: A company spokesman denied the rumors about layoffs.
toeic_zh: 公司發言人否認了裁員的傳聞。

en: To cause to be, or to provide a service
simple: The rain rendered the road unsafe.
toeic: The firm will render services to clients across the country.
toeic_zh: 公司將為全國的客戶提供服務。

en: Able to be believed or trusted
toeic: The report comes from a credible source.
toeic_zh: 這份報告來自可信的消息來源。

en: in a way that is right for the situation
simple: Please dress appropriately for the party.
simple_zh: 請穿著適合派對的服裝。
toeic: All complaints will be handled appropriately by the customer service team.
toeic_zh: 所有客訴都將由客服團隊妥善處理。

en: in a correct or fair way
simple: She rightly said no to the offer.
simple_zh: 她拒絕那個提議是對的。
toeic: Customers rightly expect a quick reply to their complaints.
toeic_zh: 顧客理所當然期待客訴能迅速獲得回覆。

en: to say strongly that something is wrong
toeic: Several leaders condemn the new policy as unfair to workers.
toeic_zh: 數位領袖譴責這項新政策對工人不公平。

en: an angry meeting between opposing people
simple: There was a confrontation at the door.
toeic: The manager tried to avoid a confrontation with the angry client.
toeic_zh: 經理試圖避免與憤怒的客戶發生衝突。

en: to try very hard to achieve something
simple: We strive to do our best.
toeic: We strive to deliver every order on time.
toeic_zh: 我們力求每筆訂單都準時送達。

en: to say a word in a certain way; to declare
simple: How do you pronounce this word?
toeic: The judge will pronounce the final decision on Friday.
toeic_zh: 法官將於週五宣布最終裁決。

en: to stop something from growing or being known
simple: He tried to suppress a laugh.
toeic: The firm tried to suppress news of the product defect.
toeic_zh: 公司試圖壓下產品瑕疵的消息。

en: to weaken something slowly
toeic: Frequent delays could undermine our reputation with customers.
toeic_zh: 頻繁延誤可能損害我們在客戶心中的信譽。

en: to ask in an emotional or serious way
simple: The child began to plead for candy.
toeic: The customer pleaded with the manager for a full refund.
toeic_zh: 顧客懇求經理給予全額退款。

en: to continue to exist or keep trying
simple: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
simple_zh: 如果疼痛持續，請看醫生。
toeic: If the problem persists, please contact our support team.
toeic_zh: 如果問題持續，請聯絡我們的支援團隊。

en: to take in a liquid, or to deal with a cost
toeic: The company will absorb the extra shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 公司將承擔額外的運費。

en: a person who keeps or checks financial records
toeic: The accountant prepared the quarterly tax report.
toeic_zh: 會計師準備了季度報稅表。

en: to gradually collect a larger amount
simple: Dust will accumulate on the shelf.
toeic: Frequent flyers can accumulate points with every trip.
toeic_zh: 常客可以在每次旅程中累積點數。

en: in a correct and exact way
toeic: The report must accurately reflect the company's earnings.
toeic_zh: 報告必須準確反映公司的收益。

en: once every year
simple_zh: 我們每年支付這張帳單。
toeic: The board meets annually to review the company's financial plans.
toeic_zh: 董事會每年開會一次，檢討公司的財務計畫。
family: annual (adj) 每年的; annual report 年報; monthly (adv); quarterly (adv)

en: a lawyer who represents clients
toeic: Our attorney will review the agreement before we sign it.
toeic_zh: 我們的律師會在簽約前審閱這份協議。

en: a person who checks financial records
simple_zh: 審計員檢查了我們的紀錄。
toeic: An external auditor will inspect the annual accounts.
toeic_zh: 外部審計員將查核年度帳目。

en: a person who works in or owns a bank
toeic: The banker explained the terms of the business loan.
toeic_zh: 銀行員說明了企業貸款的條款。

en: not able to pay what you owe
simple: The shop went bankrupt last year.
toeic: The retailer went bankrupt after losing its largest customer.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商在失去最大客戶後破產了。
family: bankruptcy (n) 破產; go bankrupt 破產; declare bankruptcy 宣告破產

en: the state of being unable to pay debts
toeic: The company filed for bankruptcy after losing its biggest client.
toeic_zh: 公司在失去最大客戶後申請破產。

en: Certain to happen, or required by a rule.
toeic: Both parties are bound by the terms of the contract.
toeic_zh: 雙方皆受合約條款約束。

en: A rule made by a company or local authority.
simple: The by-law says no parking here.
simple_zh: 規章規定這裡不可停車。
toeic: The by-law requires a majority vote to change the budget.
toeic_zh: 該規章規定變更預算須經多數決。

en: The act of finding an amount using numbers.
toeic: The accountant checked each calculation before sending the report.
toeic_zh: 會計師在送出報告前檢查了每一項計算。

en: A small machine that does math for you.
toeic: Use the calculator to confirm the total on the invoice.
toeic_zh: 請用計算機確認發票上的總額。

en: Careful to avoid risk or danger.
simple: Be cautious on the icy road.
toeic: Investors remain cautious about the new market.
toeic_zh: 投資人對這個新市場仍持謹慎態度。

en: Giving help or money to people in need.
toeic: The firm made a charitable donation to the local school.
toeic_zh: 該公司向當地學校捐出一筆慈善捐款。

en: A person who gathers things, such as art or payments.
simple: My father is a stamp collector.
toeic: The tax collector will visit the office on Monday.
toeic_zh: 稅務員週一會到辦公室拜訪。

en: a decrease in size or amount
toeic: The report predicts a contraction in the housing market this year.
toeic_zh: 報告預測今年房市將出現萎縮。

en: growing by adding more over time
toeic: The cumulative sales for the year reached two million dollars.
toeic_zh: 全年累計銷售額達到兩百萬美元。

en: money taken out of a bank account
simple: I paid with a debit card.
