toeic: A debit of fifty dollars was made to your account yesterday.
toeic_zh: 昨天您的帳戶被扣款五十美元。

en: to take an amount away from a total
simple: They deduct money from my pay.
simple_zh: 他們從我的薪水裡扣錢。
toeic: The company will deduct the insurance fee from your monthly salary.
toeic_zh: 公司會從你的月薪中扣除保險費。
family: deduction (n) 扣除額; deductible (adj) 可扣除的; tax deduction 稅額減免

en: portion of company profits paid to shareholders
toeic: Dividend yields are attractive.
toeic_zh: 股息收益率很高。

en: to give money or things to help others
toeic: The firm will donate ten percent of its profits to local schools.
toeic_zh: 該公司將把百分之十的利潤捐給當地學校。

en: money or goods given to help
toeic: All donations will go to the new children's hospital.
toeic_zh: 所有捐款都將用於新的兒童醫院。

en: a period when business or the economy gets worse
simple: The economy has a downturn this year.
toeic: The company cut costs during the economic downturn.
toeic_zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間削減了成本。

en: saving money, time, or resources
simple: This car is economical to drive.
toeic: The new printer is a more economical choice for our office.
toeic_zh: 新印表機是我們辦公室更經濟實惠的選擇。

en: in a way related to money or saving money
toeic: The project is economically sound and should bring profit.
toeic_zh: 這項專案在經濟上可行，應該會帶來獲利。

en: to spend less money or use less of something
simple_zh: 我們必須節省食物開支。
toeic: The firm decided to economize by reducing travel expenses.
toeic_zh: 公司決定藉由減少差旅費用來節省開支。

en: a person who starts a new business
toeic: The entrepreneur launched her start-up with a small loan.
toeic_zh: 這位企業家靠一筆小額貸款創辦了新創公司。

en: the money used in many European countries
simple: One euro is not much money.
toeic: The invoice must be paid in euros.
toeic_zh: 發票必須以歐元支付。

en: more than is needed or reasonable
toeic: Excessive spending forced the department to cut its budget.
toeic_zh: 過度支出迫使該部門削減預算。

en: permission to not follow a rule or pay a fee
simple: He got an exemption from the fee.
toeic: Nonprofit groups may apply for a tax exemption.
toeic_zh: 非營利團體可以申請免稅。

en: related to money, taxes and a company's accounts
simple: Our fiscal year starts in April.
simple_zh: 我們的會計年度從四月開始。
toeic: The fiscal year ends on March 31 for most Japanese companies.
toeic_zh: 大多數日本公司的會計年度在三月三十一日結束。
family: fiscal year 會計年度; fiscal policy 財政政策; fiscally (adv)

en: to change often, going up and down
toeic: Oil prices fluctuate depending on the global market.
toeic_zh: 油價會隨全球市場而波動。

en: the activity of collecting money for a cause
toeic: The charity organized a fundraising dinner to support the new school.
toeic_zh: 該慈善機構舉辦募款晚宴來支持新學校。

en: a sign or number that shows a condition
toeic: Rising sales are a key indicator of the company's success.
toeic_zh: 銷售成長是公司成功的關鍵指標。

en: to fill with air, or to raise prices
toeic: Some stores inflate prices just before the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 有些商店在假期旺季前哄抬價格。

en: having a strong effect on people or decisions
simple_zh: 她是個有影響力的領導者。
toeic: The influential investor supported the merger plan.
toeic_zh: 這位有影響力的投資人支持合併計畫。

en: not regular or not following a pattern
toeic: The audit found several irregular transactions in the account.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現該帳戶有幾筆不尋常的交易。

en: To join two things or companies into one
simple: The two banks will merge next year.
simple_zh: 這兩家銀行明年將合併。
toeic: The two firms plan to merge to cut costs.
toeic_zh: 這兩家公司打算合併以降低成本。

en: combination of two companies into one entity
toeic: Merger accounting follows GAAP rules.
toeic_zh: 合併會計遵循GAAP規則。

en: The distance traveled in miles
toeic: Employees can claim mileage for business trips.
toeic_zh: 員工出差可申請里程補貼。

en: Poor and lacking basic things
simple_zh: 這個慈善機構幫助貧困家庭。
toeic: The company donates food to needy people each winter.
toeic_zh: 公司每年冬天都捐贈食物給貧困的人。

en: To make someone have to do something
simple: The contract will obligate us to pay.
simple_zh: 合約會使我們有義務付款。
toeic: The agreement may obligate both sides to share the costs.
toeic_zh: 該協議可能使雙方都有義務分擔費用。

en: To force someone or to help someone as a favor
simple: The rule will oblige us to wear helmets.
simple_zh: 這條規定要求我們戴安全帽。
toeic: The law may oblige companies to report their earnings.
toeic_zh: 法律可能要求公司申報收益。

en: Expecting good things to happen
simple: She is optimistic about the test.
toeic: We are optimistic about next quarter's sales.
toeic_zh: 我們對下一季的銷售感到樂觀。

en: able to be paid; amount owed by a company
toeic: Payable terms affect cash flow.
toeic_zh: 應付條款影響現金流。

en: a statement about what will happen
toeic: The prediction shows that sales will rise next quarter.
toeic_zh: 預測顯示下一季銷售將上升。

en: significant economic slowdown or contraction
toeic: Recession impacts unemployment rates.
toeic_zh: 衰退影響失業率。

en: suddenly and by a large amount
toeic: Sales dropped sharply after the competitor lowered its prices.
toeic_zh: 競爭對手降價後，銷售額急劇下滑。

en: to rise quickly to a high level
toeic: Sales are expected to soar after the product launch.
toeic_zh: 產品上市後，銷售額預計將急遽攀升。

en: numbers that show facts about something
toeic: Recent statistics show that online sales have doubled.
toeic_zh: 最近的統計數據顯示線上銷售已經翻倍。

en: in a regular and continuous way
toeic: Our profits have increased steadily over the past five years.
toeic_zh: 我們的利潤在過去五年穩定成長。

en: something that makes activity or growth increase
simple: Good news is a stimulus for sales.
toeic: The government introduced a stimulus package to boost the economy.
toeic_zh: 政府推出刺激方案來提振經濟。

en: a person who buys and sells shares for others
toeic: Contact your stockbroker before selling any shares.
toeic_zh: 出售任何股票前請先聯絡您的股票經紀人。

en: person or entity that owns shares in a company
toeic: Stockholder meetings occur annually.
toeic_zh: 股東大會每年舉行。

en: to pay part of the cost of something
simple: The city will subsidize the bus.
toeic: The government will subsidize the cost of solar panels.
toeic_zh: 政府將補貼太陽能板的費用。

en: by a large amount
toeic: Revenue has increased substantially since last quarter.
toeic_zh: 營收自上一季以來大幅增加。

en: to take one number away from another
toeic: Subtract the discount from the total to find the final price.
toeic_zh: 從總額中減去折扣，即可得出最終價格。

en: making you feel something is wrong
simple_zh: 那個男人看起來很可疑。
toeic: Report any suspicious activity on your account immediately.
toeic_zh: 請立即回報您帳戶上任何可疑的活動。

en: When one company buys control of another company.
simple: The takeover was in the news.
toeic: The board approved the takeover after reviewing the final offer.
toeic_zh: 董事會在審閱最終出價後核准了這項收購。

en: Not needed.
toeic: We should cut unnecessary expenses to improve profit.
toeic_zh: 我們應削減不必要的開支以提高利潤。

en: In a smart way.
toeic: The manager wisely chose to delay the product launch.
toeic_zh: 經理明智地決定延後產品上市。

en: removal of money from a bank account
simple: Make a withdrawal at the ATM.
toeic: Withdrawal fees apply after 3 transactions.
toeic_zh: 3次交易後收取提取費用。

en: The money used in Japan.
toeic: The price was converted from yen to dollars at today's rate.
toeic_zh: 價格已依今日匯率從日圓換算成美元。

en: income or expense recorded when earned or incurred
toeic: Accruals must be adjusted periodically.
toeic_zh: 應計項目必須定期調整。

en: spreading payment of a loan or cost over time
toeic: Amortization schedules show payments.
toeic_zh: 攤銷計劃顯示付款。

en: financial product providing regular income payments
simple_zh: 年金提供有保證的收入。
toeic: Annuity rates are attractive.
toeic_zh: 年金利率很有吸引力。

en: buying and selling same asset in different markets for profit
toeic: Arbitrage opportunities are rare today.
toeic_zh: 套利機會今天很少見。

en: A person or company that takes a loan.
simple: The borrower must pay every month.
simple_zh: 借款人每個月都必須還款。
toeic: Each borrower must submit tax records along with the loan form.
toeic_zh: 每位借款人都必須連同貸款表格一併提交稅務紀錄。

en: assets pledged as security for a loan
toeic: Collateral value determines loan amount.
toeic_zh: 擔保品價值決定貸款額度。

en: combining of financial statements of related entities
toeic: Consolidation is required for groups.
toeic_zh: 集團需要合併。

en: binding agreement or promise in a contract
toeic: Loan covenants require quarterly reports.
toeic_zh: 貸款契約條款需要季度報告。

en: A person or company that is owed money.
simple: The creditor wants his money back.
simple_zh: 債權人想要拿回他的錢。
toeic: The company agreed to pay each creditor within sixty days.
toeic_zh: 公司同意在六十天內付款給每位債權人。

en: A person or company that owes money.
simple: The debtor has no money today.
toeic: Late debtor payments have hurt our cash position this quarter.
toeic_zh: 債務人延遲付款傷害了我們本季的現金狀況。

en: failure to meet financial obligation
toeic: Default penalties are severe.
toeic_zh: 違約罰款很嚴厲。

en: general decrease in prices and increase in currency value
toeic: Deflation poses policy challenges.
toeic_zh: 通縮帶來政策挑戰。

en: spreading investments across different assets to reduce risk
toeic: Diversification strategy involves sectors.
toeic_zh: 多元化戰略涉及部門。

en: ownership stake in a company; assets minus liabilities
simple: Shareholders own equity in the company.
toeic: Equity value increased this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季度股權價值增加。

en: person legally required to act in another's best interest
toeic: Fiduciary duty is legally binding.
toeic_zh: 受信人責任具有法律約束力。

en: intentional deception for unlawful gain
toeic: Fraud detection requires vigilance.
toeic_zh: 詐欺檢測需要警惕。

en: intangible asset from acquiring a company at premium price
simple_zh: 商譽出現在資產負債表上。
toeic: Goodwill impairment requires testing.
toeic_zh: 商譽減損需要測試。

en: To protect money from loss by making a second deal.
simple: Banks hedge to avoid losing money.
toeic: Exporters often hedge against currency changes with forward contracts.
toeic_zh: 出口商通常以遠期合約來對沖匯率變動。

en: significant decline in asset value below book value
toeic: Impairment testing is required annually.
toeic_zh: 減損測試每年進行。

en: book or record of financial transactions by account
toeic: General ledger records are permanent.
toeic_zh: 總帳記錄是永久的。

en: A person or bank that lends money.
simple: The lender gave us a small loan.
simple_zh: 貸款人借給我們一小筆錢。
toeic: The lender requires proof of income before approving the application.
toeic_zh: 放款機構在核准申請前要求提供收入證明。

en: An official charge or tax collected by the government.
simple: The city added a new levy this year.
simple_zh: 市政府今年新增了一項稅款。
toeic: The government introduced a levy on large bank transactions.
toeic_zh: 政府對大額銀行交易徵收一項稅款。

en: ability to quickly convert assets to cash
simple_zh: 流動性對於運營至關重要。
toeic: Liquidity ratios assess cash availability.
toeic_zh: 流動性比率評估現金可用性。

en: Producing a lot of money.
simple: He found a lucrative job in banking.
simple_zh: 他在銀行業找到一份高薪的工作。
toeic: The company signed a lucrative contract with an overseas retailer.
toeic_zh: 公司與一家海外零售商簽下獲利豐厚的合約。

en: date when a debt obligation becomes due for payment
toeic: Maturity dates require payment planning.
toeic_zh: 到期日期需要支付規劃。

en: An amount of money spent on something.
simple: The first outlay was very small.
toeic: The new factory requires a large initial outlay of capital.
toeic_zh: 新工廠需要龐大的初期資金支出。

en: able to be received; amount owed to a company
simple_zh: 應收款出現在資產負債表上。
toeic: Receivable aging affects collections.
toeic_zh: 應收款賬齡影響催收。

en: Money paid to an owner for using their work or idea.
simple: The singer gets a royalty for each song.
simple_zh: 這位歌手每賣一首歌就能拿到版稅。
toeic: The firm pays a royalty to the inventor for every unit sold.
toeic_zh: 該公司每賣出一件產品就付權利金給發明者。

en: buying/selling to profit from price changes
toeic: Speculation increases market volatility.
toeic_zh: 投機增加市場波動性。

en: Money given by the government to help a business.
simple: The farm gets a subsidy every year.
simple_zh: 這座農場每年都拿到補助金。
toeic: The government offers a subsidy to firms that install solar panels.
toeic_zh: 政府對安裝太陽能板的公司提供補助金。

en: person holding and managing property for another's benefit
toeic: Trustee responsibilities are significant.
toeic_zh: 受託人責任很大。

en: process of determining the worth or value of an asset
toeic: Valuation methods vary by industry.
toeic_zh: 估值方法因行業而異。

en: Changing quickly and often, especially in price.
simple: Oil prices are volatile this week.
toeic: Investors are cautious because the market remains highly volatile.
toeic_zh: 由於市場仍然劇烈波動，投資人保持謹慎。

en: degree of price fluctuation in a security or market
toeic: Volatility index measures market fear.
toeic_zh: 波動性指數衡量市場恐懼。

en: Very serious and worrying.
toeic: The report warned of grave financial risks for the company.
toeic_zh: 報告警告該公司面臨嚴重的財務風險。

en: a thin pointed metal piece for holding things
simple: I put a pin in the map.
simple_zh: 我在地圖上插了一根大頭針。
toeic: Please enter your PIN to access the account.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您的密碼以存取帳戶。

en: the government department that manages money
toeic: Investors bought Treasury bonds to reduce their risk.
toeic_zh: 投資人購買公債以降低風險。

en: a shocking event that harms a reputation
simple_zh: 這個醜聞震驚了所有人。
toeic: The accounting scandal damaged the firm's reputation.
toeic_zh: 會計醜聞損害了這家公司的聲譽。

en: relating to numbers and data analysis
toeic: The statistical report shows a steady rise in sales.
toeic_zh: 統計報告顯示銷售額穩定上升。

en: a person or device that manages something
toeic: The financial controller approved the annual budget.
toeic_zh: 財務主管核准了年度預算。

en: smaller or less important
toeic: The firm faces lesser risks in the domestic market.
toeic_zh: 公司在國內市場面臨的風險較小。

en: a triangle-shaped river mouth; a small change
simple: The river makes a delta near the sea.
simple_zh: 這條河在海邊形成三角洲。
toeic: The delta between forecast and actual sales was small.
toeic_zh: 預測與實際銷售額之間的差距很小。

en: a separate organization or thing with its own existence
simple: The company is a legal entity.
simple_zh: 這家公司是一個法人實體。
toeic: Each subsidiary is treated as a separate legal entity for tax purposes.
toeic_zh: 就稅務而言，每家子公司都被視為獨立的法人實體。

en: in a straight line or step-by-step order
simple: Draw a linear line on the paper.
toeic: Sales showed a linear increase over the past six months.
toeic_zh: 過去六個月的銷售額呈線性成長。

en: related to money
simple: The gift has little monetary value.
simple_zh: 這個禮物的金錢價值不高。
toeic: The central bank changed its monetary policy to control inflation.
toeic_zh: 中央銀行改變貨幣政策以控制通貨膨脹。

en: the way an organization is controlled and managed
simple: Good governance helps a city grow.
simple_zh: 良好的治理有助於城市成長。
toeic: The board is reviewing its corporate governance rules.
toeic_zh: 董事會正在檢討公司治理規範。

en: a legal case brought to a court
toeic: The company faces a lawsuit over a defective product.
toeic_zh: 該公司因瑕疵產品而面臨訴訟。

en: in relation to past times
simple: Historically, this town was very small.
simple_zh: 在歷史上，這個小鎮很小。
toeic: Sales have historically been strongest in the fourth quarter.
toeic_zh: 銷售額在歷史上一向以第四季最高。

en: unfriendly and ready to oppose
simple: The man gave me a hostile look.
simple_zh: 那個男人對我投以敵意的眼神。
toeic: The board rejected the hostile takeover offer.
toeic_zh: 董事會拒絕了惡意收購的提議。

en: small and not important
simple: Do not argue about petty things.
toeic: Petty cash is used for small office expenses.
toeic_zh: 零用金用於辦公室的小額開銷。

en: in a way related to politics
simple_zh: 這個國家在政治上很穩定。
toeic: The region is politically unstable, so investors are cautious.
toeic_zh: 該地區政局不穩，因此投資人保持謹慎。

en: a small drop in level or amount
simple: There was a dip in sales.
toeic: The company saw a slight dip in profits last quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司上一季的利潤略微下滑。

en: the middle value in a set of numbers
simple: The median age here is thirty.
simple_zh: 這裡的年齡中位數是三十歲。
toeic: The median income in the city rose last year.
toeic_zh: 這座城市的收入中位數去年上升了。

en: not moving or changing
simple: The price stayed static all year.
toeic: Sales figures have remained static for three months.
toeic_zh: 銷售數字已連續三個月沒有變動。

en: to break; (informal) to fail financially
toeic: Many small shops went bust during the economic crisis.
toeic_zh: 許多小店在經濟危機期間倒閉。

en: related to mathematics
toeic: The analyst built a mathematical model to predict demand.
toeic_zh: 分析師建立了一個數學模型來預測需求。

en: small or moderate in size; not proud
simple: She is modest about her success.
simple_zh: 她對自己的成功很謙虛。
toeic: The company reported a modest increase in profits.
toeic_zh: 該公司公布利潤小幅成長。

en: a line that something turns around; a chart line
simple: The Earth turns on its axis.
toeic: The horizontal axis of the chart shows the months.
toeic_zh: 圖表的橫軸顯示月份。

en: to jump back after hitting something
simple: The ball will bounce on the floor.
toeic: The check will bounce if there is not enough money in the account.
toeic_zh: 如果帳戶餘額不足，這張支票會被退票。

en: money paid to free someone from jail until trial
simple: He paid bail and went home.
simple_zh: 他繳了保釋金後回家了。
toeic: The government decided to bail out the struggling bank.
toeic_zh: 政府決定紓困這家陷入困境的銀行。

en: the act of making secret information known
simple_zh: 這項揭露讓每個人都很驚訝。
toeic: The law requires full disclosure of all fees to customers.
toeic_zh: 法律要求向顧客完整揭露所有費用。

en: with the subtraction of
toeic: The net profit, minus taxes, was lower than expected.
toeic_zh: 扣除稅金後的淨利低於預期。

en: a company or group connected to a larger one
simple: This shop is an affiliate of a big brand.
simple_zh: 這家店是大品牌的關係企業。
toeic: Our overseas affiliate will handle all customer orders in Asia.
toeic_zh: 我們的海外關係企業將負責亞洲所有客戶訂單。

en: to look into something carefully to find the truth
simple: The police will probe the case.
toeic: Regulators will probe the company's accounting practices.
toeic_zh: 監管機關將調查該公司的會計作業。

en: in a way that relates to money
simple_zh: 他們現在財務上很安穩。
toeic: The firm is financially stable despite the market downturn.
toeic_zh: 儘管市場低迷，該公司財務上仍很穩健。

en: an economic system where private owners run businesses for profit
simple_zh: 許多國家實行資本主義。
toeic: Critics argue that capitalism increases the gap between rich and poor.
toeic_zh: 批評者認為資本主義擴大了貧富差距。

en: a feeling that something is wrong
simple: I have a suspicion about him.
toeic: The auditor reported her suspicion of fraud to management.
toeic_zh: 稽核員向管理階層報告了她對詐欺的懷疑。

en: a very small part of something
simple: I only ate a fraction of the cake.
simple_zh: 我只吃了蛋糕的一小部分。
toeic: The new system costs only a fraction of the old one.
toeic_zh: 新系統的成本只有舊系統的一小部分。

en: in the middle of something
simple: She stayed calm amid the noise.
toeic: Sales rose amid growing competition in the market.
toeic_zh: 在市場競爭加劇之際，銷售額仍有成長。

en: the total amount made from adding smaller parts
simple: The aggregate of sales was high.
toeic: The aggregate demand for solar panels grew sharply this year.
toeic_zh: 今年太陽能板的總需求量大幅成長。

en: likely to cause loss or harm
toeic: Investing in a single stock is a risky strategy.
toeic_zh: 只投資單一股票是有風險的策略。

en: to press hard on something; to reduce
simple: Squeeze the lemon into the water.
toeic: Rising costs continue to squeeze profit margins.
toeic_zh: 成本上升持續壓縮利潤空間。

en: the process of taking a legal case to court
toeic: The firm is spending heavily on litigation over patent rights.
toeic_zh: 該公司在專利權訴訟上花費龐大。

en: the act of becoming active or popular again
simple: The town needs an economic revival.
simple_zh: 這個城鎮需要經濟復甦。
toeic: Analysts expect a revival in consumer spending next year.
toeic_zh: 分析師預期明年消費支出將回升。

en: a person or group that gives money or help
simple_zh: 捐贈者給了我們一些錢。
toeic: A generous donor funded the new hospital wing.
toeic_zh: 一位慷慨的捐贈者出資興建醫院新側翼。

en: a company owned by a larger company
simple: This firm is a subsidiary of ours.
simple_zh: 這家公司是我們的子公司。
toeic: The Tokyo office operates as a wholly owned subsidiary.
toeic_zh: 東京辦公室是一家完全持股的子公司。

en: located or done at sea or in another country
simple: He works on an offshore oil rig.
simple_zh: 他在離岸石油鑽油平台工作。
toeic: The company moved its call center to an offshore location.
toeic_zh: 該公司把客服中心遷到海外。

en: a state of success and having plenty of money
simple: We wish you health and prosperity.
toeic: Trade brought prosperity to the whole region.
toeic_zh: 貿易為整個地區帶來繁榮。

en: in a way that cannot be avoided
toeic: Costs will inevitably rise as raw materials become scarce.
toeic_zh: 隨著原料變得稀少，成本勢必上升。

en: A link between two things
toeic: The report shows a strong correlation between price and sales.
toeic_zh: 報告顯示價格與銷售之間有高度相關性。

en: A person who pays taxes
simple: Every taxpayer must file a form.
simple_zh: 每位納稅人都必須提交表格。
toeic: The new road was paid for by local taxpayers.
toeic_zh: 新道路由當地納稅人出資興建。

en: The act of controlling something in a clever or unfair way
simple: The data showed signs of manipulation.
simple_zh: 資料顯示有被操縱的跡象。
toeic: The firm was fined for the manipulation of stock prices.
toeic_zh: 該公司因操縱股價而被罰款。

en: A difference between amounts or rates
toeic: The pay differential between the two positions is quite large.
toeic_zh: 這兩個職位的薪資差距相當大。

en: Existing as a natural part of something
simple_zh: 風險是商業固有的一部分。
toeic: There are inherent risks in any overseas investment.
toeic_zh: 任何海外投資都有其固有風險。

en: A person who examines facts to find the truth
toeic: An investigator was sent to examine the accounting records.
toeic_zh: 一名調查員被派去檢查會計紀錄。

en: Completely
toeic: The subsidiary is wholly owned by the parent company.
toeic_zh: 這家子公司由母公司全資擁有。

en: Used in per capita, meaning for each person
toeic: Per capita spending on travel has increased this year.
toeic_zh: 今年人均旅遊支出增加了。

en: The act of exchanging something for money or goods
toeic: The redemption of bonds will begin next month.
toeic_zh: 債券贖回將於下個月開始。

en: Never done or known before
simple_zh: 銷售達到前所未有的高點。
toeic: The company achieved unprecedented growth last year.
toeic_zh: 公司去年達成史無前例的成長。

en: The system of collecting taxes
toeic: Changes in taxation affect small business owners the most.
toeic_zh: 稅制的改變對小型企業主影響最大。

en: A person who owns money invested in business
toeic: The young capitalist invested in several tech start-ups.
toeic_zh: 這位年輕資本家投資了數家科技新創公司。

en: To control or limit something
toeic: The company introduced new rules to curb unnecessary costs.
toeic_zh: 公司訂定新規定以抑制不必要的成本。

en: To take a risk hoping for a good result
toeic: The firm decided to gamble on a new product line.
toeic_zh: 公司決定賭一把推出新產品線。

en: A single number from 0 to 9
toeic: Please enter the last four digits of your card number.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您信用卡號的最後四碼。

en: A person who has special knowledge within a group
simple: An insider gave us the news.
simple_zh: 一位內部人士給了我們消息。
toeic: Insider trading is illegal and punished by heavy fines.
toeic_zh: 內線交易是違法的，會被處以重罰。

en: careful and close examination
simple: The report is under close scrutiny.
simple_zh: 這份報告正受到嚴密審查。
toeic: The company's accounts came under scrutiny during the annual audit.
toeic_zh: 公司的帳目在年度查帳時受到嚴格審查。

en: staying the same; not changed
simple: The price stayed unchanged this year.
toeic: The interest rate remained unchanged at the central bank's latest meeting.
toeic_zh: 央行最新一次會議中利率維持不變。

en: having no legal force; void
simple: The old ticket is now null.
toeic: The contract becomes null and void if payment is not received.
toeic_zh: 若未收到款項，合約即失效。

en: to become smaller in size or amount
simple: My shirt will shrink in hot water.
simple_zh: 我的襯衫遇熱水會縮水。
toeic: Profits continued to shrink because of rising material costs.
toeic_zh: 由於原料成本上升，利潤持續縮減。

en: to hide the real nature of something
simple: He wore a hat to disguise himself.
toeic: The firm tried to disguise its losses in the quarterly report.
toeic_zh: 該公司試圖在季報中掩飾虧損。

en: making peace, or matching two sets of records
toeic: The accountant completed the bank reconciliation before the audit.
toeic_zh: 會計師在查核前完成了銀行對帳。

en: toward a lower level
toeic: Stock prices moved downward after the weak earnings report.
toeic_zh: 財報疲弱後，股價走低。

en: a lack of steadiness or security
toeic: Political instability has discouraged foreign investment in the region.
toeic_zh: 政治不穩定讓外國投資卻步。

en: a small solid piece, or a single payment
simple: There is a lump of sugar.
toeic: Employees may take their pension as a lump sum at retirement.
toeic_zh: 員工可在退休時一次領取退休金。

en: very small in size or importance
toeic: The new design brought only a marginal increase in sales.
toeic_zh: 新設計只帶來微幅的銷售成長。

en: toward a higher level
toeic: Housing prices continue to trend upward in the city center.
toeic_zh: 市中心的房價持續走升。

en: serious and without hope or cheer
toeic: The sales forecast looks grim for the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 下一季的銷售預測看來相當慘淡。

en: to control or handle something skillfully
simple: He can manipulate the machine well.
toeic: The report accused the firm of trying to manipulate stock prices.
toeic_zh: 報告指控該公司企圖操縱股價。

en: a group of companies working together
simple_zh: 一個聯合企業建造了這座橋。
toeic: A consortium of three banks will finance the construction project.
toeic_zh: 三家銀行組成的聯貸團將為這項建設計畫提供資金。

en: the act of leaving something or someone out
simple: His exclusion from the team was unfair.
simple_zh: 他被排除在隊外並不公平。
toeic: Check the exclusion list in your insurance policy carefully.
toeic_zh: 請仔細查看保單中的除外條款。

en: having doubts about something
simple: I am skeptical about this story.
simple_zh: 我對這個說法抱持懷疑。
toeic: Investors remain skeptical about the company's growth forecast.
toeic_zh: 投資人仍對公司的成長預測抱持懷疑。

en: a critical shortage or time of pressure
simple: We are in a time crunch.
toeic: The credit crunch made it hard for small firms to borrow money.
toeic_zh: 信貸緊縮使小型公司難以借錢。

en: the end or failure of something
simple: The shop's demise made us sad.
simple_zh: 這家店的結束讓我們難過。
toeic: Poor management led to the company's sudden demise.
toeic_zh: 管理不善導致公司突然倒閉。

en: a hopeful feeling about the future
toeic: There is growing optimism about the economy this year.
toeic_zh: 今年人們對經濟的樂觀情緒逐漸升高。

en: real and able to be touched or measured
toeic: The new system has produced tangible benefits for our customers.
toeic_zh: 新系統為我們的客戶帶來了具體的好處。

zh: 衍生性金融商品；衍生物
en: something developed from something else
simple: This word is a derivative of Latin.
toeic: The bank lost money trading financial derivative products.
toeic_zh: 這家銀行因交易衍生性金融商品而虧損。

en: relating to numbers
simple: Put the files in numerical order.
simple_zh: 把檔案依數字順序排好。
toeic: Please arrange the invoices in numerical order before filing them.
toeic_zh: 歸檔前請將發票依數字順序排列。

en: a large piece or part of something
simple: He ate a chunk of cheese.
toeic: A large chunk of our budget goes to advertising.
toeic_zh: 我們預算中很大一部分花在廣告上。

en: control that limits what you can do
simple: He showed restraint and stayed calm.
toeic: The company is urging restraint in spending this quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司呼籲本季節制開支。

en: the quality of being legal or acceptable
simple: They doubt the legitimacy of the offer.
simple_zh: 他們懷疑這個報價的合法性。
toeic: The court examined the legitimacy of the contract.
toeic_zh: 法院審查了該合約的合法性。

en: an official who controls an industry
simple_zh: 監管機構會檢查每家銀行。
toeic: The financial regulator approved the merger last week.
toeic_zh: 金融監管機構上週核准了這項合併。

en: the formal ending of a group or contract
simple: The dissolution of the band made fans sad.
simple_zh: 樂團解散讓粉絲很難過。
toeic: The partners agreed to the dissolution of the company.
toeic_zh: 合夥人同意解散公司。

en: done to trick people to get money
toeic: The bank detected a fraudulent transaction on her account.
toeic_zh: 銀行偵測到她帳戶上有一筆詐欺交易。

en: very small in amount; in name only
toeic: Members can use the gym for a nominal fee.
toeic_zh: 會員只需付少許費用即可使用健身房。

en: having a fair or equal relation in size
simple: Your pay is proportional to your work.
simple_zh: 你的薪水與工作量成比例。
toeic: Bonuses are proportional to each employee's sales results.
toeic_zh: 獎金與每位員工的銷售成績成正比。

en: rich and successful
toeic: The firm became prosperous after entering the Asian market.
toeic_zh: 這家公司進入亞洲市場後變得興旺。

en: one of several payments made over time
toeic: You can pay for the car in twelve installments.
toeic_zh: 您可以分十二期支付車款。

en: careful because you think there may be danger
toeic: Investors are wary of the unstable market.
toeic_zh: 投資人對不穩定的市場感到謹慎。

en: able to be changed into another form
simple: This sofa is convertible into a bed.
toeic: The bank issued convertible bonds to raise funds.
toeic_zh: 銀行發行可轉換債券來籌措資金。

en: a company that sells insurance
simple: Call your insurer after the crash.
simple_zh: 車禍後打電話給你的保險公司。
toeic: The insurer will pay for the repairs.
toeic_zh: 保險公司會支付維修費用。

en: to recover after a fall
simple: The ball will rebound off the wall.
toeic: Sales are expected to rebound in the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 預期銷售額將在下一季回升。

en: to hide something from others
simple: He tried to conceal the gift.
toeic: The firm was accused of concealing its financial losses.
toeic_zh: 該公司被控隱瞞財務虧損。

en: money given to support an organization
simple: The school received a large endowment.
toeic: The university's endowment funds new scholarships.
toeic_zh: 大學的基金資助新的獎學金。

en: to receive money or things from a dead person
toeic: The new manager will inherit several unfinished projects.
toeic_zh: 新經理將接手幾個未完成的專案。

en: remaining after the main part is gone
toeic: Residual value of the equipment is low after five years.
toeic_zh: 設備使用五年後殘值很低。

en: on or into a ship, plane, or train
toeic: Passengers should be aboard the flight thirty minutes before departure.
toeic_zh: 乘客應在起飛前三十分鐘登機。

en: a vehicle with wings that flies
toeic: Please turn off your phone before the airplane takes off.
toeic_zh: 飛機起飛前請關閉您的手機。

en: a place where planes take off and land
simple: I am going to the airport.
toeic: A shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the airport.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士往返於飯店與機場之間。

en: available instead of the usual one
toeic: Please use an alternate route because the bridge is closed.
toeic_zh: 由於橋梁封閉，請改走替代路線。

en: not exact but close to the real number
simple: The approximate cost is ten dollars.
toeic: The approximate delivery time is three to five business days.
toeic_zh: 預估送達時間約為三至五個工作天。

en: A car with a driver that you pay to ride.
simple: We took a cab to the hotel.
toeic: Please call a cab to take the visitors to the airport.
toeic_zh: 請叫一輛計程車送訪客去機場。

en: A box with bars used to keep animals in.
simple: The bird is in a cage.
toeic: The shipment included a cage for transporting small animals.
toeic_zh: 這批貨物包含一個運送小動物的籠子。

en: The person in charge of a ship, plane or team.
toeic: The captain announced a delay because of bad weather.
toeic_zh: 機長宣布因天候不佳而延誤。

en: goods carried by a ship, plane, or truck
toeic: All cargo must be inspected before it is loaded onto the aircraft.
toeic_zh: 所有貨物在裝上飛機前都必須經過檢查。

en: a company that transports goods
simple: Our carrier delivers packages to all regions.
simple_zh: 我們的承運人將包裹送到所有地區。
toeic: We use multiple carriers to ensure reliable and timely deliveries.
toeic_zh: 我們使用多個承運人以確保可靠和及時的交付。

en: A small vehicle pushed by hand to carry things.
simple: Put the milk in the cart.
toeic: Items in your online cart will be saved for seven days.
toeic_zh: 您線上購物車中的商品將保留七天。

en: a cardboard box used for packing goods
simple: He carried a carton of milk.
toeic: Each carton contains twenty-four units and weighs about ten kilograms.
toeic_zh: 每個紙箱裝有二十四件，重約十公斤。

en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
simple: The pen is ten centimeter long.
toeic: The box must not exceed fifty centimeter in width.
toeic_zh: 箱子的寬度不得超過五十公分。

en: an official document certifying something
simple: This product has a certificate of authenticity.
toeic: Quality certificates prove that products meet industry standards.
toeic_zh: 品質證書證明產品符合行業標準。

en: To put things into groups by type.
simple_zh: 我們依主題為書籍分類。
toeic: Please classify these documents as confidential or public.
toeic_zh: 請將這些文件分類為機密或公開。

en: A person who travels regularly to work.
toeic: Each commuter will get a discount on monthly train passes.
toeic_zh: 每位通勤者都可享有月票折扣。

en: A separate space inside a larger container or vehicle.
simple: Put your bag in the compartment.
simple_zh: 把你的包包放進置物櫃。
toeic: Store large bags in the overhead compartment.
toeic_zh: 請把大型行李放在上方行李櫃。

en: A new problem that makes a situation harder.
toeic: A customs complication delayed the shipment by three days.
toeic_zh: 報關上的麻煩讓貨物延遲了三天。

en: A person who leads an orchestra or checks tickets on a train.
toeic: The conductor will lead the orchestra in tonight's concert.
toeic_zh: 指揮將在今晚的音樂會中帶領樂團。

en: A crowded condition, especially of traffic.
toeic: Heavy congestion on the highway delayed our delivery trucks.
toeic_zh: 高速公路嚴重壅塞延誤了我們的送貨卡車。

en: a batch of goods sent or delivered to someone
simple_zh: 這批託運貨物搭火車抵達了。
toeic: Each consignment must be signed for by a manager.
toeic_zh: 每批託運貨物都必須由經理簽收。
family: consign (v); consignee (n); consignor (n); on consignment 寄售

en: seeking expert advice
toeic: Expert consultation improves supply chain strategy.
toeic_zh: 專家諮詢改進供應鏈策略。

en: a structure designed to hold goods
toeic: Shipping containers are standardized for efficient cargo handling.
toeic_zh: 運送容器標準化以進行高效的貨物搬運。

en: relating to a continent
toeic: The hotel offers a free continental breakfast every morning.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店每天早上提供免費的歐陸式早餐。

en: expensive or causing a big loss
toeic: A delay in delivery could be very costly for our company.
toeic_zh: 交貨延誤可能讓我們公司付出高昂代價。

en: a person who delivers messages or parcels
simple: The courier arrived with your package.
simple_zh: 快遞員帶著您的包裹到達了。
toeic: Our couriers offer same-day delivery for urgent shipments.
toeic_zh: 我們的快遞員為緊急貨運提供當日交付。

en: a business that sells cars for a company
toeic: He works at a car dealership downtown.
toeic_zh: 他在市中心的汽車經銷商工作。

en: able to be trusted to do what is needed
toeic: We are looking for a dependable supplier with fast delivery times.
toeic_zh: 我們正在尋找交貨快速且可靠的供應商。

en: the state of needing something or someone
simple: His dependence on coffee is high.
toeic: The firm is reducing its dependence on a single supplier.
toeic_zh: 該公司正減少對單一供應商的依賴。

en: to throw away something not needed
toeic: Customers should discard any damaged items and request a replacement.
toeic_zh: 顧客應丟棄任何損壞的物品並要求更換。

en: a difference or inconsistency
simple: There is a discrepancy in the inventory.
toeic: Discrepancies between orders and receipts must be investigated.
toeic_zh: 必須調查訂單和收據之間的差異。

en: to send out or arrange for delivery
toeic: Orders are dispatched to customers within 24 hours.
toeic_zh: 訂單在24小時內派遣給客戶。

en: to stop something from continuing normally
toeic: Heavy snow may disrupt train services across the region.
toeic_zh: 大雪可能使整個地區的火車服務中斷。

en: disturbance or problems with normal operations
toeic: Supply chain disruptions require rapid response and adaptation.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷需要快速反應和適應。

en: a company that distributes goods to retailers
simple: Our distributor ships products to stores nationwide.
simple_zh: 我們的分銷商向全國各地的商店運送產品。
toeic: We work with several distributors to reach different regional markets.
toeic_zh: 我們與多個分銷商合作以達到不同的地區市場。

en: a place where ships or trucks load and unload goods
simple: The truck is at the dock.
toeic: Please direct all deliveries to the dock at the rear of the building.
toeic_zh: 請將所有送貨引導到大樓後方的裝卸平台。

en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
toeic: The earthquake damaged several buildings near the factory.
toeic_zh: 地震損壞了工廠附近的幾棟建築。

en: to speed up or hurry a process
simple: Can you expedite this order for me?
simple_zh: 你能為我加急這份訂單嗎？
toeic: Customers can pay extra to expedite shipping for urgent deliveries.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以支付額外費用以加急運送緊急交付。

en: the end of the time a thing can be used
toeic: The expiration date of the contract is December 31.
toeic_zh: 合約的到期日是十二月三十一日。

en: a boat that carries people across water
simple: We took the ferry to the island.
toeic: The ferry to the island departs every hour.
toeic_zh: 前往小島的渡輪每小時開出一班。

en: a group of vehicles or ships owned by one company
simple: The company has a large fleet.
simple_zh: 這家公司有一支龐大的車隊。
toeic: The delivery company is adding ten electric vans to its fleet.
toeic_zh: 這家配送公司正在為其車隊增添十輛電動貨車。

en: ability to adjust to changing conditions
toeic: Supply chain flexibility enables quick response to demand changes.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈靈活性使快速響應需求變化成為可能。

en: a fine powder used to make bread and cakes
simple: We need flour for the cake.
toeic: The bakery orders flour in bulk every week.
toeic_zh: 這間麵包店每週大量訂購麵粉。

en: shoes, boots, and other things worn on feet
simple: The store sells footwear for kids.
toeic: The shop offers a wide selection of footwear at low prices.
toeic_zh: 這家店以低價提供各式鞋類。

en: by good luck
toeic: Fortunately, the shipment arrived before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 幸運的是，貨物在截止日前送達了。

en: goods transported by vehicle, ship, or plane
simple: The freight cost is very high this month.
simple_zh: 這個月的貨運成本很高。
toeic: Freight charges are typically calculated based on weight and distance.
toeic_zh: 貨運費用通常根據重量和距離計算。

en: a ship or plane that carries goods
toeic: A freighter will deliver the machinery to the port next week.
toeic_zh: 一艘貨船下週會將機器運送到港口。

en: to put furniture in a room, or to supply
simple_zh: 他們為新辦公室添購家具。
toeic: The landlord will furnish the apartment with a desk and chairs.
toeic_zh: 房東會為公寓配置書桌和椅子。

en: a unit for measuring liquid
simple: We bought a gallon of milk.
toeic: The truck holds about two hundred gallons of fuel.
toeic_zh: 這輛卡車可裝約兩百加侖的燃料。

en: fuel used in cars
toeic: Rising gasoline prices have increased delivery costs.
toeic_zh: 汽油價格上漲提高了運送成本。

en: things that are made or grown to be sold
simple: The shop has many goods on sale.
simple_zh: 這家店有很多特價商品。
toeic: The goods will be shipped from our central warehouse this afternoon.
toeic_zh: 這批貨品將於今天下午從我們的中央倉庫出貨。

en: a small unit of weight
toeic: The package weighs about five hundred grams.
toeic_zh: 這個包裹重約五百公克。

en: a store or goods for food and household items
simple: I buy milk at the grocery.
toeic: The grocery chain plans to open ten new stores next year.
toeic_zh: 這家連鎖雜貨店計畫明年開設十家新分店。

en: dangerous to people or the environment
simple_zh: 那個箱子裝著危險物品。
toeic: Shipping hazardous materials requires special packaging and labeling.
toeic_zh: 危險物品運輸需要特殊的包裝與標示。

en: a large public road between cities
simple: The highway is very busy today.
toeic: The new highway will shorten the delivery time to the port.
toeic_zh: 新公路將縮短送貨到港口的時間。

en: the amount of water in the air
toeic: Keep the humidity low in the warehouse to protect the goods.
toeic_zh: 請保持倉庫低濕度以保護貨品。

en: covered with ice or very cold
toeic: Drivers should be careful because the highway is icy this morning.
toeic_zh: 由於今早公路結冰，駕駛人應小心。

en: low in price
toeic: We offer an inexpensive way to ship small packages overseas.
toeic_zh: 我們提供寄送小型包裹到海外的廉價方式。

en: colored liquid used for writing or printing
toeic: Please order more ink for the office printer.
toeic_zh: 請為辦公室印表機多訂購一些墨水。

en: to examine something carefully
simple: We inspect all goods before accepting them.
simple_zh: 我們在接受所有商品前進行檢查。
toeic: Quality inspectors examine each shipment to ensure it meets specifications.
toeic_zh: 品質檢查員檢查每份貨運以確保符合規格。

en: not enough
toeic: The loan was refused because of insufficient funds.
toeic_zh: 貸款因資金不足而被拒絕。

en: in or between many countries
simple_zh: 這位歌手在國際上很有名。
toeic: The company sells its products internationally through local distributors.
toeic_zh: 該公司透過當地經銷商向國際銷售產品。

en: a place where two roads cross
toeic: The hotel is located at the intersection of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
toeic_zh: 飯店位於主街與橡樹大道的交叉口。

en: sweet fruit spread, or a blocked line of traffic
simple_zh: 我喜歡在麵包上塗果醬。
toeic: A traffic jam delayed the delivery truck by an hour.
toeic_zh: 交通堵塞使送貨卡車延誤了一小時。

en: a fast airplane with powerful engines
toeic: The executives will travel on a private jet to the conference.
toeic_zh: 主管們將搭乘私人噴射機前往會議。

en: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams
toeic: Shipping costs five dollars per kilogram.
toeic_zh: 運費每公斤五美元。

en: A unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters
simple: The school is one kilometer from here.
toeic: The factory is only one kilometer from the airport.
toeic_zh: 工廠距離機場只有一公里。

en: A narrow road or a section of a wide road
toeic: The right lane will be closed for road repairs.
toeic_zh: 右側車道將因道路維修而封閉。

en: A unit for measuring liquid
simple: I drink one liter of water a day.
toeic: This tank holds one liter of fuel.
toeic_zh: 這個油箱可裝一公升的燃料。

en: In or near the place where you live
toeic: The products are made locally to reduce shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 這些產品在當地製造以降低運費。

en: A person who carries messages or packages
toeic: A messenger will deliver the contract to your office today.
toeic_zh: 信差今天會把合約送到您的辦公室。

en: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
simple: He rides a motorcycle to work.
toeic: Motorcycle parking is available behind the building.
toeic_zh: 大樓後方設有機車停車位。

en: covering the whole country
toeic: The retailer launched a nationwide delivery service last month.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商上個月推出了全國配送服務。

en: To get something
simple: You can obtain a form at the desk.
simple_zh: 你可以在櫃檯取得表格。
toeic: Visitors must obtain a permit before entering the site.
toeic_zh: 訪客進入現場前必須取得許可證。

en: happening or delivered the next day
toeic: Overnight delivery services command premium shipping rates.
toeic_zh: 隔夜交付服務收取高級運送費率。

en: to pay more than is needed
simple: I did not overpay for the room.
toeic: The company refused to overpay for the used equipment.
toeic_zh: 公司拒絕為二手設備付出過高的價錢。

en: a package or bundle of goods
toeic: Parcel delivery services handle small to medium-sized packages.
toeic_zh: 包裹交付服務處理中等規模的包裹。

en: not complete; only a part
toeic: The client received a partial refund for the damaged goods.
toeic_zh: 客戶因貨品受損取得部分退款。

en: not completely; in part
toeic: The warehouse was partially damaged by the storm.
toeic_zh: 倉庫被暴風雨部分損毀。

en: to punish someone for breaking a rule
toeic: The contract will penalize the supplier for late delivery.
toeic_zh: 合約會對延遲交貨的供應商處以罰則。

en: the cost of sending a letter or package by mail
simple: The postage costs two dollars here.
toeic: The price of the catalog does not include postage and handling.
toeic_zh: 目錄價格不含郵資與手續費。

en: relating to mail
toeic: Please include your postal code on the order form.
toeic_zh: 請在訂購單上填寫郵遞區號。

en: a person or company that supplies something
toeic: The service provider will upgrade our network tonight.
toeic_zh: 服務供應商今晚會升級我們的網路。

en: a person who buys something
toeic: The purchaser must pay the full amount within ten days.
toeic_zh: 買方必須在十天內付清全額。

en: a track for trains
simple: The railway is near my house.
toeic: The new railway will connect the port to the city.
toeic_zh: 這條新鐵路將連接港口與市區。

en: a partial refund or discount
simple: The manufacturer offers a rebate on this product.
simple_zh: 製造商對該產品提供回扣。
toeic: Volume rebates reward customers for purchasing in larger quantities.
toeic_zh: 數量回扣獎勵以更大數量購買的客戶。

en: the part that is left
simple: I will eat the remainder later.
toeic: The remainder of the balance is due by the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 餘額須於月底前付清。

en: the act of taking something away
toeic: Snow removal on the parking lot begins early in the morning.
toeic_zh: 停車場的除雪作業一大早就開始。

en: to continue an agreement or card for a new period
simple: I need to renew my card.
toeic: The two companies agreed to renew the contract for another year.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司同意再續約一年。
family: renewal (n); renewable (adj); renew a contract 續約

en: something new that takes the place of another thing
simple: I need a replacement for this cup.
simple_zh: 我需要這個杯子的替換品。
toeic: We will send a free replacement if the item arrives damaged.
toeic_zh: 如果商品到貨時受損，我們會免費寄送替換品。

en: the place where a person lives
toeic: Please send the package to my residence instead of the office.
toeic_zh: 請把包裹寄到我的住所而非辦公室。

en: a person or business that sells to the public
toeic: The retailer plans to open ten new stores this year.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商計畫今年開設十家新店。

en: a person who rides a bike, horse or vehicle
toeic: Bus riders can now pay with a mobile app.
toeic_zh: 公車乘客現在可以用手機應用程式付款。

en: a car with a separate trunk and four doors
toeic: We would like to rent a sedan for three days.
toeic_zh: 我們想租一輛轎車三天。

en: a person who sends a message or package
toeic: If the sender is unknown, do not open the attachment.
toeic_zh: 若寄件人不明，請勿開啟附件。

en: apart from each other
toeic: The items will be shipped separately from the main order.
toeic_zh: 這些商品將與主要訂單分開出貨。

en: a lack or deficiency of something
toeic: Supply chain disruptions create material shortages.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷造成材料短缺。

en: a detailed description of requirements
toeic: Purchase orders include detailed specifications for quality and performance.
toeic_zh: 採購訂單包括品質和性能的詳細規格。

en: a pile of things on top of each other
simple: A stack of books is on the desk.
toeic: There is a stack of invoices waiting to be processed.
toeic_zh: 有一疊發票等待處理。

en: a small label that sticks to things
toeic: Place the price sticker on each item before display.
toeic_zh: 陳列前請在每件商品貼上價格貼紙。

en: a room where things are kept
simple: The boxes are in the storeroom.
toeic: Extra paper is kept in the storeroom on the second floor.
toeic_zh: 備用紙張存放在二樓的儲藏室。

en: a bag for carrying clothes when traveling
toeic: Please keep your suitcase with you at all times.
toeic_zh: 請隨時將您的行李箱帶在身邊。

en: a large store that sells food and goods
toeic: The supermarket is open until midnight on weekends.
toeic_zh: 這家超市週末營業到午夜。

en: a small label attached to something
toeic: Each item must have a security tag before it goes on display.
toeic_zh: 每件商品陳列前都必須貼上防盜標籤。

en: money paid to use a road or bridge
toeic: The toll on this bridge is five dollars.
toeic_zh: 這座橋的通行費是五美元。

en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms
toeic: The factory ships fifty tons of steel each week.
toeic_zh: 這家工廠每週運送五十噸鋼材。

en: powder used in a printer or copier
toeic: Please order new toner for the copy machine.
toeic_zh: 請為影印機訂購新的碳粉。

en: to pull a vehicle with another vehicle
simple: They had to tow my car.
toeic: Cars parked here will be towed at the owner's expense.
toeic_zh: 停在此處的車輛將被拖吊，費用由車主負擔。

en: a person who goes on a trip
toeic: Business travelers can check in at the express counter.
toeic_zh: 商務旅客可在快速櫃檯辦理登機。

en: Not thought likely to happen.
simple_zh: 我們收到一份意外的禮物。
toeic: An unexpected delay forced us to reschedule the shipment.
toeic_zh: 一個意外的延誤迫使我們重新安排出貨。

en: Not able to be trusted or depended on.
toeic: The supplier proved unreliable, so we switched vendors.
toeic_zh: 該供應商不可靠，所以我們換了廠商。

en: Not used yet.
toeic: Unused items may be returned within thirty days for a refund.
toeic_zh: 未使用的商品可在三十天內退貨退款。

en: to confirm the correctness or accuracy of something
toeic: Orders are validated before processing to prevent errors.
toeic_zh: 訂單在處理前經過驗證以防止錯誤。

en: To sell things, often from a machine.
toeic: Licensed street merchants may vend food near the stadium.
toeic_zh: 有執照的街頭商人可在體育場附近販售食物。

en: to prove or confirm the truth of something
simple: We verify all orders before shipping.
simple_zh: 我們在運送前驗證所有訂單。
toeic: Staff verify that shipment contents match the packing list.
toeic_zh: 員工驗證貨運內容與包裝清單相符。

en: a large building for storing goods
simple: The warehouse is located near the port.
toeic: We use automated systems in our warehouse for efficient inventory management.
toeic_zh: 我們在倉庫中使用自動化系統進行有效的庫存管理。

en: In all parts of the world.
simple_zh: 這首歌在全世界都有名。
toeic: Our products are sold worldwide through local distributors.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品透過當地經銷商在全球銷售。

en: the distribution or assignment of resources
toeic: Inventory allocation ensures fairness when stock is limited.
toeic_zh: 庫存配置在庫存有限時確保公平。

en: a basic product that is bought and sold in large amounts
toeic: Rising commodity prices have increased our production costs this quarter.
toeic_zh: 大宗商品價格上漲提高了我們本季的生產成本。

en: to combine multiple shipments into one
simple: We consolidate orders to save on shipping costs.
simple_zh: 我們合併訂單以節省運送成本。
toeic: Shipping companies consolidate multiple shipments to reduce transportation costs.
toeic_zh: 運送公司合併多個貨運以降低運輸成本。

en: easy to break or damage
simple: Be careful. The glass is fragile.
toeic: Fragile items must be packed with extra protective material.
toeic_zh: 易碎物品必須用額外的保護材料包裝。
family: fragility (n); handle with care 小心輕放

en: a load carried over a distance, or the trip itself
simple: It was a long haul by truck.
simple_zh: 那趟卡車運輸路程很長。
toeic: Long-haul shipments are cheaper by rail than by road.
toeic_zh: 長途運輸走鐵路比走公路便宜。

en: basic systems and facilities
toeic: Robust infrastructure supports efficient operations.
toeic_zh: 強大的基礎設施支持高效運營。

en: the management of goods transport and storage
simple: Logistics is crucial for our business operations.
simple_zh: 物流對我們的業務運營至關重要。
toeic: Our logistics team coordinates warehousing, distribution, and customer delivery.
toeic_zh: 我們的物流團隊協調倉儲、分配和客戶交付。

en: the process of obtaining goods or services
toeic: Strategic procurement reduces costs and improves quality.
toeic_zh: 戰略性採購降低成本並提高品質。

en: a written statement of the price for goods or services
simple: I asked for a quotation today.
toeic: Please send us a quotation for 200 office chairs by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前寄給我們兩百張辦公椅的報價單。

en: discarded material or waste
toeic: Scrap rates indicate manufacturing quality issues.
toeic_zh: 廢料率表示製造品質問題。

en: an amount that is less than what is needed
simple: We have a shortfall of ten boxes.
toeic: A supplier delay caused a shortfall in our spring inventory.
toeic_zh: 供應商延誤造成我們春季庫存短缺。

en: an amount that is more than what is needed
simple: We have a surplus of rice.
toeic: The factory sold its surplus stock at a discount.
toeic_zh: 工廠把剩餘庫存打折出售。
family: surplus (adj); surplus stock 剩餘庫存；trade surplus 貿易順差

en: a tax or fee on goods
simple: The tariff on imported electronics is very high.
simple_zh: 進口電子產品的稅率非常高。
toeic: Import tariffs affect the final cost of products to consumers.
toeic_zh: 進口稅率影響產品對消費者的最終成本。

en: A formal agreement between countries.
simple: The two countries signed a treaty.
toeic: The trade treaty lowered import taxes on many goods.
toeic_zh: 這項貿易條約降低了許多商品的進口稅。

en: being the only one
simple: He is the sole owner of the shop.
simple_zh: 他是這家店唯一的老闆。
toeic: Our firm is the sole distributor of this product in Asia.
toeic_zh: 本公司是此產品在亞洲的獨家經銷商。

en: a state of complete confusion
toeic: The system failure caused chaos at the airport.
toeic_zh: 系統故障使機場陷入一片混亂。

en: to make something seem necessary or right
simple_zh: 這個問題值得我們注意。
toeic: The results warrant further investigation by the committee.
toeic_zh: 這些結果有必要由委員會進一步調查。

en: a written statement of rules or a rented vehicle
simple: The club has a written charter.
simple_zh: 這個俱樂部有一份書面章程。
toeic: We booked a charter flight for the company trip.
toeic_zh: 我們為公司旅遊預訂了一班包機。

en: exactly the same
toeic: Please confirm that both copies of the contract are identical.
toeic_zh: 請確認合約的兩份副本完全相同。

en: the act of sorting things into groups
simple: The classification of books takes time.
toeic: Each item needs a correct tariff classification before shipping.
toeic_zh: 每件商品出貨前都需要正確的關稅分類。

en: the business of flying aircraft
toeic: Aviation fuel costs have risen sharply this year.
toeic_zh: 今年航空燃油成本大幅上升。

en: a large round container for liquids
simple: The barrel is full of oil.
toeic: Oil prices rose to 90 dollars a barrel.
toeic_zh: 油價漲到每桶九十美元。

en: to press something so hard that it breaks
toeic: Heavy cartons can crush the goods at the bottom.
toeic_zh: 沉重的紙箱可能壓壞最底層的貨品。

en: a thin ball of air inside liquid
toeic: Bubble wrap protects the glass items during shipping.
toeic_zh: 氣泡紙在運送期間保護玻璃製品。

en: straight up and down
toeic: The vertical shelves save space in the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 直立式貨架節省倉庫空間。

en: very strong, unpleasant, or severe
toeic: Harsh weather conditions delayed the construction work.
toeic_zh: 惡劣的天氣狀況延誤了施工。

en: a failure to follow a rule or agreement
simple: That is a breach of the rules.
toeic: The late delivery was a breach of contract.
toeic_zh: 延遲交貨違反了合約。

en: an aircraft with spinning blades on top
simple: A helicopter flew over the city.
simple_zh: 一架直升機飛過這座城市。
toeic: The resort offers helicopter tours of the island.
toeic_zh: 度假村提供搭乘直升機遊覽該島的行程。

en: an official statement; a list of goods or income
simple: He made a declaration at the airport.
toeic: Travelers must fill out a customs declaration before landing.
toeic_zh: 旅客必須在降落前填寫海關申報單。

en: a person or device that receives something
simple: Pick up the receiver and call him.
toeic: The receiver of the package must sign for it.
toeic_zh: 包裹的收件人必須簽收。

en: similar enough to be compared
simple: The two phones are comparable in price.
simple_zh: 這兩支手機的價格相當。
toeic: Our prices are comparable to those of our competitors.
toeic_zh: 我們的價格與競爭對手相當。

en: a central place where activity or traffic meets
simple: The airport is a big hub.
simple_zh: 這座機場是個大型樞紐。
toeic: Singapore serves as a regional hub for our shipping network.
toeic_zh: 新加坡是我們貨運網絡的區域樞紐。

en: certain to happen and impossible to stop
toeic: Some delays are inevitable during the busy holiday season.
toeic_zh: 在繁忙的假期旺季，部分延誤是無可避免的。

en: one of the world's large land areas
toeic: Our company now ships products to every continent.
toeic_zh: 我們公司現在把產品運送到每個大洲。

en: a grid or table of rows and columns
simple: The teacher drew a matrix on the board.
simple_zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個矩陣。
toeic: We used a decision matrix to compare the suppliers.
toeic_zh: 我們用決策矩陣來比較各家供應商。

en: having many detailed parts; carefully planned
simple_zh: 他們做了一個精緻的蛋糕。
toeic: The hotel lobby has an elaborate design with marble floors.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店的大廳設計精細，鋪有大理石地板。

en: complete and total; very steep
toeic: The sheer size of the order surprised the warehouse team.
toeic_zh: 這筆訂單的龐大規模讓倉儲團隊感到驚訝。

en: not valid; completely empty
simple: The ticket is void after today.
simple_zh: 這張票今天之後就失效了。
toeic: The contract will be void if either party breaks the terms.
toeic_zh: 若任何一方違反條款，合約即告無效。

en: to balance or cancel the effect of something
simple: Savings can offset the high price.
simple_zh: 省下的錢可以抵銷高價。
toeic: Lower shipping costs helped offset the rise in raw material prices.
toeic_zh: 較低的運費有助於抵銷原料價格的上漲。

en: the study of the earth, countries and land
toeic: Knowledge of local geography helps us plan delivery routes.
toeic_zh: 了解當地地理有助於我們規劃配送路線。

en: related to the physical features of a place
toeic: The company is expanding into a new geographic region.
toeic_zh: 該公司正擴展到新的地理區域。

en: according to what people believe, but maybe not true
toeic: The supposedly cheaper supplier ended up costing us more.
toeic_zh: 那家據稱比較便宜的供應商最後讓我們花了更多錢。

en: the main part of a country, not nearby islands
simple: We took a boat to the mainland.
toeic: The factory ships goods from the island to the mainland daily.
toeic_zh: 工廠每天將貨物從島上運到本土。

en: quickly and easily, or willingly
toeic: Our products are readily available in most stores.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品在大多數商店都很容易買到。

en: harmful or unfavorable
simple: The weather had an adverse effect.
toeic: Adverse weather conditions delayed the shipment by two days.
toeic_zh: 惡劣天候使貨物延誤了兩天。

en: a desire for food or for something
toeic: Investors showed little appetite for risky stocks this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季投資人對高風險股票興趣不高。

en: To arrange something dishonestly or equip it
simple: They tried to rig the vote.
toeic: The company was accused of trying to rig the bidding process.
toeic_zh: 該公司被指控試圖操縱投標程序。

en: A person or company that builds houses or buildings
simple_zh: 建築工人修好了我們的屋頂。
toeic: The builder promised to finish the office by June.
toeic_zh: 建築商承諾六月前完成辦公室。

en: Related to the land and places of the world

toeic_zh: 這家店因地理優勢而選擇這個地點。

toeic_zh: 一項新法令禁止進口某些化學品。

en: In all parts of the world
toeic: The brand is recognized globally for its quality.
toeic_zh: 該品牌因品質而受到全球認可。

en: A sudden strong increase

toeic_zh: 需求激增造成出貨延誤。

en: The state of depending on something

toeic_zh: 公司依賴單一供應商是個嚴重風險。

toeic_zh: 海關人員在港口查扣了違禁貨物。

en: To the amount needed

toeic_zh: 貨物在運送過程中沒有受到充分保護。

en: Something that reduces the effect of a shock
toeic: Extra inventory acts as a buffer against supply problems.
toeic_zh: 額外庫存可作為供應問題的緩衝。

en: Measured by comparing with something else
toeic: A comparative analysis of both suppliers will help us decide.
toeic_zh: 對兩家供應商的比較分析將有助於我們決定。

toeic_zh: 工人用樑柱支撐受損的牆。

en: A person who watches something
toeic: The program attracted over a million viewers last night.
toeic_zh: 這個節目昨晚吸引了超過一百萬名觀眾。

simple: The policeman helped us find the street.
simple_zh: 警察幫我們找到那條街。

toeic_zh: 事故發生後，一名警察在飯店外指揮交通。

en: involving two sides or countries
simple: The two countries signed a bilateral deal.
toeic: The bilateral trade agreement will lower tariffs for both countries.
toeic_zh: 這項雙邊貿易協定將降低兩國的關稅。

simple_zh: 我是間接聽到這個消息的。

toeic_zh: 燃料價格上漲間接影響我們所有產品的成本。

toeic_zh: 班機因天候不佳意外取消。

en: not ready or happy to do something
toeic: The supplier was unwilling to lower its prices.
toeic_zh: 供應商不願意降價。

en: the state of being legal or correct

simple_zh: 請確認你的票是否有效。

toeic_zh: 出發前請確認你的護照是否仍有效。

en: not possible to know in advance
toeic: Fuel costs are unpredictable, which makes budgeting difficult.
toeic_zh: 燃料成本難以預測，使預算編列困難。

en: a person who talks about news or sports
simple: The commentator talked about the game.
toeic: A financial commentator explained the market trends on the evening news.
toeic_zh: 一位財經評論員在晚間新聞中解釋市場趨勢。

en: a small hollow made by hitting a surface
simple: There is a dent in my car.
toeic: The delivered box had a dent, so the customer asked for a refund.
toeic_zh: 送達的箱子有凹痕，所以客戶要求退款。

en: to pay back money you owe
toeic: The firm must repay the loan within five years.
toeic_zh: 公司必須在五年內償還這筆貸款。

en: failure to take proper care
simple: The accident was caused by negligence.
simple_zh: 這起意外是疏忽造成的。
toeic: The company was fined for negligence in maintaining safety equipment.
toeic_zh: 公司因疏於維護安全設備而被罰款。

en: not enough in supply
toeic: Skilled workers are scarce in this region.
toeic_zh: 這個地區缺乏技術工人。

en: the gradual gathering of things
simple: The accumulation of snow closed the road.
toeic: The accumulation of debt worried the board.
toeic_zh: 債務的累積讓董事會擔憂。

en: to stop something before it arrives
simple: The guard will intercept the man.

toeic_zh: 海關人員在港口攔截了非法貨物。

en: in agreement with a rule or contract

toeic_zh: 依照合約，款項須在三十天內支付。

en: to make something less harmful

toeic_zh: 我們採取措施來降低延誤的風險。

toeic_zh: 合約中包含轉售的限制條件。

simple_zh: 司機迅速做了個閃避動作。

toeic_zh: 這家公司採取了巧妙策略進入市場。

en: to exchange a coupon for something

simple_zh: 我今天要兌換這張優惠券。

toeic_zh: 顧客可以用點數兌換贈品。

en: the state of needing someone or something
simple: His dependency on coffee is strong.
toeic: The firm wants to reduce its dependency on one supplier.
toeic_zh: 公司想降低對單一供應商的依賴。

en: not sure or unlikely

toeic: It is doubtful that the shipment will arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 貨物是否能準時送達很令人懷疑。

en: to talk proudly about what you have

toeic: The hotel boasts a beautiful view of the sea.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店擁有迷人的海景。

en: based on guessing, often risky for money
toeic: The fund avoids speculative investments in new technology.
toeic_zh: 該基金避開對新科技的投機性投資。

en: to increase greatly in number

toeic_zh: 如果我們拓展海外，利潤可能倍增。

en: the quality of being exact and correct

toeic_zh: 高準確度確保客戶滿意度。

toeic_zh: 客戶必須先啟用新卡才能使用。

toeic_zh: 出國旅行時請攜帶電源轉接器。

en: a warning about danger or an important event

toeic_zh: 庫存量偏低時，系統會發出警示。

toeic_zh: 經理為工作站分配設備。

toeic_zh: 每位學徒花兩年時間跟著資深機械工訓練。

toeic_zh: 技術人員精確組裝零件。

en: to use machines or computers to do work without people

simple_zh: 他們想讓這項工作自動化。

toeic_zh: 工廠計畫明年讓包裝流程自動化。

en: working by itself without a person

toeic_zh: 系統會對每封客戶郵件自動回覆。

en: a car

en: relating to cars and car making

toeic_zh: 這座工廠每九十秒生產一顆電動車電池。

toeic_zh: 技師更換了送貨廂型車的煞車。

en: A small insect, or an error in a computer program.

toeic_zh: 軟體團隊修正了付款系統中的一個錯誤。

simple_zh: 印表機需要新的墨水匣。

toeic_zh: 請為影印機訂購一個替換用的碳粉匣。

toeic_zh: 檢查員將證明該設備符合安全標準。

en: The science of substances and how they change.
toeic: The lab is looking for a researcher with a background in chemistry.
toeic_zh: 這間實驗室正在尋找具化學背景的研究員。

toeic_zh: 每片印刷電路在安裝前都會測試兩次。

simple_zh: 這個充電器與我的手機相容。

toeic_zh: 所有產品都必須符合國際安全標準。

en: a thin wire or rope used for power or tying

toeic_zh: 請不要把電源線放在會絆倒人的地方。

en: working without a power cord

toeic_zh: 這家店本週無線電鑽特價。

toeic_zh: 請小心處理這些精密設備。

toeic_zh: 系統更新前，請將檔案存到桌面。

simple_zh: 開發人員修好了程式錯誤。
toeic: The software developer will present the new application on Monday.
toeic_zh: 軟體開發人員將於週一展示新應用程式。

en: used to find the cause of a problem
simple: The technician ran a diagnostic test.
simple_zh: 技術人員執行了診斷測試。
toeic: Run a diagnostic check if the printer stops working.
toeic_zh: 如果印表機停止運作，請執行診斷檢查。

en: a simple drawing that explains something

toeic_zh: 手冊中附有說明如何組裝桌子的示意圖。

toeic_zh: 你可以在設定選單中停用通知。

en: to copy files from the internet to a device

toeic_zh: 您可以從我們的網站下載申請表。

en: strong and able to last a long time

toeic_zh: 工程師將在每台裝置中嵌入一顆安全晶片。

toeic_zh: 這間實驗室配備了最新的檢測機器。

toeic_zh: 這種布料在裁剪前會先檢測色牢度與強度。

en: having a mechanical problem
toeic: Faulty machinery stops production.
toeic_zh: 故障的機器停止生產。

en: a device for holding something in place

simple_zh: 使用正確的夾具進行組裝。

toeic_zh: 精密夾具確保準確對齐。

toeic_zh: 新軟體為簡報提供了更好的圖像效果。

toeic_zh: 銀行聘請專家保護網路，防範所有駭客。

en: useful and easy to use or reach
simple: This small bag is very handy.

toeic_zh: 請將說明書放在手邊，以便需要時查閱。

en: computer machines and equipment, or tools and metal goods
toeic: The IT department will upgrade all office hardware this month.
toeic_zh: 資訊部門本月將升級所有辦公室硬體設備。

en: using new ideas or methods

toeic_zh: 這家公司以創新的產品設計方式聞名。

en: to put something into something else

toeic_zh: 請將車票插入機器以開啟閘門。

en: careful examination to check quality

toeic_zh: 最終檢查確保產品品質。

en: a person who checks things officially

toeic_zh: 安全檢查員星期一將到工廠視察。

en: the act of putting equipment in place

toeic_zh: 新軟體的安裝將於星期五開始。

en: allowing two-way communication with people or a computer

toeic_zh: 該網站提供互動式工具來比較保險方案。

en: a new thing that someone has made

simple_zh: 電話是一項偉大的發明。

toeic_zh: 該公司上個月為其最新發明申請了專利。

en: A set of keys used to type on a computer

simple_zh: 我的鍵盤有一個按鍵壞了。

toeic_zh: 公司為每個工作站訂購了新鍵盤。

en: Less heavy

en: A book that explains how to use something

en: A natural substance found in the ground

en: the science of matter and energy
